Delwyn_FirstIntroHuntressA.text: Spirit's breath... It's you. Weren't sure I'd ever see you again after... well, you know. <continue>Some said you were dead. Part o' me almost wished it—easier than wonderin' where you went... or how to reckon with what you did.

Delwyn_FirstIntroHuntressB.text: Aye... and save 'em you did. Just wish it hadn't cost you—us—everythin'. <continue>But what's done is done. Now's your chance to make it right. The Spirit is near, or at least... a form of it. Approach, and the hunt begins.

Delwyn_FirstIntro.text: Here to hunt, are ya? That makes two of us. Name's Delwyn. <continue>See that there? No, your eyes don't deceive ya. That... is the Spirit. Or at least, a form of it. <continue>Don't worry—it means for us to follow. Approach, and the hunt begins.

Delwyn_IntroAfterHuntHuntress.text: Spirit's breath... It really is you. Thought me eyes were playin' tricks when I saw you run past. Weren't sure I'd ever see you again after...well, you know. <continue>Some said you were dead. Part o' me almost wished it—easier than wonderin' where you went... or how to reckon with what you did.

Delwyn_IntroAfterHunt.text: I see you don't hang about—nice work on that hunt. Name's Delwyn. <continue>Hope you're friendlier than the Ezoymtes I've met so far—though seein' as you've not tried to cave my head in yet, I'd say we're off to a fine start.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsHuntressA.text: I've never known the Spirit to manifest itself so openly. Heard tell of it, aye... but even in the stories, it weren't like this.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsHuntressB.text: I know you do. Just weren't sure you still cared.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsHuntressC.text: That's what I aim to find out. In years past, the Spirit sought out <i>{rathin}—led our hunters to it, so they could root it out.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsHuntressD.text: Aye. The Spirit's no fool. It's drawn to the worst of 'em—the powerful ones. Might be worth your while to hunt such marks.  If you're lookin' to redeem yourself... here's your chance.

Delwyn_OnSpirits.text: I've never known the Spirit to manifest itself so openly. Heard tell of it, aye... but even in the stories, it weren't like this. <continue>Our elders spoke of a time when the Spirit moved among us, seekin' out <i>{rathin}—Corruption, in the modern tongue—and guidin' our hunters to it so they could cleanse the land. <continue>Seems it's doin' the same now... but more often. More urgent. <continue><i>{Rathin's} spreadin'. The Spirit's callin' us to act. Question is—will you answer?

Delwyn_OnSpiritsAfterHuntHuntress.text: Seems the Spirit hasn't turned its back on you just yet. I've never known it to manifest so openly. Heard tell of it, aye... but even in the stories, it weren't like this.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsAfterHunt.text: You've already had your first hunt with the Spirit. Never known it to manifest so openly. Heard tell of it, aye... but even in the stories, it weren't like this. <continue>Our elders spoke of a time when the Spirit moved among us, seekin' out <i>{rathin}—Corruption, in the modern tongue—and guidin' our hunters to it so they could cleanse the land. <continue>Seems it's doin' the same now... but more often. More urgent. <continue><i>{Rathin's} spreadin'. The Spirit's callin' us to act. Question is... will you answer?

Delwyn_OnSpiritsConvoA.text: I've never known The Spirit to manifest itself so openly. Heard tell of it, aye... but even in the stories, it weren't like this.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsConvoB.text: Our Elders spoke of a time when the Spirit moved among us. It sought out <i>{rathin}... led our hunters to it, so they could put an end to it.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsConvoC.text: Aye, in the modern tongue. Seems it's returned... and the Spirit wants rid of it, same as before.

Delwyn_OnSpiritsConvoD.text: The Spirit's no fool. It's drawn to the worst of 'em—the powerful ones. You might find it worth your while to hunt such marks. Who knows? Maybe even an outsider can hear its voice.

Delwyn_OnDefeatingFirstWispHuntressA.text: I see now, the power those forbidden gems give you. The Spirit may be silent, but I'll thank ye. For all that's happened... it feels right, huntin' alongside you again.

Delwyn_OnDefeatingFirstWispHuntressB.text: Then let's not make it the last. These wisps... follow 'em long enough, maybe we'll come to understand why they're here. Or maybe we won't. Either way, we keep huntin'.

Delwyn_OnDefeatingFirstWispHuntressToget.text: I see now, the power those forbidden gems give you. The Spirit may be silent, but I'll thank ye. For all that's happened... it feels right, huntin' alongside you again. <continue>These wisps... follow 'em long enough, maybe we'll come to understand why they're here. Or maybe we won't. Either way, we keep huntin'.

Delwyn_OnDefeatingFirstWisp.text: Aye, you've the makings of a proper hunter. The Spirit thanks ye—and so do I. <continue>If you've an interest in these hunts, stick around—we'll talk more. <continue>If we run enough of 'em, maybe we'll come to understand what the Spirit wants of us.

Delwyn_OnTypesOfWispsHuntressA.text: Most wisps are small flickers o' the Spirit, drawn to <i>{rathin} like moths to flame. But some... some burn brighter, and seek out only the strongest. <continue>You'll know 'em by their orange glow—bright as embers in the dark.

Delwyn_OnTypesOfWispsHuntressB.text: Aye, they're not so easy to bring down... but I reckon you can handle yourself.

Delwyn_OnTypesOfWisps.text: Most wisps are small flickers o' the Spirit, drawn to <i>{rathin} like moths to flame. But some... some burn brighter, and seek out only the strongest. <continue>You'll know 'em by their orange glow—bright as embers in the dark. They're not easy to bring down... but I reckon you can handle yerself.

Delwyn_OnWispEffectsHuntressA.text: Followin' 'em ain't as simple as just keepin' pace. Chase a wisp, you'll find every beast it touches turns meaner, stronger—more ferocious than before.

Delwyn_OnWispEffectsHuntressB.text: Aye. Seems like the <i>{rathin} in 'em don't take kindly to the Spirit's presence—like a fire ragin' hotter when the wind picks up. <continue>Regardless, the Spirit always settles on one in particular—that's the real threat—but don't go ignorin' the rest, neither.

Delwyn_OnWispEffects.text: Followin' 'em ain't as simple as just keepin' pace. Chase a wisp, and you'll find every beast it touches turns meaner, stronger—more ferocious than before. <continue>Seems like the <i>{rathin} in 'em don't take kindly to the Spirit's presence—like a fire ragin' hotter when the wind picks up. <continue>Regardless, the Spirit always settles on one in particular—that's the real threat—but don't think the rest'll be easy pickings, neither.

Delwyn_OnWispPurposeHuntressA.text: Ain't my place to question the Spirit—I follow where it leads. And right now, seems to me it's guidin' us to rid the land o' <i>{rathin}. <continue>Follow a wisp, and you'll see—it lingers, like.

Delwyn_OnWispPurposeHuntressB.text: Exactly. But best be careful—wherever the Spirit treads, the <i>{rathin} stirs, fightin' back... like a wounded beast that won't go down easy.

Delwyn_OnWispPurposeHuntressC.text: Maybe, maybe not. Either way, it's set us on this path, and I'll not stray from it.

Delwyn_OnWispPurpose.text: Ain't my place to question the Spirit—I follow where it leads. And right now, seems to me it's guidin' us to rid the land o' <i>{rathin}. <continue>Follow a wisp, and you'll see—it lingers, almost like it's waitin' on ya. <continue>But best be careful. Wherever the Spirit treads, <i>{rathin} stirs, fightin' back... like a wounded beast that won't go down easy.

Delwyn_OnAzmeriHuntressA.text: We always kept to ourselves—never troubled the world, and it never troubled us. Least, not 'til our ancestors took in the Vaal, and folk still bicker over whether that were a mistake.

Delwyn_OnAzmeriHuntressB.text: Aye... and you'd have died an Azmeri rather than an outcast.

Delwyn_OnAzmeriHuntressC.text: Nay. Just a statement o' fact. But that were then. Now, the Spirit calls on us to look beyond our own. Who are we to ignore its will?

Delwyn_OnAzmeri.text: We Azmeri always kept to ourselves—never troubled the world, and it never troubled us. Least, not 'til our ancestors took in the Vaal, and folk still bicker over whether that were a mistake. <continue>But that were then. Now, the Spirit itself calls on us to look beyond our own. Who are we to ignore its will?

Delwyn_OnMissingHuntress.text: Heard folk say an Azmeri got taken prisoner 'round these parts, few moons back. Figured I'd ask around... I never expected to find you, least of all walkin' free. <continue>I won't even ask how you managed that one. You're here, you're alive— that's what matters.

Delwyn_OnMissing.text: I'm lookin' for someone—an Azmeri like meself. Heard folk say one might've been taken prisoner in these parts, a few moons past. <continue>You seen anyone like that? ... No? <continue>Suppose I'll have to keep lookin', then. Wanted to ask 'er why she— ugh, forget it. She's not here. That's all I needed to know.

Delwyn_OnMissingConvoA.text: I'm lookin' for someone—an Azmeri like meself. Heard folk say one might've been taken prisoner in these parts, a few moons past. You seen anyone like that?

Delwyn_OnMissingConvoB.text: Suppose I'll have to keep lookin', then. Wanted to ask 'er why she— forget it. She's not here. That's all I needed to know.

Delwyn_OnSpiritHuntressA.text: What can I tell you o' the Spirit you don't already know? It's in all livin' things—you, me, the beasts we hunt. Spirit only knows why it led you to that virtue gem, knowin' what it'd cost you.  <continue>Maybe it saw what was comin'... knew it were the only way to save our kin.

Delwyn_OnSpiritHuntressB.text: The Elders, sometimes they... Never mind. That's not for me to say.

Delwyn_OnSpirit.text: The Azmeri've long lived by the Spirit's ways—not so much a goddess as the lifeblood o' the land, but to outsiders like yerself, it's much the same. <continue>Its energy flows through all livin' things—the wisps are proof o' that. But what Wraeclast is endurin' now... it must be causin' the Spirit no end o' pain.

Delwyn_OnSacredWispsHuntressA.text: We've always hunted beasts infused with the Spirit—you know that as well as I do. But lately... I've seen wisps unlike the rest. Older, maybe. Stronger. More potent with the Spirit's power.

Delwyn_OnSacredWispsHuntressB.text: I do. And I'll be damned if I don't listen... Question is, will you?

Delwyn_OnSacredWisps.text: We Azmeri hunt beasts infused with the Spirit. Always have. But... seems there are some wisps that are different. Older, maybe. More potent with the Spirit's power.  <continue>These are the ones I track—they seek out only the most Corrupted o' beasts. <continue>I've seen more and more of 'em lately. Can't say why. But the Spirit clearly means to tell us summat... and I'll be damned if I don't listen.

Delwyn_OnSacredFoxHuntressA.text: That were a Wisp o' the Cunning Fox. Aptly named, they are. Any beast they inhabit don't just get stronger—they get meaner, trickier too. We're lucky this turned out as well as it did.

Delwyn_OnSacredFoxHuntressB.text: Ha—forgive me. Almost forgot who I were dealin' with.

Delwyn_OnSacredFox.text: That were a Wisp o' the Cunning Fox. Aptly named, they are. Any beast they inhabit don't just get stronger—they get meaner, trickier too. We're lucky this turned out as well as it did.

Delwyn_OnSacredHareHuntressA.text: Reckon that were a Wisp o' the Spring Hare. Wily lil' things, they are—devilishly so. Any beast they inhabit's got a chance o' springin' straight back to life after you've put 'em down... as if there weren't enough o' that goin' around already.

Delwyn_OnSacredHareHuntressB.text: Aye—seems unlike the Spirit, truth be told. But who am I to question?

Delwyn_OnSacredHare.text: Reckon that were a Wisp o' the Spring Hare. Wily lil' things, they are—devilishly so. Any beast they inhabit's got a chance o' springin' straight back to life after you've put 'em down... as if there weren't enough o' that goin' around already.

Delwyn_OnLosingWispHuntress.text: It's not like you to lose a trail. Still, even the best miss their mark sometimes. We'll get the next one, Spirit willing.

Delwyn_OnLosingWisp.text: Even the best hunters lose a trail now and then. No shame in it—Spirit willing, we'll get the next one. Just be ready when the time comes.

Delwyn_IntroInMapsHuntressB.text: Thought maybe I'd lost me way. But if you're here too, then perhaps this ain't a dream after all.

Delwyn_KeepHuntingHuntress.text: The Spirit must think highly of us. To bring us here, together... there's no greater sign. We've a task before us, and we must see it through.

Delwyn_KeepHunting.text: The Spirit's brought us here for a reason—to keep goin', to keep drivin' out the <i>{rathin} wherever it may reside. Our path's never been clearer. We must prevail.

Delwyn_OnTheForest.text: That forest were like no other, but I think I ken its nature. Must've been where our long-lost Maji travelled, all those generations past. Who'd have thought the Wildwood were real, all this time? <continue>But slippin' in an' out so easy... that don't sit right with me. The wisps, the <i>{rathin}, the 'Wood... all things that once kept their distance, drawin' closer. Not sure that's a blessin'.

The Elders had us tearing 'em down soon after you left—said they were drainin' the sacred flow, makin' the wisps restless. <continue>But this King feller were here? In these forests? ...Aye, I don't much like how this fruit's ripenin'.

WifeBoss_PlayerDeath_Karui.text: Your soul will not travel to your Halls of the Dead, Karui... it will stay right here with us...

WifeBoss_Area1Draven.text: So... You have vanquished my beloved Praetor? You shall find no mercy here, intruder. I will relish every moment of your torment.

WifeBoss_Area1DravenEzo.text: You murder my Praetor, and now you dare come for me? I will break you, dog.

WifeBoss_Area1DravenEzoAlt.text: Ezomyte filth! Yet you bested my husband? Your kind knows only suffering, and I shall ensure you suffer most of all!

WifeBoss_Area1Ezo.text: You dare trespass in my halls after what your people have done to mine, Ezomyte? You disgust me!

WifeBoss_Area1EzoAlt.text: An Ezomyte trespassing in my halls? Disgusting... This land belongs to the immortal souls of the Eternal Empire!

WifeBoss_Area2.text: You can't possibly be aiding that doddering old fool! Why die for someone else's war?

WifeBoss_Area2Ezo.text: Your precious 'Count' Lachlann has accomplished nothing but sending your people to their deaths.

WifeBoss_Area2EzoAlt.text: Hmm... aiding that decrepit Ezomyte fool, are you?

WifeBoss_Area3MonstersDead.text: It appears I will have to deal with you myself... So be it.

WifeBoss_Area3MonstersDeadEzo.text: It appears I must sully my hands with you... Ezomyte vermin.

WifeBoss_BoneWall_5.text: Prison of Bone! Now... hold still!

WifeBoss_BoneWall_6.text: Prison of Bone! Now... hold still!

WifeBoss_BoneWall_7.text: Prison of Bone! Now... hold still!

WifeBoss_PreEmerge.text: I studied dark thaumaturgy beyond your comprehension! With this power, I have transcended the chains of the flesh!

WifeBoss_PreEmergeAlt.text: And finally... You have found my place of rest...Here... You shall fight for more than just your worthless life.

WifeBoss_Summon_4.text: My love, I call to you!

WifeBoss_Summon_5.text: My love, I call to you!

WifeBoss_Summon_6.text: My love, I call to you!

WifeBoss_Summon_7.text: My love, I call to you!

AkoyaBossfightDishonour.text: Misguided chieftain! You dishonour us all!

KaruiElder_EyeOfHinekora.text: [DNT] The Eye of Hinekora is this way.

KaruiElder_NavaliGreeting.text: [DNT] They are worthy of the trial.

HusbandBoss_Combo_Random.text: I will end your meaningless life!

HusbandBoss_Combo_2.text: I will end your meaningless life!

HusbandBoss_Combo_3.text: I will end your meaningless life!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Ezo_Random.text: Ezomyte filth! Your people will rot for eternity, beneath my feet!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Ezo_2.text: Ezomyte filth! Your people will rot for eternity, beneath my feet!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Karui_Random.text: Your soul will be quite the trophy... Karui...

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Karui_2.text: A Karui soul for my collection... You shall die... slowly!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Other_Random.text: You will have eternity to regret your intrusion here!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Other_2.text: Now... your soul will join my steeple of death!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Sorc.text: Maraketh woman... Do not meddle in Eternal affairs!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Templar.text: Oriathan... Your soul will never see the light of your god!

HusbandBoss_Emerge_Witch.text: Depraved witch... You are not long for this world!

HusbandBoss_Knockdown_Random.text: Ugh... The Eternals will never surrender!

HusbandBoss_Knockdown_2.text: Ugh... The Eternals will never surrender!

HusbandBoss_Knockdown_3.text: Ugh... The Eternals will never surrender!

WifeBoss_Summon_Map_Random.text: My love, I call to you!

WifeBoss_Summon_Map_2.text: My love, I call to you!

WifeBoss_Summon_Map_3.text: My love, I call to you!

WifeBoss_Summon_Map_4.text: My love, I call to you!

HusbandBoss_Area1.text: What living soul walks among the dead?

HusbandBoss_Area1AsiniaSlainEzomyte.text: Ezomyte dog! You dare enter this place after what you did to Asinia? I will rip your soul from your very flesh!

HusbandBoss_Area1AsiniaSlain_Random.text: I know what you did. I shall repay, in kind, every moment of Asinia's suffering!

HusbandBoss_Area1AsiniaSlain_2.text: I know what you did. I shall repay, in kind, every moment of Asinia's suffering!

HusbandBoss_Area1Azmeri.text: Begone, Azmeri. This is not your war.

HusbandBoss_Area1Ezomyte_Random.text: Come to carry on your useless rebellion, Ezomyte? How pathetic...

HusbandBoss_Area1Ezomyte_2.text: You defile this place with your very presence, Ezomyte!

HusbandBoss_Area1Maji_Random.text: I'm surprised your kind still exist at all, Maji... You are treading on someone else's war.

HusbandBoss_Area1Maji_2.text: A child of the Maji... Unexpected. You should not have come here.

HusbandBoss_Area2_Random.text: This belongs to the Eternal Empire... For this theft, your blood will stain these halls!

HusbandBoss_Area2_2.text: This belongs to the Eternal Empire... For this theft, your blood will stain these halls!

HusbandBoss_Area2Ezo_Random.text: Vile rodent... You shall pay for this sacrilege with your life!

HusbandBoss_Area2Ezo_2.text: Vile rodent... You shall pay for this sacrilege with your life!

HusbandBoss_Area2Ezo_3.text: How expected. An Ezomyte that defiles our graves and steals what is ours. You are a testament to your kind...

HusbandBoss_Area2Ezo_4.text: How expected. An Ezomyte that defiles our graves and steals what is ours. You are a testament to your kind...

HusbandBoss_Area3.text: You journey ever deeper towards your own death. Join me...

HusbandBoss_Area3Ezo_Random.text: Your path is one of inevitable ruin... Embrace your death, and in darkness, learn to submit, as countless Ezomytes have before you.

HusbandBoss_Area3Ezo_2.text: Yes, come to me, dog! One way or another, we shall finally break this endless cycle of vengeance.

HusbandBoss_Area3Ezo_3.text: Yes, come to me, dog! One way or another, we shall finally break this endless cycle of vengeance.

HusbandBoss_Area3EzoAsinia.text: Yes, come to me, dog! I will rip your soul from your very flesh! You will be the kindling that reignites Asinia's spirit...

HusbandBoss_Pre-Emerge.text: I gave you every chance to leave. Now... you never will.

AlvaKingsmarchIntroWildCallout.text: Ahhh, Kingsmarch! It's been months since I had a bath!

RogKingsmarchIntroWildLeave.text: Come visit my shop some time!

DannigA4_Wild_Expedition_One.text: Good. Now keep going! See how far you string out those explosives.

DannigA4_Wild_Expedition_Four.text: All done... Now the fun part. The detonation!

DannigA4_Wild_ExpeditionDetonate.text: Please note, this usually stirs all manner of creatures below!

DannigA4_Wild_ExpeditionMonstersDead.text: Well then. You made short work of that. Well done!

MortimerFirstCalloutAbyss.text: You there! Before you go - allow old Mortimer to warn you.

MortimerFirstCalloutAbyssWarrior.text: Ah, before you go, foundling... I must warn you.

MortimerFirstCalloutAbyssWitch.text: Ah, dark one... before you go, I must warn you.

MortimerFirstCalloutAbyssMerc.text: Trarthan... before you go, I must warn you.

MortimerFirstCalloutAbyssHuntress.text: Fair Azmeri... before you go, I must warn you.

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo1_D.text: Watch your bloody mouth while you're here, alright?

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo2_A.text: Peg-leg! You must visit us again on Arastas.

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo2_B.text: You... are on your last warnin'.

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo2_C.text: We have some of the best mead you'll ever taste.

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo2_D.text: I wondered why you lot kept so many bees...

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo2_E.text: Bees are useful for many reasons!

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo2_F.text: But yes, we have some of the best mead the world has ever seen!

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo2_G.text: Well... I'll be the judge of that.

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo3_A.text: How much longer do we gotta hear your yappin' today?

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo3_B.text: Why does it bother you so, friend?

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo3_C.text: I'm pretty sure it bothers everyone.

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo3_D.text: On the contrary. We've had plenty of pledgers arrive from Kingsmarch.

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo3_E.text: Well... yet another reason to shut up.

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo4_A.text: You know, there is a brighter future for you, peg-leg.

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo4_B.text: You just have to reach out and take it!

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo4_C.text: How about I reach out my hands... Around your bloody throat?

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo4_D.text: One more comment. Just one. And I swear...

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo4_E.text: Now, now... violence is not necessary.

Preacher_Wild_TPConvo4_F.text: There'll be no need for that in Utopia!

Tujen_Wild_TPConvo4_G.text: You might not make it to your... Utopia... at this rate.

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrapped_A.text: Please hurry! I feel I could die at any moment. Oh! Cadigan preserve me!

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrapped_C.text: You must forgive me. This has been a nightmare.

Tujen_Wild_FreyaTrapped_D.text: Oh... of course... I can't even imagine. What's it been now? Four years?

Tujen_Wild_FreyaTrapped_E.text: We thought you made it to Kalguur with your shipment.

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrapped_F.text: We crashed upon these unseen shoals.

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrapped_H.text: I long to walk once more under the sun, in those softly waving fields...

Tujen_Wild_FreyaTrapped_I.text: <i>{Softly waving fields}? What part of Middengard are you from again?

Tujen_Wild_FreyaTrapped_K.text: Of course. I can't imagine what being out here this long does to the mind.

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrapped_M.text: Yes... I think I'll rest now.

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedIdle_A.text: What are you doing? Please... help me.

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedIdle_B.text: Will you get a move on?

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedIdle_C.text: I can't go on... much... longer...

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedIdle_D.text: Hurry up, will you! She's fading!

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedIdle_E.text: I see a light... Oh... it's so bright and lovely...

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedIdle_F.text: No no no no no! Don't look at it. Not yet! Resist it!

Freya_Wild_FreyaTrappedEnd_B.text: Hahaha... thank you kindly... I am finally free!

Tujen_Wild_FreyaTrappedEnd_B.text: Ugh, we've been played, 'aven't we? I'm out of here!

TwilightOverlordBoss_PillarSlam_Random.text: So long as Divinity disgraces the world... no one is safe. You stand in the way of Hope!

TwilightOverlordBoss_PillarSlam_2.text: So long as Divinity disgraces the world... no one is safe. You stand in the way of Hope!

TwilightOverlordBoss_PillarSlam_3.text: The Saviour is precious. He is all that matters. Your time is shorter than you think.

TwilightOverlordBoss_PillarSlam_4.text: The Saviour is precious. He is all that matters. Your time is shorter than you think.

TwilightOverlordBoss_PillarSlam_5.text: Utopia awaits, whether you like it or not. Behold! The Beginning of Tomorrow!

TwilightOverlordBoss_PillarSlam_6.text: Utopia awaits, whether you like it or not. Behold! The Beginning of Tomorrow!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_Random.text: Behold the power of truth! ... Bask in its glory.

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_2.text: Behold the power of truth! ... Bask in its glory.

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_3.text: You will fall in line... or be unmade!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_4.text: You will fall in line... or be unmade!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_5.text: The Saviour is pure... you are vile!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_6.text: The Saviour is pure... you are vile!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_7.text: Storming vigilance... beholden to His will!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_8.text: Storming vigilance... beholden to His will!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_9.text: The unmaking is nigh... a shame you will not see it!

TwilightOverlordBoss_RockStorm_10.text: The unmaking is nigh... a shame you will not see it!

Lorandis_Wild_Church_One.text: Your timing is quite remarkable, you know!

Lorandis_Wild_Church_Two.text: Together, we can witness the birth of a new tomorrow. A better tomorrow.

Lorandis_Wild_Church_Three.text: Now, I must ask that you wait here a time. I shall fetch the First Herald! He will know how to aid you.

Lorandis_Wild_Church_Four.text: I am sure he will be delighted to meet you.

Lorandis_Wild_AmbushSpeech_Random.text: Friend! Give us the pieces. Come now... think this through. We promise you more! Accept Utopia! Embrace the saviour! Pledge now. It is not too late for you. Beauty awaits us all. Search your heart. You know that there is hope for you. You will not be harmed!

Lorandis_Wild_AmbushSpeech_2.text: Friend! Give us the pieces. Come now... think this through. We promise you more! Accept Utopia! Embrace the saviour! Pledge now. It is not too late for you. Beauty awaits us all. Search your heart. You know that there is hope for you. You will not be harmed!

Lorandis_Wild_AmbushDefeated.text: What!? No! Stay back! Saviour... help me!

Lorandis_Wild_Death.text: Why did it come to this? We were trying to... save you...

TwilightOverlordBoss_Death.text: My lady... you must take your leave! I will bury these fools... I will bury it all! For the Saviourrr!

TwilightOverlordBoss_Knockdown_Random.text: Ah! ... Utopia cannot be stopped. You don't stand a chance!

TwilightOverlordBoss_Knockdown_2.text: Ah! ... Utopia cannot be stopped. You don't stand a chance!

TwilightOverlordBoss_XBlast_Random.text: Divinity holds you in its lie... Let go! Be free!

TwilightOverlordBoss_XBlast_2.text: Divinity holds you in its lie... Let go! Be free!

TwilightOverlordBoss_XBlast_5.text: The gods don't care...So why should you? Give in!

TwilightOverlordBoss_XBlast_6.text: Tomorrow is at hand. Let the gods die!

TwilightOverlordBoss_XBlast_7.text: Tomorrow is at hand. Let the gods die!

TwilightOverlord_Church_One.text: Ahh... the meddler. In the flesh.

TwilightOverlord_Church_Two.text: We have been made well aware of your... activities.

TwilightOverlord_Church_Three.text: You will hand over what you have found.

TwilightOverlord_Church_Four.text: Let her go, it matters not.

CountessA4_OverlordFight_Start.text: You really are becoming quite a nuisance...

CountessA4_OverlordFight_PreEmerge.text: My life's work is about to be finished. The Twilight Order will see to it that the world is remade. A world without gods... without suffering... without the disease of Divinity. You and your shade cannot stop us. First Herald... deal with them.

Kanu_Wild_DigsitePlead.text: Please, please, please! Take me with you, please!

Kanu_Wild_PleadOnBeast.text: Agh! Wait... wait, wait, I know where they're keeping the Beast! Oriath! They're in Oriath - please, forgive me Makoru!

Tavakai_Wild_ReforgeWeapon.text: Now... reforge this Weapon, so we can be done with this place.

Makoru_Wild_MuralsTalk.text: These murals... They appear to depict the Weapon... and the Beast... Who made these?

Tavakai_Wild_MuralsTalk.text: The ones that came before... older than the oldest stories...

Tavakai_Wild_HoldsSpear.text: Behold! The might of the Karui!

Tavakai_Wild_KaruiWillBeStrong.text: Taking what is rightfully ours. The Karui will now be stronger than ever before!

Makoru_Wild_Fool.text: You fool! They need the Weapon! The world is at stake!

Tavakai_Wild_PickUpDaughter.text: I will fix this... The Karui way!

Tavakai_Wild_ApproachAfterTangmazu_Gener.text: Ahh...  this must be the foolish <i>{pakarui}! Get over here.

Tavakai_Wild_ApproachAfterTangmazu_Warri.text: You are the one who did this? I expected more of you, <i>{kurimo.} Get over here.

Tavakai_Wild_ApproachAfterTangmazu_Marau.text: <i>{Ngakuramakoi...} What were you thinking? Get over here.

Tavakai_Wild_ApproachAfterTangmazuMet_Ge.text: Outsider! I would have <i>{words} with you!

Tavakai_Wild_ApproachAfterTangmazuMet_Ka.text: Come! I would have <i>{words} with you!

Tavakai_Banter_ReturningHome_A1.text: So, Makoru... have you considered returning home? You'd still be welcomed back, you know.

Makoru_Banter_ReturningHome_A2.text: If the tribe can't accept a new way of thinking, then I best remain here.

Tavakai_Banter_ReturningHome_B1.text: Hmm... Kanu and his lot have twisted your mind...

Kanu_Banter_ReturningHome_B2.text: Makoru is no weakling. I couldn't <i>{twist her mind} even if I tried. You know that.

Kanu_Banter_BigFish_A1.text: So Chieftain, how's the fishing out there lately?

Tavakai_Banter_BigFish_A2.text: Don't try and butter me up by talking about fishing, boy. Anyway, you'd know if you were where you <i>{ought} to be.

Kanu_Banter_BigFish_B1.text: You are one of the best fishermen I've seen! Come on... any big ones?

Tavakai_Banter_BigFish_B2.text: Well... the other day I did manage to land a <i>{rapurana}. This thing was about twice the size of your cousin.

Kanu_Banter_BigFish_C1.text: Twice the size of Fat Kono?

Tavakai_Banter_BigFish_D2.text: Hah! You know, I'd like to see you back on one of our fishing vessels someday. The flow of Tasalio still lives in you. Your tribe was made to fish the seas.

Kanu_Banter_BigFish_E1.text: I have my own flow these days. That's my 'Way'.

Tujen_Banter_SecondPieceFound_A1.text: Hail, Chieftain. Good to see ya.

Tavakai_Banter_SecondPieceFound_A2.text: Mmm. I'm not here for small talk, Kalguuran.

Makoru_Banter_SecondPieceFound_B3.text: Hahaha! Oh, how grown men can be such fools.

Tavakai_Banter_Honor_A1.text: You know, Makoru... you may not understand me. You may not understand our Way. But all that I do is in honour of our people. In honour of you. In honour of all Karui.

Makoru_Banter_Honor_A2.text: How grown men can be such fools!

Makoru_Banter_Honor_A2_2.text: Oh, I understand that you think you are doing the right thing.

Makoru_Banter_Honor_A2_3.text: But all you're really doing is closing the Karui off from the world.

Makoru_Banter_Honor_A2_4.text: And the world will continue to change. The Karui have to as well.

Tavakai_Banter_Honor_B1.text: That is <i>{fear} talking! Not wisdom! Some things never change. Some things are constant. Is the tide any weaker because you can predict it? You know better than that.

Makoru_Banter_Honor_B2.text: Either way... we both want what is best for the Karui.

Makoru_Banter_Honor_B2_2.text: We just don't see eye to eye on what that is.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalkInterruption_11.text: Alright. I'll just talk to myself.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_IsleOfKin.text: Be wary here. The Kinfolk are a bit crazed lately... They used to be nothing more than a nuisance. But now that volcano rumbles like it's hungry, and you can see them carting sulphite down there non-stop. The mountain must be alive... and oh boy, it's got an appetite.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_JourneysEnd.text: We shouldn't be here. This place hates us. Can't you feel it?! I keep seeing angry faces in the fog...

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_Whakapanu.text: This island looks nice... beautiful even. But they say anyone who settles here goes missing. The thing is, I spent a week on this beach a couple summers ago. I didn't see a damn thing. I did drink pretty heavily though. Nah. Rumours and tales. You'll be fine!

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_EyeOfHinekora.text: Oh... I'm in awe. My family has come here to speak to our ancestors on occasion... but I've never been. Feels strange to think I'll end up here one day. Well... that's assuming they let me in... heh.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_AbandonedPrison.text: In the Kingsmarch tavern, sailors whisper about clanking and roaring coming from that prison. Though it was abandoned long ago, it seems there are still folks kicking around in there. I don't know much more about this place. No one does. Watch your back.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_ShrikeIsland.text: I left Ngakanu before I was even old enough to run the Isle of Shrikes. Because of that, in the eyes of the Karui, I'm not a man. I didn't pass the test. It's a ridiculous tradition... and I know a few ladies who can vouch for my manhood...

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_Arastas.text: They're nice here. They'll feed you and give you a bed for the night. And there's always a listening ear. Taken them up on it a couple times myself, when I had nowhere else to go.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_Ngakanu.text: They're polite to me here, but I can tell they consider me an outsider now. It shouldn't be like this... Maybe one day, things will be different. Just probably not while Tavakai leads the tribe.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_TreasureIsland.text: I used to dream about exploring. Finding buried treasure. Still do! But, uh, I'll wait in the boat for this one.

Kanu_Wild_IslandTalk_PirateIsland.text: The Brinerot are rough buggers. Heard some stories from the crew about what they get up to. Hard to believe pirates are still out and about, causing mayhem, pillaging the sea. I won't bat an eye for whatever you put them through. It's probably deserved.

Matiki_Wild_Krutog_Callout.text: You there! Save me from this bloody brute, will you?!

Kaimana_Wild_HealedApproachBloodFever.text: Ahh, ah please! You must aid us, yes?

YamaBoss_HeavyStun_Random.text: Ooof! ... Hahahaha! Now I get you!

YamaBoss_HeavyStun_2.text: Ooof! ... Hahahaha! Now I get you!

YamaBoss_HeavyStun_3.text: Ooof! ... Hahahaha! Yama know you now!

YamaBoss_TimeFreeze_2.text: Catch yourself, if you can! Haha!

YamaBoss_TimeFreeze_Random.text: Catch yourself, if you can! Haha!

YamaBoss_TimeFreeze_3.text: Time, it bends! And you snap!

YamaBoss_TimeFreeze_4.text: Time, it bends! And you snap!

YamaBoss_TimeFreeze_5.text: Which is one real? Yama forget! Haha!

SinA4_Wild_FirstPiecePortalIn.text: You have found the first piece. Well done. I shall keep it safe.

SinA4_Wild_FirstPieceAfterConvo.text: Now, we must find the others. Make haste.

SinA4_Wild_ThirdPieceAfterConvo.text: This is the final piece. We have succeeded. Let us meet back in Kingsmarch to plan our next move.

SinA4_Wild_AtPrecursorForge_Three.text: This will take most of my strength...

SinA4_Wild_AfterTavakaiFight_Two.text: I believe so... But we have to move quickly. You must relinquish the Weapon.

NavaliA4_Wild_ApproachFinalRoom.text: Hinekora has seen you. But now... one final challenge.

NavaliA4_Wild_DefeatYamaGV.text: It is done! The guest is worthy to meet the Mother of Death!

YamaBoss_CombatEmerge_1.text: A challenger! Haha! Old Yama see if worthy of Hinekora! Haha! Come!

YamaBoss_CombatDefeat_1.text: Ahhh! Okay, okay. Yama sees you. You are worthy.

DannigA4_OpenShop_5.text: What can I do for you?

DannigA4_OpenShop_6.text: What can I do for you?

DannigA4_BuyArmour_11.text: There's more where that came from.

DannigA4_Sell_Random.text: I'll melt it down, find a use.

DannigA4_Sell_2.text: I'll melt it down, find a use.

DannigA4_Sell_3.text: I'll melt it down, find a use.

DannigA4_Sell_4.text: I think I know someone who needs this.

DannigA4_Sell_6.text: I think I know someone who needs this.

DannigA4_Buyback_Random.text: Fairer winds are blowing, are they?

DannigA4_Buyback_2.text: Fairer winds are blowing, are they?

DannigA4_Buyback_3.text: Fairer winds are blowing, are they?

Give it time, my sweethearts, give it time...

Your master,
Niko

Azmadi_Glyph_AzmadisAmbition.text:
Too long have the Faridun bent beneath the Maraketh boot heel. We were penned to the desert's edge, called lesser, denied even the right to exist. Every revolt broke upon the same stone - no 'legitimacy,' no voice the <italic>{akharas} would heed.

So I made a new covenant. Zarokh, keeper of the ages, showed me the path through the Trial of the <italic>{Sekhemas} - and lent me the strength to walk it. I passed. The first Faridun in history. In that moment, the lie of our illegitimacy died.

When I take the mantle of <italic>{Sekhema} of <italic>{Sekhemas}, every <italic>{akhara} will be bound by oath and custom to obey me. Not just the Maraketh, not just the Faridun - <italic>{all} of the Vastiri. They will not dare question my rule. And with Zarokh's gift, I will unite this land beneath my banner... for all time.

WardenGlyph.text:
Our mistake was holding on to hope. Even after the sky turned crimson and the sea raged, even after we cowered inside these walls and rode out the chaos, we believed the Empire would come...

Not for the prisoners! But for us. 

We kept them all caged for weeks, as our supplies dwindled. The fish we caught were rotting and dead, yet... still moving. The rain was slick like grease, and men who touched it began to burn from the inside out, as if an unseen flame had caught within them.

No ship from the Empire came. No ships passed at all. The prisoners were growing more and more restless, and were certain to become violent. We told them nothing, but they'd felt it...

So... we began to feed them.

We cut chunks of meat... they kept growing back... so we cut some more... and that quelled the prisoners. They had no idea what we'd done.

When they learn what they've been eating... gods help us...

KaomTotemGlyph.text:
Ngamahu is the mother of Fire.
She lends it to us in life, but here, in death, we return it to Hinekora.
We exist now to give our wisdom to our descendants, until we are all returned to the volcano.
When the world is forged anew, a new line of Karui will emerge, to conquer a savage world.
Until then, we linger here, in the Halls of the Dead.

MaataTotemGlyph.text:
Tawhoa is the Son of the Forest, and its Father.
His alone is the perspective of the ages, of centuries of life, growth, death, and decay.
Inner peace can only be attained by accepting that life and death are inevitable.
This is something you will learn as the ages pass here, in the Halls of the Dead.

RakiataTotemGlyph.text:
Tasalio is the Father of Water, but he does not require you to believe.
He is the essence of the moment, of flowing from one second into the next.
Be who you are. Be what you are. Be nothing other than this, and you will know peace.
You will be here until the End of Time, but that is no wait at all if you exist only in this moment.
In this Way, this Flow, you will find it pleasant here, in the Halls of the Dead.

AkoyaGlyph.text:
The <i>{Ngakuramakoi} are those who truly embody our culture. If you wish to become one of us, you do not have to be Karui by blood.

But you must follow the Way. Pass your test, at the Isle of Shrikes, or elsewhere. Live by our traditions. Live through strength. But most of all, do not let the Way shift or falter.

Stand strong when others would seek to dominate or subvert you.

This is how we will survive as a people.

JadoGlyph.text: I will follow my orders to the letter. Do not doubt my loyalty. Deception is our life. Yet, I still believe Kulemak's forces will not attempt to steal back his divine spark during the current crisis... it would do nothing for them if the Beast is successfully regrown. We should be more honest with our allies if we are to earn their trust long-term.

AzmadiGlyph.text:
Too long have the Faridun bent beneath the Maraketh bootheel. We were penned to the desert's edge, called lesser, denied even the right to exist. Every revolt broke upon the same stone - no 'legitimacy,' no voice the <i>{akharas} would heed.

So I made a new covenant. Zarokh, keeper of the ages, showed me the path through the Trial of the Sekhemas - and lent me the strength to walk it. I passed. The first Faridun in history. In that moment, the lie of our illegitimacy died.

When I take the mantle of <i>{Sekhema} of <i>{Sekhemas}, every <i>{akhara} will be bound by oath and custom to obey me. Not just the Maraketh, not just the Faridun - all of the Vastiri. They will not dare question my rule. And with Zarokh's gift, I will unite this land beneath my banner... for all time.

Azmadi, the Faridun Prince

BlackwoodGlyph.text:
Rot before us in eternal autumn...
Beltimber bark.

Wilt to ruin by word and curse...
Of the everdark.

Catch their screams and hold them close...
Then still their eyes.

Deliver them to us by the morn...
So the Wendigo may drink them dry.

Against the dead of night...
The Blackwood coils forth and craves.

Now you, worthy fellspring...
Follow the Unlight, all your days.

EstateGlyph_01.text:
My dearest Elswyth,

His Voice grows clearer by the day. I can feel his presence. He thirsts so deeply for this world. I know that we shall be rewarded beyond measure upon his arrival.

I am so proud. The night we committed to Him is still vivid in my mind. You gave so much, so willingly. On the cusp between he and I, you fell to and fro. Your flesh pale white against the moon.

I am eternally yours. As we are His.
Your Wulfric

EstateGlyph_02.text:
My valiant Wulfric,

You drive me forward. You give me purpose. I am but dust without you... and Him.
But we must have more.

My skin grows tired. My heart grows heavy. My brow wrinkles and my bosom betrays me. I must have what was promised. I must have his desire!

Oswin will prepare the Scarlet Bathing. In a fountain of fatality, the lifeblood of youth shall make me whole. There you and your hound must take your renewed Pale Bride, as to please the watching Master.

I cannot wait.

Yours,
Elswyth

FarmlandsGlyph.text:
By the order of the Red Thane,

They still resist our new master's message. Hunger does wonders for a man's faith. Raze their fields. Kill their cattle. Crush their resistance, but keep them alive. We need worship, not corpses.

Bring them to Wolvenhold. Oswin will take care of the rest. Tarry not. The Wendigo watches from the shadows. If we dally, it will know.

HoltenGlyph.text:
By the order of the Red Thane,

Mark the walls. Mark their doors. Mark their fate!
The Wendigo beckons. We must rise to the occasion! 
Those that deny his Voice must pay with blood.
Use it to rouse the sign of the heretical! Brandish it!
Once marked, Oswin will have them. And so shall we.

Lend your ear to the Voice. Drink your fill of that sweet embrace. Give yourself to the eternal night.

WolvenHoldGlyph.text:
Dear Oswin,

The Red Thane and I are thrilled with your attention to detail. The Scarlet Bathing was an exquisite moment that we shall not soon forget. That you were able to acquire so many heretical younglings in such a short time... well, we cannot thank you enough.

The whispers grow deeper. He sees us. He sees you. We shall know unfathomable prosperity by his grace! 

The Red Thane, the Pale Bride, and their loyal hound. A hound most faithful. A hound most strong.

I must away, for tonight I shall dance once more. Join us to feast. Look upon me as you will. 

Elswyth

KriarGlyph_01.text:
Dear mountain-born of Kriar,

Another solstice is upon us. We shall be joined at the week's end by the fine hunters of Draelyn for a feast most spectacular. Ready the meat and the mead. Bring your most splendid of songs. We shall dance and sing, merry, into the longest night..

Spirit guide you always,
Elder Crovan Madox

KriarGlyph_02.text:
The solstice draws near, but the owls bring me worrisome tidings. They speak of erratic behaviour, of whispers in the night. The Spear of Draelyn has been attacking animals for cruel sport, rather than as a necessary hunt. Her tribe push and rough each other, raging at random, only to grow eerily calm moments later.

It is perhaps not concerning enough to cancel our coming celebrations, but we should be wary, and have our hunters remain vigilant. 

I doubt Lythara and her tribe would dare behave like that in our presence...

RavineGlyph.text:
Etched into the mountain Kriar for the glory of the Vaal

Two hundred gave their lives in service to the Queen

Many more would have died if not for Jiquani's constructs

All this, for the glory of Atziri

Uromoti, Architect of Expansion

VaultGlyph_01.text:
We have one task, and one task alone: to survive with our dignity in-tact. It is the dignity of the Vaal, of all those who came before. We were born in this Vault, and we will die in this Vault. We are not allowed the freedoms we read of; the freedoms we dream of. We cannot couple for love, or have children as we choose. We cannot choose our roles. We cannot wander an open world as we see fit.

We must accept that our Now is not At Long Last, and we must bring stillness to the dream. As your new High Priest, alongside my sister, I will endeavour to bring calm to your minds, to bring numbness to the pains in our hearts. That is the greatest calling our Now has to offer.

VaultGlyph_02.text:
One day soon, the Vaal will spread from this place like wildfire. The decline in detected Corruption that began twenty years ago continues at pace; soon, we will reach the threshold left for us by our great forebears.

Ready yourselves! Zolin and I have long served you, crafting the blood euphorics and eradicating pain. 
No longer! We must be sharp-eyed and sharp-minded. After countless years, our Now is about to become At Long Last! We will be remembered as the heroes that went forth and repopulated. You may now couple and bear children as you wish. The carnal pleasures are ours once more! The Limit is lifted! The new Vaal empire begins here, Now, with us!

TavakaiBloodFeverGlyph.text:
Let slip the chains of mercy! The era of the Mighty has begun!

Let each man and woman fight to be their own Chieftain, to battle for supremacy, until only one remains.

The True Ngakuramakoi will be the last to stand, and their body will become the new world. Their blood will spring forth the new Karui that will inherit Wraeclast! 

The End of Time has come!

ShrikeIslandGlyph.text:
You are not yet a warrior, but soon, you will be!

Climb these cliffs, and collect one Shrike egg. If you feel you cannot go on, turn back. You can always try again next season. 

We seek to build wisdom and strength, not to destroy you. A corpse does your Tribe no good.

No matter what you choose to do, return with a grand tale of what you faced.

Tavakai, Chieftain of the Tukohama Tribe

HowlingCavesGlyph.text:
My devotion. My lifetime of service. Has it really come to this? We cut our way through this remote mountain like cowardly dogs, hiding our treason from our own ruler.

To merely think such a project would mean death, since it implies we doubt her leadership. I hesitate to imagine what she will do to us—to my children—if she finds out we actually built it.

There is only one way to ensure my children live on. I must send them into the vault without me. I will finish this task, then return to Atzoatl to play my part. I was ever the good servant.

Here, then, is my last accomplishment, after the Vault: this simple carving, left for history, left for any who might survive. The Queen is mad, and I hope she finds the immortality she seeks.

May Yaomac deny her death's journey, so that we may finally be free of her!

A5FaustusGlyph.text:
[NOAUDIO] They're closing in... I must apologise for my prickliness. Though it may not seem like it, you've become something of a daughter to me. I've tried to keep you at arm's length from this, but I fear now that I may not get out of this alive, and someone must know. It's a conspiracy. It always has been.

Look to my limericks. They're not the bawdy distractions I claimed them to be. That bastard sees everything, hears everything. There's a shape to what they've done; a plan in motion.

DeliriumEndgameIntroduction.text: [DNT] Hello exile. I have found a renewed purpose in this world. While observing winter in Kriar Peaks, I could sense it, feel it. It is here and closer than you might think. It? I should say, he; he is closer than you may think. Who you may ask? Tangmazu, a dark and dangerous force that must be banished from this world. Go exile. Seek out Tangmazu and banish him before it is too late!

DeliriumEndgameDeliriousMapsCompleted.text: [DNT] Hello again exile. A nearby area has been found that seems to be cursed by the Raven. Quickly, go investigate what is going on there and report back to me once you've learned more.

Architect_Glyph_1.text:
Once again, Doryani and I argued over the consequences of the Red Communion. I suspect him. I believe he is moving against the Queen. I would inform her and have him tortured... but the other Architects would not support me in this. I will wait until I have proof.

Perhaps his intellect will triumph over his emotions. We have all worked our entire lives to make this possible. The greatest minds humanity has ever known carried us this far, and they will carry us forward. 

The Vaal Empire will not fall. Atziri will ascend, and transfigure life as we know it. This much is certain.

Architect_Glyph_2.text:
Over and over... I pore over my designs constantly... I know Doryani, or his proxies, will try to stop Atziri's Ascension. Fools! I've calculated every result, every possible nuance... my perfect mechanism is not one design. It is a living machine, a temple construct, that can modify its internal structure to change and adapt. 

History will show... I am the greatest genius of the Vaal, not you, old friend...

Architect_Glyph_3.text:
Our gods abandoned us long ago. Now, we live in a forsaken time... in a world gone mad.

Atziri is a capricious Queen, prone to using her power to randomly punish or reward those who dare come to her attention. I once said this to her face, when I could no longer contain myself. After the words escaped me, I expected torture and... a deserved death.
But to my surprise, instead, she laughed darkly, and named me her personal Architect... it was then that she knew... I was hers.

What better goddess could we ask for? This is the purpose of a divine leader, to serve as a symbol of fear and adulation. Will she lift you up for your adoration? Or cast you down for your insolence? That uncertainty is the source of her power.

She will shape our future around her. She is the hope of our people to stand against the ravages of time! The Empire will live on forever, a monolith, held strong as stone by the terror in our hearts!

Ailith_MonasteryFirstInteract_C1a_DexInt.text: You mustn't underestimate your fellow Keepers of the Flame, or yourself. You know our unique advantage.

Ailith_FirstGroundHive_A2wild_DexInt4b.text: Now... you must embrace the Dreamer's will.

Ailith_FirstEshTulHive_A2wild.text: Deal with the Lords! I will hold back the Hiveborn!

Ailith_Banter_UnrelentingWar_A1.text: [NOAUDIO] I'm here to report on the frontline effort, Ailith.

Ailith_Banter_UnrelentingWar_B1.text: [NOAUDIO] The enemy... their number grows. We fled. We lost... many.

Ailith_Banter_UnrelentingWar_C2.text: Then you've done well. But you must continue. Rally your Keepers. Return to the battlefield.

Ailith_Banter_FaceOfEnemy_A1.text: [NOAUDIO] I've another report from the frontline effort, Ailith.

Ailith_Banter_FaceOfEnemy_B1.text: [NOAUDIO] I... saw into the eyes of the enemy. Within, beyond the rage... I saw their Twisted Domain. Their Broken Sun. How is it possible?

Ailith_Banter_FaceOfEnemy_B2.text: They are controlled by a powerful mind. You saw what that mind wanted you to see.

Ailith_Banter_FaceOfEnemy_C1.text: [NOAUDIO] I... was overtaken by another... while awake? Am I cursed? Befouled?

Ailith_Banter_FaceOfEnemy_C2.text: Do not despair. Await the Dreamer's instruction.

Ailith_Banter_MalfunctioningClones_B1.text: [NOAUDIO] We've reports of Keepers behaving... strangely. As the enemy's breaches open to our world, there are some in our ranks that become... stricken.

Ailith_Banter_MalfunctioningClones_C1.text: [NOAUDIO] No. They writhe and contort where they stand. As if their mind is taken elsewhere, as their body suffers.

Ailith_Banter_MalfunctioningClones_C2.text: [NOAUDIO] Then... they either break free of it, or the unlucky are killed by the Hiveborn.

Ailith_Banter_MalfunctioningClones_C3.text: I understand... this must have been troubling to see. How many have witnessed this?

Ailith_Banter_MalfunctioningClones_D2.text: They are to report to me as soon as they can. This is not to be spoken of any further. The Dreamer will guide us.

Ailith_Banter_Overshare_A1.text: Your unique bond with the Dreamer is a true blessing.

Ailith_Banter_Overshare_A2.text: I do not take it for granted.

Ailith_Banter_Overshare_B1.text: After the first left... I didn't imagine he'd remake you so quickly.

Ailith_Banter_Overshare_C1.text: I... misspoke. It is not important.

Ailith_Banter_Overshare_C2.text: You should get some rest, perhaps.

Chayula_Speaker_XophTeaching_One.text: The Cruel Lord loved fire, and he commanded his people to fuel the flames.

Chayula_Speaker_XophTeaching_Two.text: They stripped the forests bare. He demanded more. They tore down their own homes. Still, he demanded <i>{more}.

Chayula_Speaker_XophTeaching_Three.text: They brought their own crops, feeding it to the Pyre instead of their children. Even then, the Cruel Lord demanded... <i>{more}.

Chayula_Speaker_XophTeaching_Four.text: All they had left to give was their bodies, screaming and singing, and the flesh, and the blood burned crimson.

KeepersCongregation_XophTeaching_Respons.text: [NOAUDIO] Xoph, the Cruel. He that Burns.

Chayula_Speaker_EshTeaching_One.text: The Callous Lord loved to study and learn.

Chayula_Speaker_EshTeaching_Two.text: Her people were relieved, for here was a vice soft and kind... but she commanded her people to bring her knowledge.

Chayula_Speaker_EshTeaching_Three.text: Every book, every story, but she wanted more. They tore apart the world to feed her hunger.

Chayula_Speaker_EshTeaching_Four.text: They broke every stone into the smallest pebble, simply to know what was inside. Still, she demanded more.

Chayula_Speaker_EshTeaching_Five.text: All they had left to give was their minds, and their memories spilled grey upon crystal and metal.

KeepersCongregation_EshTeaching_Response.text: [NOAUDIO] Esh, the Callous. She that Lies.

Chayula_Speaker_TulTeaching_One.text: The Caring Lord loved to protect her people.

Chayula_Speaker_TulTeaching_Two.text: They rejoiced, thinking themselves free from the plight of the others... but she commanded them to move carefully. Avoid danger.

Chayula_Speaker_TulTeaching_Three.text: No scythes to harvest the crops... no knives to cut food. No leaving home to get water. She provided all, bringing them into her keep...

Chayula_Speaker_TulTeaching_Four.text: But even the slow aging of flesh obsessed her. To satiate her, they reposed in absolute safety and stillness, giving up their very wills.

KeepersCongregation_TulTeaching_Response.text: [NOAUDIO] Tul, the Caring. She that Silences.

Chayula_Speaker_UulNetolTeaching_One.text: The Crushing Lord loved to grow and cultivate.

Chayula_Speaker_UulNetolTeaching_Two.text: She fed them well, and her people became a multitude, but they did not spread.

Chayula_Speaker_UulNetolTeaching_Three.text: She commanded them to stay. She drew them in, calling them her children, and pressed them to her mountainous body.

Chayula_Speaker_UulNetolTeaching_Four.text: They could not breathe, could not scream, as she brought more and more of them closer and closer.

Chayula_Speaker_UulNetolTeaching_Five.text: To calm her wails, they let themselves be crushed, bones snapping, souls suffocating.

KeepersCongregation_UulNetolTeaching_Res.text: [NOAUDIO] Uul-Netol, the Crushing. She that Smothers.

Chayula_Speaker_VruunTeaching_One.text: The Dread Marshal loved to feast and copulate.

Chayula_Speaker_VruunTeaching_Two.text: He reported to no single Lord, obeying the many, worshipping the whole. He saw the horizon before him. A destiny he embraced.

Chayula_Speaker_VruunTeaching_Three.text: He despised those wanting. Hatred's seed grew within him, a seed that he spread across the vastness of the Lords domains.

Chayula_Speaker_VruunTeaching_Four.text: His progeny rose from mire, filth and depravity, becoming a staple brood for the Lords.

Chayula_Speaker_VruunTeaching_Five.text: None of his lineage knew him. And he did not care.

KeepersCongregation_VruunTeaching_Respon.text: [NOAUDIO] Vruun, the Dread Marshal. He that Rampaged.

I can't believe it... I've finally found it!

That lost temple... it's set in the cliffside overlooking the Chimeral Wetlands.   
When I entered, it wasn't the forgotten treasure trove I expected it to be. Someone... watches over the Temple.

His insults are still ringing in my ears after I fled... but no matter. At least I'm still alive. I just have to get back to the encampment and tell them what I've found. Sebastian and Gwendolyn won't believe this!

Tang_MazeRant_Huntress_Two.text: Adorable. You and I both know: the only time you'll hear the Spirit is when you're dead.

Tang_MazeRant_Huntress_Three.text: Oh! Now you show some... spirit. Hahaha!

Tang_MazeRant_Marauder_One.text: When you dream of the reunion of Kitava's followers, what is served at the feast?

Tang_MazeRant_Marauder_Two.text: And when you run out of meat, will you turn on each other? Eat flesh, as he would?

Tang_MazeRant_Marauder_Three.text: If your god of Endless Hunger were alive, he would lament your lack of imagination.

Tang_MazeRant_Merc_One.text: You expect me to believe that you're doing this out of the goodness of your heart?

Tang_MazeRant_Merc_Two.text: And you hope, if you do it, that someone out there... might care about you?

Tang_MazeRant_Merc_Three.text: You are pathetic. I enjoy a good facade, but yours is just pitiful.

Tang_MazeRant_Monk_One.text: Awfully far from the monastery, aren't we? Do you have nothing better to do?

Tang_MazeRant_Monk_Two.text: My hero! You are so benevolent. A real dream. With such good judgement!

Tang_MazeRant_Monk_Three.text: I know you are a fool. If I'd found you first, you'd be serving me instead.

Tang_MazeRant_Ranger_One.text: Did anyone ever tell you, you look just like your mother? I suppose not... You have no one else...

Tang_MazeRant_Ranger_Two.text: What will you do about it? You're all alone, little rat. And I have you in my sights.

Tang_MazeRant_Ranger_Three.text: No one does. Only the forest will know where you end up.

Tang_MazeRant_Shadow_One.text: You're quite the conundrum. How do you break a man who already hates himself?

Tang_MazeRant_Shadow_Two.text: Your sarcasm is a shield, and you wield it poorly.

Tang_MazeRant_Shadow_Three.text: But that knife's not meant for me, is it? Be careful now, the King can still hear you.

Tang_MazeRant_Sorc_One.text: When you look around at where you've ended up - tell me, was the sacrifice worth it?

Tang_MazeRant_Sorc_Two.text: You know that's not what I meant. I meant her.

Tang_MazeRant_Sorc_Three.text: Don't take your anger out on me. Oh, but your death would make a good story for her!

Tang_MazeRant_Templar_One.text: What would it take for you to lose faith? Your god abandoned the Templars long ago.

Tang_MazeRant_Templar_Two.text: And look what he has taken from you. You've lost your home, your life, your purpose.

Tang_MazeRant_Templar_Three.text: You blame the world, the Templars, even yourself. When will you admit your god is to blame?

Tang_MazeRant_Warrior_One.text: Not a true Ezomyte, not a true Karui... only a true coward, running from his problems.

Tang_MazeRant_Warrior_Two.text: Yes, that's right. Keep yelling at your reflection. That will fix everything!

Tang_MazeRant_Warrior_Three.text: A hypocrite and a halfwit. I'm surprised they let you roam free.

Tang_MazeRant_Witch_One.text: You think you can dominate this world, yet you're content to run errands for the elderly.

Tang_MazeRant_Witch_Two.text: Is that what you tell yourself, as time slips through your fingers?

Tang_MazeRant_Witch_Three.text: Oh, so charming. You must have so many friends!

Tang_Q_Six.text: And the ant celebrates conquering a leaf.

Tang_Q_Eleven.text: Ah, yes... this should be interesting.

Tang_Q_Twelve.text: Time to see the fruits of your labour.

Tang_SavageHit_5.text: Did you not see that coming?

Tang_Simu_DieAlone_Random.text: Oh, dear. I had hoped you'd last longer.

Tang_Simu_DieAlone_2.text: Oh, dear. I had hoped you'd last longer.

Tang_Simu_Revive_2.text: I do enjoy toying with my prey.

Tang_Simu_Revive_4.text: Next time, you won't be so lucky.

Tang_Simu_RoomOne.text: He did his best to defend Clearfell. One old fool against all the dangers you brought.

Tang_Simu_Room2.text: She lost everything. You asked for more. She wandered until she collapsed, and only dogs found her.

Tang_Simu_Room3.text: You promised him a home. He was strung up by cultists the moment he started building one.

Tang_Simu_Room4.text: No songs will be sung for you. You abandoned them. Her heart was broken before it was stabbed.

Tang_Simu_Room5_A.text: Because of your lies, he believed he could protect them. He couldn't even protect himself.

Tang_Simu_Room5_B.text: You left, selfishly seeking answers about your past. They all died, and you have no answers.

Tang_Simu_Room6.text: He was a fool to put his trust in you. His power wanes, and he shrivels to nothing.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Druid.text: You are weak. You ran away, thinking she was gone - but she was there, waiting for you, terrified until her last breath.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Duelist.text: All your glory, you owe to this man. He taught you everything. But when the time came to fight, you fled.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Huntress.text: You kept pushing boundaries, with no care for who would be punished. He was innocent. You left him to pay for your crimes.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Marauder.text: Strength is your only virtue. Without it, you are worthless. People will celebrate your death as they did your god's.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Merc.text: Your life has no substance beyond the coins in your pocket. There is no one in this world who will care when you die.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Monk.text: You think only of yourself. You never appreciated her. The closest thing someone like you could have to a friend... left to rot.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Ranger.text: No one will love you as much as she did. Yet you resent her? You are nothing without her. You don't deserve better.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Shadow.text: Was it easier to pretend your killing was just, when you didn't know the truth? It was never just, and you deserve to suffer.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Sorc.text: Did you think she would disappear if you stopped talking about her? She suffered and died without knowing your name.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Templar.text: What would Innocence think, if he knew you served his dark brother? You should be burned in his purifying flames.

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Warrior.text: He gave you everything. Raised you as his own. And you abandoned him the first chance you got. For what?

Tang_Simu_RoomFinal_Witch.text: You drive everyone away. You think you are above death. In the end, you will be alone, nothing but a useless corpse.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_Random.text: Brave of you to come alone. And stupid.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_2.text: Brave of you to come alone. And stupid.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_3.text: Unlike these poor souls, you will die alone.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_4.text: Unlike these poor souls, you will die alone.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_5.text: I'm starting to think you enjoy suffering.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_6.text: I'm starting to think you enjoy suffering.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_7.text: I'm starting to think you enjoy suffering.

Tang_SimuEnter_Alone_8.text: Welcome back. Did you miss me?

Tang_SimuEnter_Party_6.text: Hardly seems like a fair fight... for you.

Tang_SimuEnter_Party_7.text: Too scared to face me yourself?

Tang_Start_AllAchievements.text: An impressive feat! With enough time, you can really accomplish anything.

Tang_Start_ArbiterAshKill.text: I do so enjoy when you show me new things. An Arbiter of ancient power... now in the hands of another!

Tang_Start_ArbiterDivinityKill.text: There was an Arbiter of Divinity? And you killed it? Why would you do that? Are you trying to destroy the world?

Tang_Start_ChayulaKill_A.text: How many of your mentors are secretly villains? Have you checked Madox for extra hands?

Tang_Start_ChayulaKill_B.text: What a twist! Your Dreamer was a hiveborn. You don't seem very surprised. Did you already know?

Tang_Start_EshTulKill.text: The Depraved Lords were already marked for death. If anything, you've only aided their plans.

Tang_Start_KitMKill.text: You've felled the Nameless King. Or was he actually an unknowing pawn?

Tang_Start_OlrothKill.text: Olroth's hubris was more dangerous than anything on Wraeclast. He doomed all who followed him.

Tang_Start_SpiderBossKill.text: What a strange, horrid creature you've slain! Better check your Verisium for eggs.

Tang_Start_UhtredKill.text: Poor Uhtred. Labelled a traitor. Hated. Then forgotten. This world makes villains of us all.

Tang_Start_WendigoKill.text: Darkness can be contained, but not defeated. And the cage grows weaker every day.

Tang_Start_XeshtKill_A.text: You killed this "Xesht"? Quite a violent request from Ailith's "Benevolent Dreamer."

Tang_Start_XeshtKill_B.text: This "Xesht" is no more? Ailith will be pleased. If she remembers.

DoryaniEG_MechanismRoom_D3wild.text: I am unclear what the final mural depicts exactly... but it appears the Abyssals were indeed defeated.

DoryaniEG_MechanismRoom_G1.text: Hmm. The closer we get, the stronger the energies become.

DoryaniEG_MechanismRoom_G2.text: Reach the central tower. We must learn more.

DoryaniEG_MechanismRoom_H1wild.text: I will remain to study what we've found here. Be on your guard.

DoryaniEG_FirstCentralTower_C3wild.text: These locations must house what we seek... I am sure of it.

DoryaniEG_PostArbiterOfDivinity_A1wild.text: Arbiter! What is the First Edict?

DoryaniEG_FirstCorruptedNexus_H1.text: I believe I have located another of these Corruption outbreaks. You should seek it out when you can.

DoryaniEG_FirstCorruptedNexus_H2.text: The more examples we find, the more we can progress in our research.

DoryaniEG_SecondCorruptedNexus_E1.text: Here... another case of intense Corruption for us to handle.

DoryaniEG_SecondCorruptedNexus_E2.text: I feel I am close to upgrading the prototype to reach its optimal capability...

DoryaniEG_SecondCorruptedNexus_E3.text: Make your way there, let us see what we can learn.

DoryaniEG_ThirdCorruptedNexus_A1wild.text: Yes! This seems perfect for our needs...

DoryaniEG_ThirdCorruptedNexus_E2.text: Something is off. The energy from this location... it is immense. But it is not Corruption.

DoryaniEG_AfterTecrodSeq_C2wild.text: I will calibrate the Waygate to these resonances. Perhaps we can use this new power to our advantage...

DoryaniEG_AfterTecrodSeq_F2wild.text: Be calm. We're not dead yet.

DoryaniEG_AfterBurningMonolithIntrowild.text: I will remain here. I must... contemplate the nature of this... <i>{thing}...

VoranaGlyph_TheForge.text:
The scouting party's descriptions of this valley did not do it justice. Of all the curiosities we have encountered on this heinous continent, these "Titans" may be the most extraordinary. Gazing upon this wondrous place is a small reprieve from the evils surrounding us.

A third of my Black Scythes have been killed. Half of Olroth's Knights. We need more men to fight. Uhtred's disciples are <i>{useless.} It is unthinkable, but Medved's mystics must take arms.

I will forge twin axes, to remind him: our daughter and I are by his side. May Medved's blades raze this horrid land which forced him to fight.

MedvedGlyph_TrinketsOfGold.text:
We came to this forsaken land, chasing the red skies. Here, we are near the epicentre of that apocalypse. Opulent ruins filled with horrors. I took a necklace of gold from a twisted corpse, and it fought back with impossible strength. I cut it down, yet it still pursued me... 

What possible trinket is worth suffering these cursed lands to obtain? <i>{Cadigan knows no mercy.} Did he know what we would find here? 

I have stared deep within my scrying pool, searching for answers... None come.

MedvedGlyph_CrimsonClouds.text:
The runesmiths have tried everything to ward off the encroaching crimson that clouds my scrying pool. It may... be too late. I have not seen the future-past in days.

Some of my mystics refuse to look away from the pool. Their skin hangs from their bones. They do not move. They do not eat. They will not speak. Whatever they see... has consumed them. 

Our past is severed. Our future is nothing.

UhtredGlyph_Legacy.text:
The mirror has taken us far beyond where our maps reached. The stars show... we are farther north...  
But I cannot stay here. Survivors continue to find their way to that ancient temple. Olroth has not yet found it... and I must be there to stop him when he does.

The locals here are not ones we have met before. Communication will be difficult, but we must understand each other... somehow.

We will offer the locals our ultimate gift. If our people cannot survive this continent, our legacy will.

UhtredGlyph_StarlitSacrament.text:
The survivors built this sanctuary with haste. I've instructed my priests how to track Verisium in the celestial firmament. But... they are only initiates. Not a single one of my disciples escaped Vorana's vengeance.

Twelve initiates have agreed to perform the Rite and become disciples. I've given instructions, but I dare not warn them of what the Rite entails. I am unable to watch over them. I am needed through the mirror once more.

I hope to eventually return and see them alive... and fully starlit. But, if necessary, I will make certain that no one will <i>{ever} return through that mirror.

OlrothGlyph_CadiganTheWise.text:
Cadigan the Third is dead. Long live Cadigan the Fourth!

Puritanical imbeciles like Uhtred were placated by the late King's banning of the gems. Fools! Their deluded righteousness would condemn us all.

Though I only know the Fourth through his missives, his superior wisdom is evident. He understands that, to survive, we <i>{must} use these gems. We <i>{must} do whatever it takes to prosper!

While the new King has not decried his father's ban, his new orders to my Knights were clear: seek out all artefacts of power on this forsaken continent... and bring them home.

OlrothGlyph_TerribleFate.text:
My Knights and I have travelled great distances in pursuit of artefacts. Even here, there are colonies of Kalguuran settlers. This far from the Flame's starlight barrier, there are no survivors. 

I found a promising note in a settler's pockets. They'd overheard the island-men discussing an ancient artefact. 

I had my Knights gather some nearby island-men. They would not speak. We kept them for the night, hoping hunger would persuade their tongues.

In the morning, all their throats had been slit. My Knights claim they saw nothing, but their eyes shine with fear. We must move on, empty-handed.

Farrow_TomeVolume1.text: 'Volume One: The Runes of Aldur.' <continue>'Within the warm embrace of Aldur's teachings, he, the first Runefather, carved a future for Middengard, to liberate it from the biting frost.'

Farrow_TomeVolume2.text: 'Volume Two: The Fractured Middengard.' <continue>'After a prosperous reign, Aldur, the first King of Kalguur, joined the eternal hearth.' <continue>'Middengard quickly fractured, and her people fell into unruly despair and violence.' <continue>'To unite them anew, Aldur's Runefathers banded together to smith their greatest and most ambitious design.'

Farrow_TomeVolume3.text: 'Volume Three: The Triskelion.' <continue>'To repair their broken unity, the Runefathers forged the Triskelion Flame. A monumental achievement of exquisite craftsmanship.' <continue>'The Runefather's toured Middengard with their creation. It demanded hope. It whispered a promise. It healed the people's aching hearts left in the absence of Aldur.' <continue>'The Triskelion was returned to the capital, where the Runefathers kept it, as a bastion of harmony for all Middengard.'

Farrow_TomeVolume4.text: 'Volume Four: The Rise of Cadigan.' <continue>'The Runefathers' rule was challenged by a claimant heir of Aldur. On his first appeal, his words fell on deaf ears. On his second appeal, he bore weapons instead.' <continue>'Cadigan took his throne as the next true King of Kalguur, and promised glory to all.' <continue>'When red adorned the sky across the sea, fear gripped Middengard once more. Cadigan assembled his finest heroes, armed them with the Triskelion Flame, and sent them to those distant shores.' <continue>'"Redeem those lands! Expand our shores! Show every Kalguuran that our prosperity is unending!"' <continue>'And so we sail on to our unknown expedition, with adventure in our hearts and fear in our throats.'

Ailith_Glyph_DreamOne.text:
I walked alongside a hooded figure, picking our way along a high ridge. He pointed to the stinking valley below, where vast ribs pulsed with the beat of a mountainous heart. He asked me what I saw. 

I told him that I saw half of a body, of sorts. Exposed to the elements. Both terrifying, yet vulnerable. He nodded. 

The Mother births flesh, but flesh is weak. It can be burned. Seared away. She wants her children to remain one with her, but children must leave home to thrive. The Dreamer once knew her, before the nightmare she became, but that is only a memory of sorrow. She will try to take our flesh, he warned. We must not let her.

Ailith_Glyph_DreamTwo.text:
The Dreamer led me through a great furnace, where slaves shovelled coal into vast flues, their limbs melting, their eyes blind. He pointed to the charnel pits. He asked me what I saw. 

I told him that I saw hunger beyond any other. A need that could never be sated, that could only exist by consuming ever more. He nodded. 

The Red Pyre burns hot, but flames are ephemeral. They can be quenched. Doused. Flames can never endure, only spread. The Dreamer once knew him, before his addiction, but that is only a memory of regret. He will try to burn us, he warned. We must not let him.

Ailith_Glyph_DreamThree.text:
Voiceless whispers chattered like bone-dry teeth as the Dreamer led me through a vast labyrinth of metal veins and pulsing arteries. He pointed to the sky, the center, where a crystalline face spun, its eyes hollow, its stark jaw mouthing unheard rantings. He asked me what I saw. 

I hesitated. I thought I knew, but did not trust myself. In a world so filled with ghastly flesh, here, then, was a mind without it. He nodded. 

The Forked Psyche thinks without will, decides without desire. It drains all motion and life to voice thoughts that no one hears; to decipher truths without meaning. The Dreamer once knew her, before she relinquished her soul, but that is only a memory of despair. She will try to swallow our minds, he warned. We must not let her.

Ailith_Glyph_DreamFour.text:
Weakened from our long journey, the Dreamer sat beside a chilly hollow, one of many, laid out in vast lonely rows. He pointed down, at the being within, silent and still. He asked me what I saw. 

Quite fearful now, I took a moment to answer. The aura was unmistakable. This was a graveyard. For the first time, he shook his head.

The Preserved Patterns do not venerate the dead. They live still, eyes open, hands frozen while grasping for freedom from the icy will that holds them in thrall. The Dreamer once knew her, when her heart still held passion, but that is only a memory of loss. She will try to imprison our bodies, he warned. We must not let her.

Ailith_Glyph_DreamFive.text:
Weary now, the Dreamer bade me sit beside him. We had come full circle in my nights spent dreaming, and now sat outside our very own Monastery. He pointed out, at the world beyond, and asked me what I saw.

A verdant, beautiful, living world, I told him. Unspoiled. He nodded. 

The Four have become One, he warned. He tried to help them, tried to mitigate the agonies in their souls that drove them like whips at their backs, but they lashed out. Wounded him; cast him into the void. They had purpose before, but now, know only rage and hunger. Their patchwork existence tears at the seams, filling their thoughts with nothing but screams. They will be coming, he warned. We must not let them.

With that, he faltered, lay on the soil, and slept.

When I awoke, I was in that very same spot, and the Genesis Tree had sprouted its first branches, right where the Dreamer lay. It is his gift to us... our armoury against the Hiveborn. We will not fail him.

DavinBossHeadTrader_Gossip_Introduction.text:
Before we begin, some ground rules: <i>{I'm} allowed to make jokes about it. <i>{You}... are not. 
<continue>That means no 'mind your <i>{head}', no '<i>{heads} up'... no <i>{any} of that bottom-of-the-barrel shite. <continue>Last bloke who tried that ended up just as legless as I am.  <continue>You keep to all that, and we'll get along just fine. Now... let's make some coin, shall we?

DavinBossHeadTrader_Gossip_ThisIsTheLife.text: You might think me the result of some ritual-gone-wrong, but no, I chose this life – and what a life it is.  <continue>Got back pain? Not me. What about a gimpy leg? Ain't got that either.  <continue>Now, that's not to say I don't sometimes miss my body. But from where I'm standin' – yes, I said <i>{standin}' – the good outweighs the bad.  <continue>See, it used to be I had more competition. But when <i>{you} get to live on, long after your competitors turn to dust... well, it don't take a genius to figure out how that swings things in your favour.  <continue>Now if I could just find a way to scratch what needs scratchin', I'd be the happiest head in all o' Wraeclast.

DavinBossHeadTrader_Gossip_OnTheo.text:
Oh, him? He works for me – and me only. <continue><i>{You} don't control him. <i>{You} don't command him. As far as you're concerned, he's an extension o' me. 
<continue>Not my eyes and ears, but my...  <i>{hands and feet,} savvy? <continue>And before you get all bleedin' heart on me ... he wants to be here. Don't believe me? Ask him yourself. Go on. Ask him.  <continue>He won't answer, o' course. Hasn't said a word since he was... <i>{separated}... from his tongue a while back. <continue>But I have to assume that was what he wanted, or he wouldn't have talked back in the first place. <continue>Ain't that right, Theo...? <continue>See? Happy as anythin'.
