Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_Random.text: Open yourself, for the love of Innocence can warm even the darkest of hearts.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_2.text: The road less traveled is often the exact path we ought to take.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_3.text: As sight withers, the vibrance of life becomes clearer than ever before.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_4.text: Fate moves unseen... rather than control it, we must embrace it.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_5.text: His love is upon you, whether you accept him, is up to you.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_6.text: In his light, we can see more. We can see beyond. We can see eternity.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_7.text: A new love grows on your horizon.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_8.text: Failure is but a stepping stone on your way to success.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_9.text: There are times we must forgive, and times we must forget.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_10.text: Oriath is the one true holy land. It must thrive again once more.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_11.text: Remain steadfast in your faith. Even in utter darkness, he will find you.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_12.text: The trials we face only mean to show us another side of our wanting selves.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_13.text: Tomorrow is not promised. But today is yours to own.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_14.text: Step into the light. Bask in his glory. He is your beacon.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_15.text: Darkness grows like a weed. Root it out and cast it back to the void.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_16.text: Words can cut, it is true. But knives cut deeper. Resilience against those with sour tongues is your strongest ally.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_17.text: The light burns when we need it most. Stare deeply into His radiance.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_18.text: Art weaves his essence into reality. Covering us in a quilt of his abundant understanding.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_19.text: Embrace the unknown. Set out on an adventure. Dare to be more than you are today.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_20.text: The first Spring dawn offers a chance to become someone <i>{better}.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_21.text: The touch of a blade of grass, is sometimes all our soul truly needs.

Cecilia_ReceivingBlessing_22.text: Blessings be upon you, traveller. Go well, into the light of the Pure One.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_04_01.text: Man or beast - they die the same.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_05.text: This place reeks of desperation. Best be careful who I trust.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_10.text: The Grelwood feels darker somehow. It is no longer the home I once knew.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_11.text: Has the Tree not endured enough?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_12.text: I know this place. The crimson remnants of man's folly lay scattered here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_13.text: Perhaps this holds the runes I seek.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_14.text: That should hold the last piece.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_15_01.text: Rust away into nothing. Your war is long over.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_21.text: That man's mind seems as dead as this cemetery.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_24.text: May your name be forgotten by the clans, once and for all.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_27.text: I knew something wasn't right with him. I suppose... this was a mercy.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_28.text: Tools of the forge turned tools of war. These are dangerous times.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_29.text: A songbird makes for easy prey. She'd best watch her back.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_30.text: At least he's honest about being a liar.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_31.text: This looks sinister. Perhaps Finn will know more.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_35.text: What's this feeling? It's as though the trees themselves are watching me.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_36.text: That voice... why do I feel like I've heard it before?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_37.text: Stupid cultists... This ritual is an affront to Nature.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_39.text: These lands produce naught but disease, now. I pity the farmers and their families.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_40.text: Hmm... a waste of wood if you ask me. But the songbird seems attached to it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_41.text: I'll pass on the song - but that ought to get her off my back.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_42.text: So... the Mad Wolf's 'justice' now razes Ogham to the ground. This must end.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_43.text: That execution will be your last.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_45.text: The axe edge is dulled. Count Geonor's mongrel is no longer.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_46.text: It's a cowardly wolf that hides in his den...

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_48.text: Is there nothing safe from Corruption?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_52.text: The once proud Wolf of Ogham... now a rabid dog.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_53.text: The once proud Wolf of Ogham... now a rabid dog.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_01.text: Sand as far as the eye can see. Who would choose to live in such a place?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_02.text: Proving myself in the wilderness? Simple enough.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_06.text: I like to keep moving... but this is something else.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_07.text: It appears the Faridun have been busier than the Ardura expected.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_08.text: It seems people were still alive down here when the entrance was sealed...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_10.text: Something's wrong. Why have we stopped?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_11.text: Hmm... seems these doors were to remain closed.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_12.text: So this is where the 'traitor' resides.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_13.text: Caged for a thousand years... Must've been quite the betrayal.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_14.text: What crime is worthy of such punishment?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_15.text: So that's my reward for freeing you: a murder attempt and an old coin.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_17.text: I don't usually do requests... but then again...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_18.text: There's a faint scent on the air... The Beast is near...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_20.text: Corruption has driven them all insane.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_22.text: Look at him run. Bravery befitting a king...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_23.text: Jamanra thinks himself safe inside that sandstorm. We'll see about that...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_25.text: All these snake-women make me miss the Grelwood.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_26.text: Once a bustling city... now a sand-choked tomb.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_27.text: What have they done to you?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_28.text: Opulence and madness go hand in hand.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_31.text: I hear voices. Distant... but living.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_32.text: This woman's certainly seen better days...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_34.text: Not the most peaceful way to go... but her pain is ended.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_35.text: I've never seen such death. Bones, stacked on bones...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_37.text: You're free of his influence! Now yield!

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_38.text: If I ever see another necromancer, it'll be too soon.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_39.text: They won't be needing these anymore...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_40.text: I've never met a challenge I couldn't overcome.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_41.text: This valley is not natural. It's been carved...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_42.text: I get the feeling... that I am not welcome here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_43.text: Whoever chose this as their burial place thought highly of themselves...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_45.text: Strength is wasted on a brute such as you.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_47.text: One of these days, the gate will open on the first try.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_48.text: That's all three. Time to reconstruct the Horn.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_49.text: I'm not musically inclined. But if I must...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_52.text: I was never a fan of heights... Best not look down.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_53.text: What have you done with the Beast?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_54.text: They can keep resurrecting the dead... and I'll keep putting them back where they belong.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_62.text: It's done. He never stood a chance.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_63.text: It doesn't matter what you've done. Only what you're going to do about it.

Int4_A1_02.text: Impressive size but little acuity. Dismal.

Int4_A1_03.text: A descent into darkness. I wouldn't have it any other way.

Int4_A1_04.text: The raven always outsmarts the worm.

Int4_A1_05.text: The Grelwood has turned foul... I think I prefer it this way.

Int4_A1_06.text: Well, well... who is this that adorns the Tree of Souls?

Int4_A1_07.text: Blood, bones, and rust... Death in abundance.

Int4_A1_29.text: Perhaps this is what we need.

Int4_A1_09.text: Dark, dense, and twisted. A home away from home.

Int4_A1_10_01.text: Your dreary tale is over, old man.

Int4_A1_22.text: The old man was already gone. I just put him out of his misery.

Int4_A1_23.text: It's never easy watching your friends turn mad. I do know how it feels.

Int4_A1_11.text: Even the darkest corner is ablaze. How... festive.

Int4_A1_14.text: And so, who is the true master of death?

Int4_A1_15.text: Here I come, big bad wolf.

Int4_A1_16.text: He took my kill. I'll remember that.

Int4_A1_17.text: A kind leader... Hopefully he survives.

Int4_A1_26.text: I just found my path to power.

Int4_A1_25.text: This oozes darkness... I welcome it.

Int4_A1_31.text: The Tree must bend to my will now.

Int4_A1_32.text: Do as I command! Release this shade to my service!

Int4_Gameplay_A1_35.text: A sister, in the Grelwood? Curious.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_36.text: You tarried too long, dear sister.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_38.text: It's a pity to end you, monstrous weed.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_39.text: The roots here have a mind of their own. I'll need to convince them to part for me.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_41.text: You've some power, Ezomyte. You'd have made a worthy sister.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_42.text: This druid has seen better days.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_43.text: At least he died in a place he loved... or some such nonsense.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_44.text: How nice of them to put all their corpses in one place!

Int4_Gameplay_A1_45.text: I don't take orders from <i>{you...} but I do love cemetaries.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_47.text: Give it a rest... Your Empire is no more.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_48.text: I hate to put down a sister witch, but you had it coming.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_50.text: What powers might I learn from him, I wonder?

Int4_Gameplay_A1_51.text: The forbidden books don't mention anything like this altar. I should ask a local.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_103.text: You've been a bad bird, haven't you?

Int4_Gameplay_A1_54.text: Yes! Show me what you've got!

Int4_Gameplay_A1_55.text: Aww. We were just getting started.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_56.text: There's an immensely disturbing energy here. Time to seek it out.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_57.text: Don't whisper at me from the dark. <i>{I} <i>{am} the shadows.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_58.text: Ah! So this is where the darkness is hiding!

Int4_Gameplay_A1_59.text: The darkness is <i>{mine.} Never forget that.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_60.text: Ah, the girl's lute... But dear me... what a desperately boring home.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_61.text: Bring all you like. They'll serve me soon enough.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_63.text: I simply must have my own one of those some day.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_64.text: Hmm... He's even more insane than when we last met.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_66.text: Not if I take yours first!

Int4_A2_01.text: So... the Maraketh. Strong-minded women aplenty. I approve.

Int4_A2_02.text: Time to show them what I can do.

Int4_A2_03_01.text: Up there... the leader of the pack.

Int4_A2_05.text: So many corpses, so little time.

Int4_A2_07.text: I wonder if I'll come across this vile traitor... What a delight that would be.

Int4_A2_08.text: Creepers and crawlers in dark spaces... How wonderful.

Int4_A2_09.text: One day, they'll make a statue like this... of me.

Int4_A2_11.text: She made light work of that.

Int4_A2_12.text: I like how she decorated her camp... but I also like that she's dead.

Int4_A2_14.text: Time to check in with the Shade.

Int4_A2_15.text: The skeleton city of a once-great culture... How adorable.

Int4_A2_19.text: The once-verdant city is still mostly in-tact... but overwhelmed with sand. Pretty.

Int4_A2_22.text: Long-forgotten shrines... Show me your secrets.

Int4_A2_24.text: Hm. There's a being here that causes the very air to weep.

Int4_A2_28.text: A place of ritual and bone... I should retire here someday.

Int4_A2_31.text: Pit graves and necromancers. This place just gets better and better.

Int4_A2_32.text: Oh my... what a gorgeous rite! I'm ready!

Int4_A2_34.text: I suppose I am your better, necromancer.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_36.text: Seems the Faridun have been up to no good in the Hills of Mawdun...

Int4_Gameplay_A2_37.text: This lot were left down here to die... or worse.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_38.text: A defector... I admire those who resist tyrants.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_40.text: Someone wanted to these doors to remain shut... I should open them.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_42.text: Her spirit... in a coin? How fun!

Int4_Gameplay_A2_44.text: Let's see what you can do, Djinn.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_45.text: Traditions are meaningless drivel. But let's see what power is offered here.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_46.text: I have to admit, I'm somewhat enjoying all this.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_47.text: I accept the power of the <i>{Sekhemas}.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_48.text: Titans lived and died here. What fate wrought their demise?

Int4_Gameplay_A2_49.text: This was certainly off limits to mortals... How exciting.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_51.text: You're quite possibly my largest victim. Farewell.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_52.text: Oh. It's warm. And now, mine.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_53.text: I've all I need. Time to create this 'Horn.'

Int4_Gameplay_A2_54.text: So... now I have to blow this thing?

Int4_Gameplay_A2_56.text: So this is how they bury their dead? It's rather... elegant.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_61.text: One day... I'll bring you back to serve me.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_62.text: Off we go, it's time to kill!

Int4_Gameplay_A2_63.text: Yes, yes, <i>{Sekhema}. We all know you are very brave.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_65.text: That stench—our beautiful Beast is near.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_66.text: Done running, I see. But not done dying.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_68.text: First a Count... now a King... I'm quite the success.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_70.text: Get up, woman. We're done here.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_71.text: So... I think it's time you confess.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_72.text: I knew all along. For one vying for power, what better company to keep than a God?

Int4_A3_01.text: Rather colourful here... but deadly. I suppose it's alright.

Int4_A3_02.text: One of the Architect's workshops... A summoner of a different kind.

Int4_A3_04.text: I heard a soul escape that thing. A beautiful sound.

Int4_A3_08.text: Impressive. Perhaps I could learn a thing or two from this Jiquani.

Int4_A3_09.text: Ugh. I'd best talk to the optimist again.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_10.text: A swamp. Full of mosquitoes and ticks. Still... better than sand and heat.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_11.text: Your swamp fiends won't help you!

Int4_Gameplay_A3_13.text: Treasure hunters. Greedy scoundrels. I like it here.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_15.text: Knowledge is a form of power, I suppose.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_17.text: This jungle has flourished since the fall of the Vaal. Let it now know darkness.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_21.text: What an impressive beast. This jungle produces fine servants.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_22.text: Poison tongues slither through ancient graves... I love my work.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_24.text: The optimist may know something of this.

Int4b_A3_06.text: A traditional place... overrun by vagabonds. I disapprove.

Int4b_A3_07.text: This woman is curious. I wish to know more of her.

Int4b_A3_08.text: She knows how to part fools from their coin... Clever.

Int4b_A3_09.text: The mighty Vaal empire... Now just an overgrown jungle.

Int4b_A3_12.text: How does it lift that thing?

Int4b_A3_13.text: Ouch. You should've been more careful.

Int4b_A3_14.text: What is worse? Snakes... or scorpions?

Int4b_A3_16.text: This looks promising. I should ask Alva about this.

Int4b_A3_17.text: I've never seen such beauty... The Oases at home lacked such splendid colour.

Int4b_A3_19.text: The vaunted technology of the Vaal... and look where it got them. Dead and buried.

Int4b_A3_43.text: Hmm... I feel a murmur of power within them.

Int4b_A3_21.text: I wonder if Alva knows this place?

Int4b_A3_24.text: Another Soul Core. Now, where to use it?

Int4b_A3_25.text: They... are warm to the touch.

Int4b_A3_29.text: I'll need a larger Soul Core for this.

Int4b_A3_30.text: This is what I need. Back to the generator.

Int4b_A3_31.text: A larger Soul Core... Now where to place it?

Int4b_A3_32.text: I must admit... it is impressive this all still functions.

Int4b_A3_33.text: It appears... the place now teems with energy. I should be quick.

Int4b_A3_35.text: Alva, I should plunge you into a pit of scorpions for that!

Int4b_A3_36.text: Now... let me access these waterways.

Int4b_A3_37.text: So these are the Azak that Servi despises? I can understand why.

Int4b_A3_38.text: If the Vaal were so intelligent... why would they build something that could flood their main city?

Int4b_A3_40.text: Servi was right. The Azak must be dealt with.

Int4b_A3_42.text: May your spirit shriek for eternity, vile one.

Int_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: This is a far cry from the Vastiri Plains. I may lack the foresight of my dastanha, but I can see that these guards are poorly equipped for the struggles ahead.

Int_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: The truth is inescapable for those who face it without fear. This place is a little unnerving, though.

StrInt_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: The guards here are Templar – of that I have no doubt. They will not be amenable to reason.

StrInt_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: These halls have been untouched by sunlight since they were first built.

Str_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: I have survived far worse than this. By Hinekora, I swear I will seek vengeance upon my captors.

Str_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: All shall fear me. None shall survive.

StrDex_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: A distinct lack of card games in this derelict prison... And they deprived me of my coin-purse, too. I won't be able to bribe my way out of this one.

StrDex_4a_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: A grim place to be imprisoned.

Dex_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: This place falls under Templar rule... with fewer trees than I'd like.

Dex_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: This wouldn't be the first time an Azmeri has been enslaved. I'll escape this place, one way or another.

DexInt_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel1.text: A futile place to find refuge in.

Int_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Had I a virtue gem, I'd make short work of you.

StrInt_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Careful. The guards won't take kindly to chatter.

StrInt_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Without guidance from the First Ones, this will likely end in bloodshed...

Str_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: I will silence you if you keep talking.

StrDex_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Careful now, friend. With words that sharp, the guards might be inclined to pit us against each other...

StrDex_4a_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: A fine day for slaughter. You might even be next.

Dex_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: You know what Templars do to heretics, little boy? They silence them.

Dex_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Your words haven't found their mark. <laughs>

DexInt_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Hold your tongue. Else you might lose it.

DexInt_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel2.text: Few men improve their situation with attitudes such as yours.

Int_4a_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: The very man who enslaved me.

Int_4b_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: This man would be useless without his armies.

StrInt_4a_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: An Inquisitor? I had imagined someone a little more imposing.

StrInt_4b_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: Who is this man who would tip the balance of power.

Str_4a_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: He is weaker than his guards.

StrDex_4a_4b_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: If this man hired me, he'd solve many of Oriath's problems.

Dex_4a_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: So... this is the man who commands the Templars?

Dex_4b_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: Wait, this is the Adjunct Inquisitor? Curious.

DexInt_4a_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: He moves in plain sight. An unwise decision.

DexInt_4b_M1_Tut_dominusintro.text: A leader who seems less enlightened than I expected.

Int_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: Thaumaturgy surges through my veins. I know power once more!

StrInt_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: Surely they are giving us these gems for a reason...

StrInt_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: I shudder to use such potent magic, but it must be done.

Str_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: What did he mean by that?

StrDex_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: Thank you kindly, good sirs. I'll make sure to use this one wisely.

StrDex_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: A virtue gem? A promise of power.

Dex_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: A rare find in the wilderness. A precious thing in a time of need.

Dex_4b_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: A-ha! The gem is attuned to my weapon.

DexInt_4a_M1_Tut_tunnel3.text: A virtue gem? A powerful tool, if used with precision.

StrInt_4a_M1_Tut_murderexiles.text: You won't survive the trials ahead.

StrInt_4b_M1_Tut_murderexiles.text: The cycle of life ends here.

StrDex_4a_4b_M1_Tut_murderexiles.text: You will die a dishonourable death.

Dex_4a_M1_Tut_murderexiles.text: You won't have the strength to survive this!

DexInt_4b_M1_Tut_murderexiles.text: By the Dreamer's will, I have another chance.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_02.text: I've fought some big buggers before, but... blimey.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_03.text: Dirty job, this. Shoulda asked for more...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_07.text: A good mercenary knows when to cut and run. I won't end up lying in a field like this...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_08.text: Ezomytes never give up a fight. I expected no less.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_09.text: There better be a reward at the end of all this...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_10.text: Shite like this is why I never wanted a family.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_11.text: So the Hooded One was right. They lost their minds...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_14.text: This place is right fancy. Gold is wasted on the rich...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_15.text: It's finally over... Now, time to ask about that reward.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_17.text: Kindness'll get you killed in times like these, old man.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_18.text: A face like that almost makes me want to help for free. Almost.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_19.text: I'm not one for music, but to each their own.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_20.text: No liquor for sale, eh? Times really have gotten tough.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_21.text: It was him or me, kid.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_22.text: In my experience, madness is contagious. It had to be done.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_24.text: Oh, it's been many years since I saw one of these little beauties...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_27.text: Well, doubt these folk will have much gold...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_29.text: That must be what I'm looking for.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_31.text: Ezomyte runes, eh... Well, whatever works.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_33.text: This body's long rotten. What's going on here?

StrInt_4b_M1_4_boss_death.text: Death must be a relief after what he suffered...

Dex_4b_M1_4_boss_death.text: It was a joy to put you down!

Str_4b_M1_4_watcher_spirit.text: What did he mean by that?

Dex_4b_M1_5_BoneCircle.text: This place feels truly ancient. How much bloodshed have these sands seen?

DexInt_4b_M1_5_BoneCircle.text: It's long past time someone put an end to these pagan rituals.

Dex_4b_M1_5_BoneArchway.text: They bring the very bones back to life. Let's hope they don't try this on something... bigger.

StrInt_4b_M1_5_ValdoFlees.text: Constructed might. It's no match for real strength.

Dex_4b_M1_7_Arrival.text: The light here is.... unnatural. This place is cursed.

Int_4b_M1_7_Arrival.text: Hah! It will take more than a few rotting corpses to take me down.

StrInt_4b_M1_7_Encounter.text: Urgh, what is wrong with you!

Dex_4b_M1_7_KillBoss.text: It was a joy to put you down!

DexInt_4b_M1_8_BossStart.text: A foul lair, for a foul creature.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_01.text: They... will suffer for this humiliation.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_02.text: Power can hide where you least expect.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_04.text: He bore the mark of Corruption... I know it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_05.text: Here, there is a small trace of hope in the air.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_06.text: Disgusting. Everything is wet and vile in Ogham.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_07.text: I have wandered the Vastiri... This was not a challenge.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_09.text: It is strange to think... the Vastiri was once home to such forests...

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_10.text: This tree has an abundance of energy...

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_11.text: I thought the Ezomytes buried their dead... This must have been some battleground.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_12.text: That may hold what I seek.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_13.text: Ugh, the dead seem to rise in every direction... No matter.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_14.text: Ah. The last of what I am seeking.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_16.text: How was this man able to craft these? He is more gifted than he knows...

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_17.text: Let's see what power the old-clans wield.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_18.text: This Shade is more than he seems.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_19.text: The roots here have succumbed to Corruption.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_20.text: These customs are strange to me. Burying their dead... How terrible.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_21.text: Cruel Praetor... I shall bring you the storm.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_22.text: Your demise is welcomed, I am sure of it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_23.text: Repulsive witch. May your misdeeds be long forgotten.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_26.text: Rejoin your kin, lost one. I will remember you.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_27.text: His burden is heavy. He hides it well.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_28.text: Her mind tends to wander. She reminds me of one of my sisters.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_29.text: This is no Lost-Man effigy... The boy is from these parts. I should ask him of this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_94.text: Rabid one – this land is not yours to plunder!

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_33.text: Corruption spreads like wildfire. No creature is safe.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_34.text: Ah, yes... Yet another wicked energy to contend with.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_35.text: Who speaks to me from beyond the void?

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_36.text: The shadows here undulate with raw power...

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_37.text: I return you to the void, or wherever you hail from.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_38.text: Una will be most pleased to see this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_39.text: Such a different sort of melody to my akharas... Haunting.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_40.text: I cannot control this much flame... This village is beyond saving.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_41.text: The Maraketh do not forgive. Nor do they forget.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_43.text: His suffering was short-lived... It is a shame.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_44.text: This Mad Wolf... May he howl like ravaged Deshret.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_45.text: What foul energy gives life to you?

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_47.text: There he is... just a man. Nothing more.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_48.text: I know what this is... and it is not good.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_50.text: Hmm... the Shade is indeed powerful.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_51.text: Vile sorcery hangs on the air.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_52.text: Corrupted or not, your kind deserve no better.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_53.text: The very trees tremble with sickness.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_54.text: Waste away, back to the soil.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_55.text: Blocked for now. But I sense more than just life in these vines...

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_58.text: The elements will now take you, druid.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_59.text: This man has known respect in his life... but now, he is simply lost.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_01.text: I did not know if I would see the Vastiri again... It's good to be home.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_02.text: Time to prove myself to this <i>{akhara}.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_05.text: I leave you to the sands, foul Raiders.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_06.text: Ahh. It's been too long since I felt the rumble of a caravan beneath my feet.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_07.text: From what I can see... the Faridun have been preparing for war. This night... now grows warm.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_08.text: This mine was sealed with some still inside... Corruption seems to have taken them.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_10.text: The Halani Gates have been closed? This has not happened for generations.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_11.text: I must see what Asala thinks of this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_12.text: So the tales of Balbala the Traitor were true. This is how she let in the enemy...

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_13.text: The Traitor must be sealed within these doors.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_14.text: Your punishment has should have ended long ago.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_16.text: A true Djinn... Her soul inhabits this <i>{barya}.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_17.text: Ah. Varashta's great Trial. I know this well. But we must first reach it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_18.text: Orbala and the sisters five! Beautiful!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_19.text: Hmmm... dead Maraketh. The Faridun must infest this place.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_20.text: Reopen, ancient gates of Seven Waters!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_23.text: Mark my words, Jamanra - I will return you to death!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_24.text: We cannot pass. Jamanra will stop at nothing to succeed.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_25.text: Lost Keth, I can only imagine how beautiful you must have been in your time.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_26.text: Kabala! I know of this serpent-tongue!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_28.text: Buried beneath shifting sands... Keth still endures.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_30.text: Defiled treasure. I will remember this day.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_31.text: Such shrines were not meant for mortal eyes. I am honoured.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_33.text: I sense a formidable energy here...

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_35.text: I wish I knew... who you are.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_36.text: The Ardura would not understand this... I must keep this to myself, for now.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_41.text: The darkness is now dispelled. May it stay this way.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_42.text: The great steed's tusks. I shall honour them.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_43.text: The Winter <i>{Sekhema's} challenge... I am right where I deserve to be.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_44.text: Perhaps here, Balbala... we can both be redeemed.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_47.text: My <i>{akhara} are permitted here, but I should not linger.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_48.text: I have heard whispers of such a place... where Titans fought and died.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_50.text: You know why I am here... Relent!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_51.text: More may roam here. It's time to go.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_54.text: I have retread Orbala's path. I must complete the horn.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_56.text: We reclaim the sands and ease the winds!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_58.text: I hope there is time... to protect our honoured dead.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_59.text: The Faridun should know better than to let this madness transpire...

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_61.text: Jamanra will pay for raising the Defiler!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_70.text: The husband of Garukhan? I... don't believe it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_02.text: Now this might be just what I need.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_05.text: Ugh, stay back! Don't do this!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_06.text: I'm sorry Branoc... It was me or you...

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_08.text: The Count must die for what he has done to us.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_09.text: We will survive this. I swear it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_10.text: He lives up to his reputation.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_11.text: This lair... How deep does it go?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_12.text: Corruption has twisted it into a nightmare!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_14.text: The Grelwood has changed... and not for the better.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_16.text: These were not my ancestors, but I still respect their valour.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_17.text: Ominous... but it might hold the runes I seek.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_18.text: They still defend their land, even after all this time.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_20.text: Go with honour. There is nothing left to defend.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_21.text: It's fine work, Father. I still have much to learn.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_23.text: The land itself rots from within.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_24.text: Eternal bastards. Should they rise, I'll hew them back down.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_25.text: This place has not been abandoned...

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_26.text: Your name has long been maligned in Ogham, Draven. This was my pleasure.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_27.text: Your cruelty was immortalised in song, Asinia. Your end will be, too.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_28.text: Is this his wife? She's been here for a very long time...

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_29.text: I'm sorry, Lachlann. Your boys are long dead.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_30.text: Hunt with the First Ones, old man. You've earned it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_31.text: What is this? Perhaps the boy might know.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_32.text: Is that what's been eating our cattle?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_33.text: You won't get away from me!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_34.text: One less danger to threaten our home.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_35.text: So this is where the clanless live. There are far more of them then I expected.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_36.text: That voice... What sinister shadow lurks here?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_37.text: I must destroy this before it goes any further.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_38.text: Shadows should remain where they belong!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_39.text: I can put right one thing, at least.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_41.text: What have they done?! The bastards...They've burned it all!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_42.text: We've lost everything... I'll make them pay...

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_44.text: Death is not revenge enough for what you've done!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_45.text: I'll make them regret not killing me here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_46.text: Geonor must be made to answer for his crimes.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_49.text: That's him. One of us will not leave this Manor alive.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_51.text: You are nothing but a tyrant!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_52.text: First Ones, hear me! Feast upon this tyrant's soul!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_01.text: A culture of warriors. Only the toughest survive here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_02.text: I will have to show them what I can do.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_05.text: It is done. I should return to the caravan.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_06.text: They are nomads. Much like my ancestors.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_07.text: What could they need so much metal for? You could outfit an army with a mine of this scale.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_09.text: Maybe she knows what's going on.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_11.text: Fenumus, protect me from your kin...

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_12.text: I know nothing of these symbols. What secrets lie within?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_13.text: This must be the Traitor's prison.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_14.text: There is nothing just about excessive punishment.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_20.text: These Faridun fight with surprising fury.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_22.text: He has the Beast! I must stop him!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_23.text: Argh. The sand! I must get back to the caravan!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_24.text: This barren place holds an essence of water? Perhaps it is beneath the sands.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_26.text: The Vastiri Desert is a strange and deadly place.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_27.text: How could the Maraketh abandon something like this?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_29.text: Impressive workmanship. A shame I had to destroy it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_31.text: Something still remains at the heart of this place.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_32.text: That wound! How is she still alive?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_35.text: How does anyone live in this forsaken wasteland?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_39.text: Join the dead, you so defiled.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_40.text: These tusks are what I seek.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_41.text: I will show them how a true warrior fights.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_42.text: This place is ancient, yet something stirs within...

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_43.text: This valley was not carved by the hands of men.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_44.text: The First Ones cannot help me here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_47.text: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_49.text: Another closed gate? Let's see what the Ardura have to say.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_50.text: That's everything. I must talk to Zarka.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_52.text: By Farrul's roar, open the way!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_54.text: I pray I am not too late.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_56.text: Enough tricks! They won't get away this time!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_57.text: My life has been a forge. I am ready for war.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_58.text: I will end this or die fighting!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_60.text: I can sense it. The Beast is near.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_61_B.text: Then they shall sing of my victory!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_61_C.text: This is not how respect is earned!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_62.text: You fought well, Faridun. A shame you did it with stolen strength.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_65.text: I don't know much of your history. But all I see is a good man.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_01.text: Ah, the Maraketh! A very... <i>{rich culture.}

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_05.text: If <i>{this} doesn't earn my passage, nothing will.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_06.text: Never thought I'd work for the Maraketh again... Too bloody hot.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_08.text: I hear movement in the dark... <i>{Lots} of movement...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_09.text: All these statues, still just as dead... What was the point, eh?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_12.text: Asala, these people have been infected by a seed carried by the Faridun. We need to move fast.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_14.text: Now where's that bloke with the hood gone?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_19.text: I hope this place doesn't bloody cave in...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_20.text: Auria's Tits! This things gotta be worth a fortune.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_21.text: Yes! Go on, make more o' the little gold buggers!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_22.text: Gold! And jewels! I'm coming back for you later!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_24.text: There's light ahead. Hmm... what's all this then?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_25.text: Never heard of a god in such a state...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_26.text: I'll do as you ask, my lady. I'll bring you fire.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_27.text: Some days, this job is brutal.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_28.text: Gotta make sure my bones don't end up here, too.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_29.text: Always some sort of ritual going on, eh?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_31.text: Now, just a giant damned mastodon to deal with!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_32.text: I despise necromancers. Make me do the job twice!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_33.text: Time to take this trophy and run.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_03.text: I miss the desert... At least it was dry heat.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_04.text: Pretty. But I'm not touching a damn thing 'round here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_05.text: I usually try to avoid jobs like this. Always <i>{something} to kill ya.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_07.text: Better watch out for more like those.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_08.text: Oh, it's warm... Why is it <i>{warm?}

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_11.text: Your job's long over, me ol' mate. Take a rest.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_36.text: This needs a Soul Core that's a bit... bigger.

StrDex4b_SummonCompanion_02_01.text: I think this is a two person job!

StrDex4b_SummonCompanion_02_02.text: I think this is a two person job!

StrDex4b_SummonCompanion_02_03.text: I think this is a two person job!

StrDex4b_SummonCompanion_02_04.text: I think this is a two person job!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_52.text: The Miller has seen better days.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_54.text: Nightmares have no power against the light.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_55.text: Could that hold the runes I seek?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_57.text: There's nothing in the Dreamer's teachings about a being like this...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_58.text: He has the manner of a man lost in his own mind...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_59.text: Somewhere in the darkness, a soul lies dreaming of hate...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_62.text: Finally, familiar terrain. I must be getting close to their village...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_63.text: Better dead than enslaved to a false religion.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_66.text: Your tricks won't work on me!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_68.text: Perhaps we can all breathe a little easier now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_69.text: Hmm. I should ask about this in Clearfell.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_70.text: Not surprised to see that thief in a place like this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_74.text: I best not tarry... if the trees here can behave like that...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_75.text: I won't be getting through here... for now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_77.text: The misery in Ogham never ends!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_73.text: Time to consult the Hooded One.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_76.text: Just another undead horror I must destroy.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_77.text: Discipline and strength triumph once again.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_81.text: The power of the Dreamer flows through me!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_88.text: A living gem... a gift, and a prize.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_90.text: I must know the truth if I am to continue.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_91.text: Slavery will not be necessary when the Dreamer awakes.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_01.text: Where the Dreamer wills, I go.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_05.text: This land is infested with ancient Corruption!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_06.text: I recognise this place from my dreams...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_07.text: I am exactly where I need to be.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_08.text: Wisdom of any kind is much appreciated.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_10.text: Wraeclast is adorned with the scars of what once was.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_12.text: What manner of creatures are these?!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_13.text: It moves almost like a man!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_18.text: Alva will know what to do with this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_21.text: The works of the mind are no match for the will of the soul.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_24.text: Alva likely knows what this altar does.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_27.text: Another Soul Core. Perhaps, there is another door.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_29.text: This will require another Soul Core...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_30.text: Hmm, this will need another Soul Core...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_31.text: That thing, it fought with the ire of a mortal man...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_32.text: How strange. I should ask Alva about this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_33.text: Something like this will require a bigger Soul Core.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_36.text: It still functions after all this time.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_37.text: That should be enough. Back to the central chamber.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_39.text: Finally, I have what I need.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_41.text: They're here, just as Servi warned.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_43.text: Time for Utzaal to reveal its secrets.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_44.text: I had no idea how enormous this Ziggurat really is.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_45.text: This stench is damaging my calm.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_47.text: I have had my fill of witches for one lifetime.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_48.text: I hope the children of Servi's tribe can now rest.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_49.text: I would do it all again, even without a reward. Thank you.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_50.text: This drowned city is not dead... something moves in hidden spaces...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_51.text: I'm not interested in treasure, but wisdom... that is what I seek.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_52.text: What horrors does this quiet darkness hide?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_54.text: Is there a smith at work within this tomb?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_58.text: Does the molten gold actually make him <i>{stronger}?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_61.text: The dangers of wealth have never been so literal.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_66.text: You were not worthy of my skills.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_67.text: This looks like it will fit the Ziggurat's door.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_69.text: What is the source of that blinding light?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_71.text: Did the Vaal create and master a <i>{sun}?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_75.text: This must be what they needed all that power for.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_78.text: This heart still beats... what foul sorcery sustains it?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_83.text: Would they have still built this, if they knew?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_90.text: You will suffer, architect of death!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_91.text: Your contraptions will not save you!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_94.text: A strange alliance... but I am willing to listen.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_95.text: Another chance to test my mettle.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_97.text: A fierce beast! I am ready!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_101.text: Three heads, one tail... but no chance.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_103.text: The ultimate test... Let us begin!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_107.text: A life taken too soon. I wonder if Servi knew them.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_110.text: At least I saved some of them...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_118.text: These poor souls didn't stand a chance.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_121.text: Hmm... I should watch my footing.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_122.text: I tire of this wretched place.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_125.text: Hmm... This looks to be dormant. I wonder if I could power it...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_128.text: Praying to sticks and fire... fools.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_129.text: Perhaps there is something to these beliefs after all.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_131.text: How could they have lived here all this time?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_133.text: This place should be razed to the ground.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_137.text: May as well hold onto this too.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_139.text: This abomination isn't hostile... Seems it is cooking something.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_141.text: I think I need more ingredients.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_142.text: This ought to do the trick.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_143.text: Well, well... this foul creature has some use after all.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_144.text: This should cool the molten gold.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_146.text: Huh... I'm sure Oswald will want this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_147.text: This should fetch a decent sum.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_149.text: And another. I should get these to Oswald.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_150.text: Hmm. Only one part of a whole. I wonder what it does?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_151.text: Seems there should be one more piece.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_152.text: It is complete. Now... to find a use for it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_157.text: Might this be the Orok shaman?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_158.text: It seems there's a concealed exit there.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_01.text: An unlikely refuge, but I'll take it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_02.text: Uhh... How long have I been asleep?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_03.text: Man was not meant to master time.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_04.text: I've never seen such a blood-chilling beauty.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_06.text: Why did that energy feel... familiar?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_07.text: I've seen this horror... in dreams!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_08.text: You were an enemy, and yet...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_09.text: I swear I've seen this symbol before...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_11.text: It's not real, but I must fight just the same!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_12.text: Courage means fighting despite the fear!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_14.text: A strange aura surrounds that woman.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_16.text: His arrogance belies a great sadness.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_19.text: Wraeclast does not give up its secrets easily!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_20.text: At long last, this is it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_21.text: Maybe now, Wraeclast can start healing.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_25.text: This heat will not stop me.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_31.text: No walls will hold me back.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_34.text: Nothing they forge can match my skill.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_36.text: I've seen a temple like this before...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_42.text: Feels like where this all began.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_45.text: A shore... but of what sea?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_47.text: I've never seen a forest quite like this one.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_49.text: These springs will soon be stained with blood.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_51.text: Dark, but not silent. Something stirs.

DexInt4b_Intro_SalesPitch_01.text: My life has been naught but discipline and focus, preparing me for this. I fight for the Benevolent Dreamer. Free my hands, and those who seek chaos will fall before me!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_44.text: Eh, I've taken orders from stranger.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_45.text: This place raises the hackles on the back o' me neck. Eugh...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_48.text: Bloody Eternals... never did know when to quit.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_49.text: Wow... you don't see that every day.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_50.text: Ah, fresh tracks. Must be nearing the village now.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_51.text: What's all this then? Hmm... Finn's from these parts. Maybe he knows.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_52.text: Guess we know what's been killing the cows!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_55.text: This is bloody work. Still, I never did like birds...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_56.text: I better watch me step around here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_57.text: Who was that? Where is he...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_59.text: Oh will you bugger off?! We've got enough problems!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_60.text: Awfully quiet here... That's not good.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_65.text: And here I thought I'd reached the Manor already. Bugger.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_66.text: Ooh! All I did was touch it!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_67.text: Always did say religion is dangerous!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_68.text: That's him! Hah. Soon... very soon.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_73.text: Well this'll be a dirty job.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_74.text: And that's the last of 'em, haha! Finally.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_75.text: Pretty piece of work, this is. I should ask about it in Clearfell.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_76.text: Ah, Una will be happy to see this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_77.text: A swindler and a thief. I like him already.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_79.text: Ahh... I think I heard a fable about this kind of thing.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_80.text: Kinda walked into that one, didn't I?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_81.text: A trap, eh? Let's do this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_82.text: Ya need more than an overgrown weed to take me down!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_83.text: No getting through here. Well not yet, anyway.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_84.text: Neat little show... Wish I could sing away <i>{my} problems.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_85.text: No, tell me that isn't fungus!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_86.text: Fungus. It just had to be fungus!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_102.text: I'm no botanist, but I'm pretty sure these roots ain't meant to glow.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_103.text: Sure are a lot of mushrooms. Hope they ain't poisonous.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_104.text: Great. Guess I get to follow the locusts.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_105.text: Blimey... Whatever did this could rip me in two.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_35.text: Now what were they doing here?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_36.text: Ah, I bet a load of weapons came out of this place.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_37.text: Heh. I should charge for this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_39.text: Best ask the lady boss about this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_40.text: Oiiii... gotta be something valuable behind those doors!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_41.text: So that's where they got the ol' girl locked up...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_43.text: No gold, just... who's this then?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_45.text: She's in the coin? This won't do.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_47.text: All these statues, and no one remembers... What was the point?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_48.text: He can't just leave, can he?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_49.text: Nah. Going on foot in that will never work.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_50.text: Look at all this religion. Didn't help them, in the end.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_54.text: Best take care not to spill this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_57.text: It's getting rather ugly around here. Smells like necromancy.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_58.text: Oh I walked into this one!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_59.text: I wonder if by 'Maraketh wisdom,' Balbala meant 'gold'. A man can hope.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_61.text: At least I've got some help in here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_63.text: Oh, great – a moving pile of rocks!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_64.text: I... have had... enough of you!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_67.text: Dark times call for a dark profession.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_66.text: Time to see what these gems can really do.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_74.text: Zarokh, was it? You put up a hell of a fight. Good on ya.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_76.text: Looks like any other valley to me.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_77.text: Ah, this must be the forbidden part. Well, on I go.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_78.text: Is this... a graveyard for Titans...? No wonder...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_80.text: Thought I was cooked for sure.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_83.text: That should be all the pieces. Time to speak to the old lady.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_86.text: So... that's what true power feels like...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_87.text: Gotta find a way up I suppose.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_88.text: Never been so high. Precarious job, this one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_92.text: Giant blasted bone monsters! I'm done with this!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_93.text: Been awhile since I been to war. It's like comin' home.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_94.text: You're payin'. Whatever you say, boss.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_95.text: This war ends today, one way or another.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_96.text: My payday approaches. I can feel it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_97.text: No runnin' this time. You and me!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_101.text: It's done... For what it's worth, Faridun, I took no pleasure in it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_103.text: Get up now, I've still got to get paid!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_104.text: Go on, then. I like to know who I'm working for.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_105.text: Sorry mate, that went right over my head.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_107.text: Slaves? These Maraketh'd give House Keita a run for its money.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_120.text: What's with all the parchment? Practically paperin' the walls.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_121.text: Serpent Clan must've set up shop nearby.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_122.text: Don't think I'll like the look of whatever did this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_123.text: These Titans must've been somethin', alright.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_125.text: Ah, shite. Better tell Shambrin the bad news.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_18.text: I'll take any help I can get.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_19.text: A fellow cynic, heh! Love it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_20.text: Swore I'd never fight in the jungle again, damnit.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_21.text: Not catchin' me off guard, monkeys! I remember you!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_22.text: Ain't never seen a monkey like that before!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_24.text: They grow 'em big around here... Good riddance.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_25.text: Not lettin' these snakes get in me. Not a chance.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_26.text: Slow and steady... Don't trust this ground at all...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_27.text: Should ask Miss Valai about this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_29.text: That's gonna come alive, innit? I just know it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_32.text: Where there's a Soul Core, there must be... a Soul Door. Heh heh heh.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_33.text: Did this thing just whisper? No, couldn't have...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_34.text: Gonna need another Soul Core for this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_35.text: Ho ho, ominous! Miss Valai'll know what this is about.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_37.text: This'll power something here, no doubt.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_38.text: Yee! Is it... supposed to spark like that?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_40.text: Oh, I just <i>{know} what's gonna happen.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_43.text: The Carver tribe are here? This is gonna get ugly.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_44.text: The first of many, no doubt.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_45.text: There we go, that oughta do it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_46.text: So many stairs... With all their cleverness, you'd think they'd have made some sort of elevator.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_47.text: I'm in their home turf now...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_48.text: That's the witch that's gotta die!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_49.text: You can't be serious! A flying bonestick?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_50.text: Taking children - that's where I draw the line, witch!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_52.text: I'd have done it either way. Some things just can't be abided.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_53.text: They weren't pulling my leg. There's a whole damn city down here!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_58.text: I think he knows I'm here...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_59.text: Time to meet the man of the house.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_60.text: No need to get excited now!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_64.text: Gotcha, bastard... and now it's all mine... and Oswald's, I guess.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_65.text: First thing I'm gonna do, when I get back to civilisation, is buy myself a boat and sail off forever...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_66.text: These probably ain't the good kinda mushrooms...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_69.text: Was that made of... of children?!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_71.text: Hate to tumble and run, but I need that.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_72.text: A solid gold baby? Had a dream like this once.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_73.text: Hope I can get that back once we're done with this door...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_74.text: She's a bit warm in here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_76.text: Huh, an indoor sun. Wonder how they managed that.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_79.text: I like the sun as much as the next guy, but you lot took it too far.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_80.text: I knew there'd be an elevator! I said it, and I was right!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_81.text: I'm gonna have to go in that thing, aren't I?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_83.text: It's all prettied up. Not bad.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_85.text: I know a shakedown when I see one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_86.text: I can't let you take Miss Valai.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_90.text: This is a place of death dressed up in bright colours.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_91.text: Killing should be dirty and disgusting, not glorified.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_93.text: Hmm, Doryani... I've heard that name somewhere.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_95.text: They're gonna regret taking Miss Valai.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_96.text: Enough talk. Show me what ya got!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_97.text: Oh, I did ask for this, didn't I?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_98.text: Listen, I'm just here for the lady! There's no need for all this!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_101.text: All that ruckus, and for what?!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_102.text: Just doing my job. I'm fine with a truce.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_103.text: Another chance at ancient wisdom, eh.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_106.text: Strange beast. Dies just the same, though, dunnit?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_108.text: Heh, I'm really taking to this place.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_109.text: Buncha spare parts stuck together, aren't you?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_110.text: Heheh... almost feel bad for that one. Looked like it was somebody's pet project.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_114.text: Oi, a dead man. Looks a bit like... oh, bugger.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_116.text: Hello! I see a chance to earn some gold!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_117.text: Heh heh, I'm worth every coin.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_118.text: A few losses are to be expected.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_120.text: Always happy to help out... for coin.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_121.text: What are they doin' this deep?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_124.text: Ahh... if anyone asks, I was never here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_126.text: Hmm... no chance of saving this lot. They're long gone.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_127.text: Is coming in here really a good idea?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_129.text: Might be a good idea to avoid breathing 'round here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_132.text: Finally, some good old fashioned treasure!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_133.text: Looks like this might do something interesting... if it had power.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_134.text: Looks like this might do something interesting.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_135.text: What in the... The Vaal must have been crazy.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_136.text: These bastards gotta pay for what they did to those children.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_137.text: I don't want your damn dark power, but I'll sure as hell use it against ya.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_138.text: They just won't leave me alone!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_140.text: What have they been doing down here?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_141.text: Maybe this place shoulda stayed sunken.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_143.text: Not gonna die to a bunch of fish! No way, no how!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_145.text: Always willing to try a new mushroom.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_148.text: Oh well - time for a mushroom hunt.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_151.text: Hmm... this should come in handy.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_152.text: I could use this to get across...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_156.text: Could probably sell this to Oswald for a pretty penny.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_157.text: Wonder what Oswald would pay for this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_158.text: This looks like it fits something.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_163.text: Eugh. Too many snakes for my likin'. Wonder where they're going.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_164.text: All that fancy get-up – gotta be a shaman.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_165.text: Some kinda hidden exit over there.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_02.text: I had the worst dream... I was – ah, shite.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_03.text: Never met a man I've killed before.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_04.text: I don't mind bein' trapped in here with 'er, not at all.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_05.text: Been a long time since I seen one of these.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_06.text: Cousin's third wife was a Breachy. Heh! Let's not reunite.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_07.text: Never heard of this Breach Lord before... Strange.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_08.text: When you grow your new body, friend, I'll be back again. Believe me.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_09.text: Never did think the peace would last.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_10.text: Creepy mirrors be damned, is that really what I look like in all this gear?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_11.text: Can't scare me with this. I've spent my whole life here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_12.text: I've only got one fear... but you know that, don'tcha, you foggy bastard.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_13.text: I hear you, wherever you are. Don't think I'm not gonna find you.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_14.text: I've needed more than luck to make it this long.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_15.text: Logistics has always been the true key to warfare.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_16.text: I'm no hero. Don't make that mistake.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_17.text: A man with an interest in mercenaries? I like him.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_19.text: Have those been right under our feet the whole time?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_25.text: I have a feeling my luck's about to run out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_27.text: I'm still alive? Ha! What do you know...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_28.text: Reminds me of that battle in Phaaryl...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_29.text: Ah, it's like that campaign five years back.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_30.text: This place brings back bad memories.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_31.text: It's like that fight we had in that volcano eighteen years ago...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_32.text: I shoulda just sailed off in a boat when I had the chance.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_33.text: Always get ambushed in places like this...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_34.text: I don't got the boots for this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_36.text: Again, not touching a damn thing.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_37.text: Let's find out who's king of this castle.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_38.text: Swore I'd never go back to prison...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_40.text: Ooh... even more ominous than usual.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_42.text: Heh. Always love roughing up a temple.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_43.text: Oh, great – swarms of things. My favourite.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_46.text: There better be gold at the end of this... rainbow.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_47.text: Oh, I just know this one's gonna go bad.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_49.text: Oof... gonna hold my breath for this one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_51.text: Might be a nice place to settle down one day.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_52.text: Ohh... I'm gonna get sand in me boots for sure.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_54.text: Slow and steady'll get me through this one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_55.text: Don't suppose these springs are safe for a bath.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_57.text: Best step quietly. Hate to wake the dead.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_59.text: Now isn't this a hidden little paradise?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_63.text: Well this is... If I was a poet, I'd... Ah something.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_IntroSalesPitch_01.text: You've got a weapon, I'll wield it. Just tell me where to point it. I've seen the highs and horrors of war, and I'll do whatever it takes to survive. If you've got coin, I'm your man.

StrDex4b_OilGrenadeIgnite_03_01.text: Ooh, it's a bit hot in here!

StrDex4b_ShardDespoiler_01_01.text: To the worthy go the spoils. Heh.

StrDex4b_ShardDespoiler_01_02.text: To the worthy go the spoils. Heh.

StrDex4b_ShardDespoiler_01_03.text: To the worthy go the spoils. Heh.

StrDex4b_ShardDespoiler_01_04.text: To the worthy go the spoils. Heh.

DexInt4b_HeraldOfIce_02_01.text: There's a chill in the air.

DexInt4b_HeraldOfIce_02_02.text: There's a chill in the air.

DexInt4b_HeraldOfIce_02_03.text: There's a chill in the air.

DexInt4b_HeraldOfIce_02_04.text: There's a chill in the air.

Int4_Gameplay_ZombieIntro_01.text: The dead rise again? Oh, I'm going to like it here.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_71.text: That voice... He sounds like fun.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_72.text: Dreadful Draven... Where are you hiding?

Int4_Gameplay_A1_73.text: Life and death are well balanced here... Disgusting.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_74.text: Once crops, now fields of foul plague. Delicious.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_81.text: I suppose this belongs to Una.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_82.text: I guess now she'll start playing songs. Best get out of here soon.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_83.text: He's a devious one. I like him.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_73.text: I should ask the <i>{Sekhema} about this.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_74.text: This must be the traitor's prison.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_75.text: Well... if isn't the traitor herself. Let's get this over with.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_76.text: Jamanra the Corpse-King is running away... Ha!

Int4_Gameplay_A2_77.text: Well... we aren't getting through here in a hurry.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_80.text: I'm usually opposed to burning women alive... but as you wish.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_83.text: Raised from bone! I like these Lost-men!

Int4_Gameplay_A2_87.text: Never mind, no challenge at all.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_89.text: They burned many a sister. They tried to burn me. I think now I shall pay it forward.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_90.text: Of my blood, they will see true power. And of my blood, they shall know true pain.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_96.text: How is it you can control time and you lose? Weak. Pathetic.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_97.text: It appears they fought here. Died here. A resting place...

Int4_Gameplay_A2_99.text: Nowhere left to hide now, sweet undead King...

Int4_Gameplay_A2_100.text: This whole operation would be more efficient... if they were dead.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_101.text: I'll take anything I can get.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_30.text: Constructs once powered by dead souls. Wondrous.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_33.text: Well... where does this one go?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_34.text: I'm really quite fond of these things.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_35.text: Need another Soul Core for this...

Int4_Gameplay_A3_36.text: Seems this needs a larger Soul Core than the doors did.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_37.text: I suppose this will fit the generator.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_39.text: What a display. Let's find another.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_40.text: Well... that seemed to bring the whole place alive.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_41.text: This is very obviously a great idea.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_42.text: A genius construction. But... too weak.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_44.text: The Azak tribe, in the flesh!

Int4_Gameplay_A3_46.text: Yes, drain away! Reveal yourself, Utzaal!

Int4_Gameplay_A3_48.text: A bog... overrun by savages. Time to have some fun.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_49.text: Ignagduk... Vile one. You taint our title.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_50.text: A stick? You're embarrassing us, Azak witch!

Int4_Gameplay_A3_51.text: You crossed the line, sister. You should have known what the price would be.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_52.text: It was deserved. I draw the line at children... unless provoked, of course.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_53.text: Witches like her give the sisterhood a bad name.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_54.text: Utzaal, wretched and drowned. I'm sure I'd prefer you this way.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_55.text: I suppose it could be worth a look.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_56.text: Seems this place has long been forgotten... but is not without life.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_65.text: Wealth has never inspired me. But it was a fun fight.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_66.text: Not a total waste after all.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_67.text: While I do admire darkness, filth I cannot abide.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_68.text: Atziri failed to grasp immortality. I will not make the same mistake.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_72.text: What a disgusting pig of a woman.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_73.text: One golden idol for the optimist.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_74.text: Something of immense power resides within. I... shall harness it.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_77.text: The Vaal were smarter than they had any right to be. This is proof of that.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_78.text: This fellow has been here far too long.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_80.text: I'm sure Kopec will love to see you.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_82.text: Well... I've seen it all now.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_84.text: Utzaal... Yes... I certainly preferred it drowned and wet.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_85.text: A bigger heart than mine, to be sure.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_89.text: Somehow, I've been cheated out of another kill.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_92.text: Many have died at this table.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_93.text: A similar method to a curse or two I know...

Int4_Gameplay_A3_96.text: The fool doesn't realize he's already dead.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_97.text: Yes, yes... resist all you like.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_100.text: All of that, just to fall at my feet and submit. What a weasel.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_101.text: Even the grandest of figures cower at the prospect of death. Pathetic.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_102.text: I will seize the power of Chaos.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_104.text: I accept your challenge, ancient one.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_108.text: I shall grant you a death per head!

Int4_Gameplay_A3_109.text: Chaos certainly has a strong imagination.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_110.text: Are you sure you want to fight me?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_112.text: The power of Chaos flows through me.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_114.text: I'd bring him back but... he won't love her like he did.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_116.text: I'm too busy to be bothered with this.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_117.text: Death is a part of life. Deal with it.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_122.text: Surely you didn't all expect to live?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_124.text: Why are you talking to me?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_128.text: Someone ought to cut all this back.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_129.text: That beast... was odd. I was fond of it.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_130.text: Hmm... a relic of Chaos, it seems.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_139.text: Let's see what the lake kept hidden.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_140.text: The stench. I suppose they survived here... more or less.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_144.text: Looks like she needs certain ingredients.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_145.text: I suppose I can help find your mushrooms.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_148.text: Thank you, sister. I accept this gift.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_152.text: I should ask the Weakling about these artefacts.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_154.text: The Weakling would definitely be interested in these.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_155.text: This is some sort of relic of Chaos...

Int4_Gameplay_A3_156.text: Ah, it's the second piece of something. I need one more.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_157.text: That's the third piece, but what is it for?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_158.text: Is this the Viper's home? How meagre.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_159.text: The Vaal should not have been meddling with this.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_02.text: So... I'm still alive after being hit in the face by the Cataclysm... I'd almost say I'm lucky.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_03.text: I liked him better when I killed him.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_04.text: She and I really must exchange forbidden secrets.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_06.text: I sense there will be others.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_12.text: I am the master of fear!

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_13.text: I've had enough dark revelations for one life!

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_15.text: I suspect he's more intelligent than he lets on.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_19.text: A quick way to gather corpses. I approve.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_13.text: Silly me, expecting a door to actually open.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_25.text: Arbiter... Your purpose is served. Submit!

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_27.text: Pity! There are no more lands left for me to conquer.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_30.text: I could settle down here one day...

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_32.text: The Cataclysm really did change the face of Wraeclast...

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_36.text: This place would look better on fire.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_37.text: They haven't built a fortress strong enough to stop me.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_38.text: I don't see the point in keeping living prisoners. So much wasted potential.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_40.text: Not quite hot enough here for my tastes.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_42.text: What false power do they worship here?

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_45.text: I grow weary of places like this.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_47.text: Now this is a rather striking forest.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_49.text: I don't mind pollution, but not like this.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_52.text: Thought I'd seen the last of sand.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_53.text: Is there no end to Corrupted lands?

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_55.text: Not a place to bathe in.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_56.text: I could set this ablaze so easily...

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_59.text: A hidden path, not for the timid.

Int4_Gameplay_EndGame_60.text: I was born in darkness. I shall thrive here.

Int4_IntroLine_AscendancyPitch_01.text: The true path to power lies in my very blood. When I bleed, they die. And when I succeed, the world will fear my name.

Int4_IntroLine_AscendancyPitch_02.text: There's nothing more exquisite than explosive carnage. I shall see the world burn. They will regret what they did to my sisters.

Int4_Keystone_AvatarOfFire_01.text: The pyre is mine to channel.

Int4_Keystone_BloodMagic_01.text: I've got thaumaturgy in my blood.

Int4_Keystone_EternalYouth_01.text: The forbidden books taught me much.

Int4_Keystone_GiantsBlood_01.text: I'm now stronger than I look.

Int4_Keystone_Heartstopper_01.text: A heart of ice is easily chilled.

Int4_Keystone_HollowPalmTechnique_01.text: There are many forces within the flesh.

Int4_Keystone_IronReflexes_01.text: I am what I choose to be.

Int4_Keystone_NecromanticTalisman_01.text: I shall lead an army of the dead.

Int4_Keystone_Oasis_01.text: Not all witches are fond of potions.

Int4_Keystone_VaalPact_01.text: I shall thrive on the flesh of my enemies.

Int4_KeystoneResonance.text: I'll decide my path to power.

Int4_KeystoneBlackflameCovenant.text: Flames of the pyre, now flames of shadow.

Int4_KeystoneRitualCadence.text: Good things for those who wait.

Int4_KeystoneCrimsonAssault.text: Let their blood flow like a fountain.

Int4_KeystoneBulwark.text: I can take a bit of pain.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_55.text: The journey has not been kind to you, Miller.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_57.text: It seems someone refuses to let go...

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_58.text: The Praetor's wife must be in here somewhere.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_59.text: It seems something has tainted the bounty of Ogham.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_60.text: Scream all you like - it won't help you!

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_61.text: The Nameless have no place in Wraeclast!

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_63.text: All this rock and stone cannot hide the rot within.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_64.text: I cannot allow Corruption to fester here. It must be cleansed.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_65.text: One step closer to cleansing this land.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_66.text: Looks like someone left in a hurry...

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_67.text: Home of the Grelwood witch... What happened here?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_69.text: Even the trees have become twisted with Corruption.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_71.text: The roots have grown like a scab covering a wound.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_73.text: Oh... not you as well, Druid.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_64.text: I should ask Asala about this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_65.text: Well... at least there's some shade in here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_67.text: Seems there's a meeting at the main cart.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_71.text: Knaves and their rituals. When will they learn?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_73.text: So <i>{you're} the one responsible for all this death. Let me return the favour.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_75.text: I'm unsure what I've gotten myself into here...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_76.text: A monstrosity born of earth and stone.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_77.text: You were no match for me.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_79.text: If a way exists, I will find it. If it does not, I will make it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_80.text: By the time they see my arrow, it's already too late.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_83.text: You fought well... but not well enough.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_85.text: I think I'm starting to get the hang of this place.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_86.text: You won't get the better of me, Djinn!

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_87.text: My victory was never in doubt.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_88.text: A city of the dead... Why not just bury them and be done with it?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_91.text: Slaves? The Maraketh really are a brutal people.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_01.text: First a barren desert, now a festering swamp. Oh, how I miss the forest.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_05.text: There was a time when I considered the trees my friends...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_06.text: Treasure hunters... Buzzards picking at the corpse of Wraeclast.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_09.text: I can smell the fear on him. How unbecoming.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_10.text: Best give the hives a wide berth.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_11.text: I shouldn't assume this is anything like the forests back home.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_14.text: You're strong, I'll give you that.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_15.text: It's a shame to kill such a creature... but you left me with little choice.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_16.text: Bones that writhe in the dark... I should keep my weapon at the ready.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_17.text: Hmm... this is a bad sign.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_18.text: I suppose... I should talk to Alva about this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_19.text: Everything here looks like it wants to kill me.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_21.text: For all their inventions, the Vaal still couldn't save themselves...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_25.text: So, this is a Soul Core. Let's hope Alva was right about these.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_28.text: Another Soul core. Are there more doors?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_30.text: This will need another Soul Core.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_31.text: Another Soul Core will get me through.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_33.text: Yet again, I must call upon Alva...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_34.text: I need to find another Soul Core to use this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_35.text: Powering up an ancient generator... What could go wrong?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_36.text: This Soul Core is larger. I wonder what it's for?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_37.text: I don't trust this thing. Best keep moving.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_40.text: You should have shared... Now the core is mine.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_42.text: If the Azak value their lives, they'll steer clear of me.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_43.text: If only the Vaal lasted half as long as their contraptions.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_45.text: So this is what the Vaal were capable of...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_46.text: These Azak treat their land with no respect.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_47.text: I'll do to you what you've done to this land.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_50.text: One less blight on the land.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_52.text: Nice of him to risk <i>{my} neck.
