Dex4_Gameplay_A3_53.text: There's a strange heat within this temple.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_58.text: He draws strength from the heat!

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_61.text: All this heat and I barely broke a sweat.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_62.text: A 'finder's fee' for doing all the heavy lifting. Typical treasure hunter.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_63.text: So this is what I could smell? How repulsive.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_66.text: There's a sight I won't soon forget!

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_67.text: I just did the world a huge favour.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_68.text: This should grant us access to the temple.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_73.text: Can't kill what you can't catch.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_74.text: A trapped animal will lose it's mind... eventually.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_77.text: Where are we? How is this possible?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_78.text: Incredible. An entire civilization... brought back from ruin...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_79.text: Never seen a heart this big, even from an animal.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_81.text: Guess we can't talk this out!

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_82.text: What trickery is this? Where did she go?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_83.text: Rulers are never as beautiful as their statues portray them to be.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_84.text: To think everyone here will die... All because of one woman and her pet thaumaturge.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_85.text: How many were sacrificed at this altar?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_86.text: Just like gutting an animal... in a sense.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_87.text: Ah yes. Another arrogant man erects a statue in his own honour. How vulgar.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_92.text: All that, and your machines still fall short!

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_93.text: So, you've come to your senses. About time.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_99.text: Come on then. Let's do this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_105.text: This must be poor Servi's son...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_106.text: They look a long way from home.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_107.text: They all escape with their lives... this time.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_108.text: As Servi says, let the dead be a lesson to the living.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_109.text: You explorers never learn. Nature is not your playground.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_110.text: If you had any sense, you'd go home and stay there.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_111.text: Those explorers have bitten off more than they can chew.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_112.text: They'd all be dead had I not come along.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_113.text: Some lessons have to be learned the hard way.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_114.text: They were fools to come here unprepared.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_115.text: Next time, you may not be so lucky.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_116.text: This is what happens when I'm not around to save the day.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_119.text: As deadly as they are beautiful.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_121.text: This key could come in handy.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_122.text: Possessions don't interest me, but perhaps this will be put to good use...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_123.text: Hmm... I wonder what this would do once powered?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_124.text: Dark energy flows from this device.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_127.text: Hmm. This... is not what I expected...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_129.text: Perversions of nature... and ugh... the smell...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_130.text: The stink... How could they live like this?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_134.text: This mushroom looks edible... Famous last words...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_137.text: She doesn't look like the friendly type... but nor does she look hostile.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_138.text: Why do I feel like she's disappointed in me?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_139.text: I should look for more mushrooms.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_140.text: I'll let you be the one to taste-test these.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_142.text: These cores might cool the molten gold!

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_144.text: Oswald would burst a blood vessel if he saw this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_146.text: What purpose did these serve, I wonder?

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_147.text: If Oswald's lucky, I might just let him have these.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_148.text: There must be more to this. I should keep looking.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_149.text: Hmm... One more piece is needed.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_150.text: It is complete. Now to find where to use it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_151.text: So this is the den of the snake... Nothing special really.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_153.text: If only they knew the truth...

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_154.text: Wonder where those snakes are headed.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_155.text: Looks like a shaman of some sort.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_156.text: I see a hidden exit over there.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_01.text: I suppose this is home... for now.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_03.text: Pretty sure I've killed him... How awkward.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_06.text: I must seal any rifts I find. They can only bring doom.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_08.text: Four on one and I'm still standing.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_13.text: Were you even real to begin with?

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_19.text: That felt better than it should've.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_22.text: Spiders... not my favourite of Nature's creations.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_23.text: Things are about to get messy.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_25.text: For how long has this poor forest burned?

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_26.text: Red sands... A reminder of the Vastiri.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_30.text: Beautiful, and deadly. A dangerous combination.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_31.text: No fortress is impenetrable. Especially where I'm concerned.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_32.text: I'd sooner die than let myself be taken prisoner again.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_34.text: The heat of the forge won't slow <i>{me} down.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_35.text: My return to the forest can't come soon enough.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_36.text: Time to profane another temple, I suppose.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_37.text: Easy to put a foot wrong here.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_38.text: I've never known Nature to birth a place like this.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_39.text: This place seems twisted by Corruption.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_41.text: Something about this place... I've never felt less at home in a forest before.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_42.text: Now this is more like it. Reminds me of back home.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_43.text: If the beasts don't get me, the fumes will. Best keep moving.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_44.text: I long for some nice, <i>{flat} terrain.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_45.text: My travels have certainly taken me to worse places.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_47.text: Leaves underfoot and branches overhead. Just the way I like it.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_50.text: When did it last rain here? Not for some time, I'd wager.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_51.text: I hear the shambling of undead feet...

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_53.text: One could fall a long way from here...

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_54.text: The air is rank and stale down here.

Dex4_Heartstopper_01.text: Nature is full of poisons. It's only a matter of knowledge.

Dex4_Keystone_CrimsonAssault.text: One bleeding cut at a time.

Dex4_ZealotsOath_01.text: I believe in more than myself.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_53.text: A horrific task, but to protect Clearfell, I'd do it again.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_56.text: I will gladly honour this request.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_57.text: I will put the Eternals back in their graves.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_58.text: Corruption has twisted these wilds beyond recognition.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_60.text: I am sorry, Finn. But there was no other way.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_63.text: None will stop me from enacting vengeance.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_64.text: Must stay out of the mist!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_65.text: Your stolen strength won't save you!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_67.text: I will cleanse every last bit of Ogham.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_68.text: If I remember right, this was the home of Una's family. Could this be hers?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_69.text: It's been many years... Does the witch still live here?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_70.text: It seems no one is safe from Corruption.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_71.text: The very Grelwood turns against me!

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_73.text: There'll be no passage here... for now.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_74.text: For a moment, everything felt... alive...

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_75.text: By Fenumus, is that the wandering druid?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_76.text: How many more will I have to kill before this is through?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_67.text: What have they done to this woman?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_68.text: These statues are older than anything I've ever seen...

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_69.text: I must speak to the Hooded One.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_71.text: Did they really need all this to prove their faith?

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_74.text: This land of the dead has no end.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_77.text: This is proof of my strength.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_83.text: My dance with death is over.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_85.text: Being outnumbered did not mean I was outmatched.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_87.text: There is no more left to challenge me here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_88.text: This is a graveyard unlike any other.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_90.text: The Countess and her puppet King will not leave here alive.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_92.text: Slaves? This goes against everything the Ezomytes stand for.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_01.text: From burning sands to steaming bogs.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_05.text: Corruption infests even the trees here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_06.text: People? Here? Ah... not quite. Treasure hunters.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_08.text: The wisdom of the tribe. Like my clan's songs.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_09.text: There's the cynic this group needs for survival.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_10.text: Somehow, this feels hotter than the desert.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_11.text: The trees are alive with danger. I should take care.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_15.text: You were a magnificent creature. Go with the First Ones.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_18.text: Alva should know what to do with this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_21.text: The Vaal built their structures well, if it's survived all this time.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_24.text: I should ask Alva about this altar.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_25.text: This must be what the altar needs.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_27.text: Another one of these things? I should keep this, just in case.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_30.text: I need another Soul Core for this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_32.text: This seems like something Alva would know about.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_33.text: I should find a larger Soul Core for this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_34.text: This should fit in the generator.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_35.text: What is this size of Soul Core for?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_36.text: Is it supposed to spark like that?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_38.text: I have a bad feeling about this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_39.text: The Vaal jealously guard their secrets.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_41.text: Are those the Carver? Servi was right.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_44.text: Now the true search can begin.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_46.text: I have come to end you, witch!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_48.text: Your captured souls will suffer no longer!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_50.text: Honour demanded the deed be done.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_52.text: I suppose... I could look for treasure while I'm here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_55.text: I recognise the sound of a smithing hammer.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_56.text: It's safe to say he's seen me.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_57.text: If Oswald wants this gold, I'd better get rid of <i>{him.}

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_59.text: Ahh, so, you need the heat! Hahaha!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_61.text: You won't catch me off guard!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_63.text: I will put this hammer to good use.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_64.text: Every step is more disgusting than the last.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_67.text: Ugh... that was one fight... I won't tell tales of.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_70.text: This looks like exactly what I need.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_71.text: Don't ask where I found it...

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_72.text: How is there light within this ancient ruin?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_77.text: I do not fear the fire. It is mine to shape.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_81.text: The city as it was. Do they know their fate?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_83.text: There'll be no talking our way past this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_85.text: That was no death. What <i>{was} that?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_86.text: So this is the woman that will end this Empire.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_87.text: These people are already doomed. I will kill whoever I must.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_89.text: Heh. There is power in brutality.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_90.text: So, this is Doryani. How... arrogant.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_91.text: Vaal cleverness no longer surprises me.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_95.text: Yes, face me with your true might!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_97.text: I don't trust you, but you do have my respect.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_99.text: The Vaal do love their mechanisms.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_101.text: Nothing can stand against those graced by the First Ones.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_103.text: The skies belong to the First Ones.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_105.text: You never stood a chance, creature.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_107.text: I have passed your tests. This is over.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_108.text: I will carry the wisdom of the Vaal.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_113.text: They shouldn't have been out here unprepared.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_114.text: Of course. I would have done the same for anyone.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_117.text: If only I'd got here sooner...

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_118.text: Why were they out here like this?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_121.text: What manner of nest is this?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_124.text: This isn't the same fungus from back home... is it?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_126.text: Ahh... so this is why the treasure hunters do it!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_129.text: I'm... not sure what I expected.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_131.text: The children... they whisper... they cry for help...

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_133.text: Greatwolf, take my senses! The smell!

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_134.text: My head feels strange down here...

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_135.text: I'm going to kill every last creature down here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_141.text: I need to find more ingredients.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_142.text: Here are the mushrooms you seek.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_144.text: This might allow me to cross the molten gold.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_146.text: I should bring this to Oswald.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_147.text: I wonder what this is worth?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_149.text: Hmm, this one must be worth something, too.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_151.text: These pieces... they connect... but something's missing.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_152.text: The puzzle is solved. But what is it for?

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_153.text: Hah. A leader must live here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_155.text: A foul ritual took place here.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_01.text: At least we know this Ziggurat survives.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_02.text: I take it that wasn't a nightmare...

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_03.text: A man should not know his own fate.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_04.text: With allies like these, who needs enemies?

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_05.text: These invaders will not find an easy conquest.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_06.text: Wraeclast is protected. Tell your master.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_08.text: Let this be a message to your kind.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_12.text: I put my faith in the First Ones. Not luck.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_14.text: We must share songs when the opportunity arises.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_15.text: That's the cynicism of a veteran.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_17.text: Now I see why they need a warrior!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_18.text: I will finish this, or die trying.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_19.text: Surely... this will make a difference.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_21.text: There is nowhere I will not brave.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_23.text: Feels like the heat of the forge.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_25.text: I must keep my guard up, even here.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_26.text: I've had enough of places like this.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_27.text: Like the Red Vale back home...

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_29.text: Simple stone will not stop me.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_32.text: This is my kind of place.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_34.text: What kind of temple is this?

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_36.text: What shaped the land like this?

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_37.text: It's not as hot here as it should be.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_40.text: This is no river I know.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_43.text: Unknown shores make for dangerous travels.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_45.text: This is like no forest I've seen.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_46.text: There is beauty to be found in this deadly land.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_48.text: It has not rained here for many months.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_49.text: A forgotten space under the earth.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_51.text: This vast wound in the land may never heal.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_52.text: The living do not belong here.

Str4b_Intro_SalesPitch_01_01.text: I wanted very little for myself. A forge, a bed. They took all that away when they burned down my home. Give me one good hammer, and they will find out that there is nothing more dangerous than a man of peace roused to war!

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_62.text: That voice... It is bound to this place.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_64.text: Witches are not tolerated where I am from. I shall deal with her.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_65.text: These plains, though twisted... hold beauty.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_66.text: You must move on. I have. It is better this way.

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_67.text: No longer does this soil enrich life...

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_68.text: These walls are oppressive... Who chooses to live this way?

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_69.text: Must stay out of the fog!

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_70.text: Your Greatwolf cares not for you!

Int4b_Gameplay_A1_75.text: These must be the old man's.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_71.text: Balbala must be inside these doors.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_73.text: This passage is how the Traitor betrayed her people... Now I explore its secrets.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_74.text: I should consult with the Shade.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_76.text: This... is the last drop of Keth's glory.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_77.text: You who wake the dead... shall count yourself among them.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_85.text: The elements are mine to wield.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_84.text: I shall bend time itself to my will.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_86.text: Test me, Great mother of the Sands!

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_87.text: I have danced with death and survived.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_91.text: The Winter <i>{Sekhema} made you, Djinn... and I have unmade you.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_93.text: Come now, Shade. Share your truth with me.

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_94.text: It must be hard for some to understand our older traditions.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_160.text: This one... he would not survive the desert.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_44.text: The ground here is cracked and broken... What lives in these hives?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_46.text: That will need another Soul Core.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_47.text: This drowned city... disgraced by time, just like precious Keth. There is still a beauty about it, I admit.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_48.text: Your dark legacy ends now, tribe-witch!

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_50.text: It was my honour to assist you.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_51.text: Utzaal... You are impressive, even as a drowned ruin.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_52.text: Treasure... I suppose I can investigate.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_55.text: One of the forge... How long have they been in here?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_56.text: So... that's who is responsible for all this noise.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_57.text: It is time you retire, Corrupted one.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_62.text: Oswald will be very pleased with all this gold.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_63.text: A taste of the life of a treasure hunter. It has an appeal...

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_64.text: Garukhan's grace, what is that smell?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_65.text: Look at you now, Atziri. Surrounded by ugliness. Fitting.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_69.text: I will never be able to remove this memory from my mind.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_70.text: Well... at least it was worth it, I suppose. I should take this back to the Ziggurat.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_72.text: The feeling... Like the desert sun.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_77.text: The elements should remain our servants, not our masters.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_79.text: Is this... a portal... of time?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_81.text: I must say... the city in its prime is quite beautiful.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_82.text: There is unique power within this flesh.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_83.text: I feel they are not happy to see us...

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_86.text: Did she die? What just happened?!

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_87.text: Atziri really was as beautiful as tales claim.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_89.text: The Vaal also had brutal traditions.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_90.text: I offer this heart to you, Garukhan!

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_91.text: Ah, a statue of the man himself. I know not much of him, other than his brutality.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_93.text: It appears he has no idea who he is dealing with.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_96.text: The genius of the Vaal. I'm not impressed.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_100.text: If you betray me, I will scorch your flesh to the bone.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_101.text: The tale-women say... Chaos is a fickle master.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_106.text: I am up to the challenge.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_109.text: Ah. A Disciple of Chaos. Face me.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_111.text: I accept the wisdom of the Vaal.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_113.text: Oh no... how can I tell her of this?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_116.text: They should have been better prepared.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_119.text: How many fools are out here?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_120.text: They were lucky I was here.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_127.text: A magnifcent sight... but deadly all the same.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_129.text: This artefact bears the symbol of Chaos.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_130.text: A treasure room? I should take a look.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_132.text: This altar radiates a strange heat.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_133.text: Of course... It's a form of harnessed Corruption. Still, unpredictable.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_134.text: Foul savages worshipping broken sticks. Ugh.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_135.text: The tale-women never spoke of this kind of power.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_138.text: The water did not touch this place.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_143.text: Even these monstrous creations have a tale-woman... of a kind.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_144.text: I shall find the mushrooms you seek.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_146.text: Let's see what knowledge you possess.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_147.text: Thank you. I accept your gift.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_148.text: This will allow me to pass.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_149.text: Oswald mentioned looking for something like this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_151.text: I wonder the significance of this item.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_152.text: Time to bring these to Oswald.

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_155.text: It is finished... but what is it for?

Int4b_Gameplay_A3_157.text: The forces at work here... Unnerving.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_02.text: Did the world really just end?

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_08.text: This shall be the fate of any who threaten Wraeclast!

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_14.text: Luck means nothing to me. Only power.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_15.text: Life in the desert depends on such skills.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_16.text: Do I sense a great sadness behind his boasts?

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_19.text: So many bones... forgotten under the earth.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_13.text: Something sinister waits behind this door.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_21.text: This looks like it combines with something else.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_22.text: That's two. One more piece to find.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_27.text: The world is saved. Your duty is over.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_29.text: I will cleanse this disgusting place.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_32.text: The sand... reminds me of home.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_33.text: Like the Plains, in the ancient days.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_34.text: Perhaps a place to settle one day.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_38.text: Prisoners should not be caged. They should work.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_39.text: We built more impressive ancient towers.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_44.text: I've never seen anything like this.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_46.text: I shall cleanse Corruption wherever I find it.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_49.text: I should keep my time here short.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_52.text: The closest thing to home I've seen.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_55.text: A bath... might do me well.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_56.text: The air here is as dry as the Vastiri.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_57.text: I shall put them back in their graves.

Int4b_Keystone_Acrobatics_01.text: A dance with the scorpion leaves only the most agile.

Int4b_Keystone_AncestralBond_01.text: I carry the stories of my tribe.

Int4b_Keystone_BloodMagic_01.text: I shall draw my power from my very flesh.

Int4b_Keystone_EldritchBattery_01.text: Knowledge and faith are not enemies.

Int4b_Keystone_ElementalEquilibrium_01.text: The balance is mine to control.

Int4b_Keystone_EternalYouth_01.text: Master the flesh. Master the soul.

Int4b_Keystone_GiantsBlood_01.text: A legacy of the Third Pact.

Int4b_Keystone_GlancingBlows_01.text: Perhaps not such a reckless style as it seems.

Int4b_Keystone_Heartstopper_01.text: The scorpion's sting teaches valuable lessons.

Int4b_Keystone_HexMaster_01.text: Curse my enemies, that they may fall before me.

Int4b_Keystone_BlackflameCovenant.text: I forsake the element of Fire.

Int4b_Keystone_CrimsonAssault.text: The sands will run red with blood.

Int4b_Keystone_Bulwark.text: Charge like a rhoa, as they say.

Int4b_Keystone_VaalPact_01.text: The Vaal knew many dark secrets.

Int4b_Keystone_ZealotsOath_01.text: My faith shall keep me safe.

Int4b_Gameplay_ZombieIntro_01.text: Death comes swiftly here... I should keep moving.

Str4b_Gameplay_ZombieIntro_01.text: Clearfell could be in danger. I'd best hurry.

Dex4_Gameplay_ZombieIntro_01.text: This is like no sickness I've ever seen. Let's track down this... Miller.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_ZombieIntro_01.text: Well, that was unexpected. Now off to find this 'Miller' bloke.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_ZombieIntro_01.text: Rest now. I will see about this Miller.

Dex4b_Intro_01.text: I'm as proud an Azmeri as any—and just as deadly. Spear in hand and Spirit at me back, nought can stop me.

Dex4b_Ascendancy_01.text: Where all else fails, strength endures. By the will o' the Spirit, I will bring the very wilds to heel.

Dex4b_Ascendancy_02.text: The Spirit's guided me this far—but I must see it through. There's no line I'll not cross to save this world from ruin.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_01.text: That were a lucky break... so to speak...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_02.text: The <i>{rathin} here is stronger than I dared imagine.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_03.text: I swore I'd never wield one o' these again...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_06.text: So, <i>{this} is the 'sickness' I were warned about.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_05.text: At least your friend weren't here to see what you've become!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_07.text: What a sorry sight... Spirit, watch over this lot.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_08.text: Somethin' about that singin' sets me teeth on edge.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_10.text: No common beast could carve out somethin' o' this size.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_12.text: You'll torment Clearfell no longer, ya slimy bastard!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_14.text: I feel for the folk o' these woods, havin' their home soiled so.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_15.text: Aye, it yet lives... but by what foul means?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_16.text: This place bears the wounds of war.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_17.text: Over there. Bound to be runes in that pile.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_18.text: For folk who have already died, they fought well enough.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_19.text: Aye, I'm hearin' voices now... and yet the Spirit stays silent.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_20.text: Reckon that's the last of them.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_21.text: Let your blade fall where it will. Your fight's done now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_22.text: Must take a proper smith to forge runes like these.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_23.text: Here's hopin' I don't come to regret this...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_24.text: What manner o' bein' is that? Not o' the Spirit... yet there's no malice 'bout it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_25.text: Some o' these graves look near as old as the ancient Azmeri's.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_26.text: Calls to mind me Uncle Tarryck in his later years.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_27.text: Reckon it's time to put this Draven to bed.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_28.text: I have made it my war.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_29.text: Poor, misguided Eternal—you were already lost.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_30.text: Who're the Eternals to accuse anyone o' stealin'?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_31.text: Time this tomb earned its name and kept the Praetor's wife good an' buried.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_34.text: Aye, good luck to ya. You'll need it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_35.text: We Azmeri are older still, Eternal.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_36.text: That's you dealt with—now to track down your wife.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_37.text: Even your witchcraft couldn't save ya.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_38.text: Don't fret—your husband'll be along soon enough.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_39.text: Rest now. You're with your kin at last.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_41.text: Nowt but bad energy about that. I should ask Finn what's what.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_43.text: I've been itchin' for a good hunt!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_45.text: There's no beast alive can best me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_46.text: These halfwits seek to summon somethin' better left well alone.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_50.text: Summat tells me we've not seen the last of him.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_51.text: He hides his pain well. Reckon I know how that feels.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_53.text: Nary an inch spared the flames. These poor folk are beyond savin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_55.text: You had your chance to kill me. Now it's my turn!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_57.text: It's you who shoulda hanged... but this were just as good.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_59.text: Nowt to do with a tyrant but stick his head on a pike.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_61.text: Whatever it was, it's dead now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_62.text: There's the tyrant, in all his rotten glory.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_63.text: I've heard enough of the Beast to know feedin' it's a fool's game.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_64.text: Go on, then—come and get it!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_65.text: Must keep out o' the shadows!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_66.text: Come on then, Geonor—let's finish this!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_67.text: He howled like a wolf... but died like a dog.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_68.text: The <i>{rathin} has taken root. It must be cleansed.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_69.text: Plenty more filth where that came from—but it's a start.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_70.text: Looks well cared for, this does. Wonder whose it is... or was.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_71.text: Una will thank me for this, no doubt.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_72.text: Aye, these tired ears could use a tune or two.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_73.text: Looks to be a decent sort, that one.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_74.text: A woman without a place to call home... We have that in common.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_75.text: He's trouble, he is... but reckon it's the harmless kind.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_76.text: Them tools are about all what survived.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_78.text: <i>{Rathin} don't discriminate—it twists witches an' innocents alike.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_79.text: Not even the trees have escaped this rot!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_80.text: Nature's hurtin'... and only stoppin' this <i>{rathin} will set it right.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_81.text: Some strange magic's taken hold o' these roots.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_82.text: Nothin' like a spot o' song to chase away the gloom.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_84.text: I only hope the Azmeri've kept clear o' this rot...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_01.text: So <i>{this} is the Vastiri. I've never felt further from home...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_02.text: I'm no stranger to slayin' beasts. Aye, I'll make it work.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_03.text: That's him up there - the leader!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_06.text: The Azmeri'd make use o' this, to move from one hunting ground to the next.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_07.text: Minin' like this... It can only mean war's comin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_08.text: Smacks o' <i>{rathin}, this place. What are the Faridun playin' at?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_09.text: This here's no mine—it's a deathtrap.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_10.text: One survivor out o' hundreds—thousands, even...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_11.text: It's shut... Least this'll give the slaves a bit o' respite.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_12.text: Asala will have somethin' to say about this, no doubt.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_13.text: Me tribe'd name me traitor, too. Makes me wonder what this one's done.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_14.text: There's summat odd about this door... Feels like it were meant to stay shut.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_15.text: Let's have a look at this 'traitor', then.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_16.text: Better banished than left to rot for a thousand years...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_17.text: Someone were dead-set on keepin' this lass locked up.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_19.text: Hmm. It's got a warmth to it...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_20.text: Aye, suppose I could give it a go.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_21.text: Finally, some shade. I'm sweatin' like a stuck pig, I am.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_22.text: Who are these lasses then? They've an air of importance.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_23.text: Too late to stop the bloodshed... but not too late to avenge the fallen.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_25.text: Mess with <i>{rathin} and you'll pay a hefty price.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_27.text: See how he runs? Some king...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_28.text: That sand's as good as a fifty-foot wall.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_29.text: Now where's that Hooded One got to?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_30.text: Findin' water in a place like this... Easy job, that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_33.text: These sands'll suffer your poison no longer.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_34.text: To think this were here all along, buried 'neath the sand...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_35.text: Got to be the strangest pack animal I've ever seen...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_36.text: To the victor go the spoils.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_37.text: The Spirit needs no such shrines...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_39.text: Can't quite put me finger on it... but I sense a great pain about this place.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_40.text: This is it—the heart o' the grief I could feel.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_41.text: No wonder Halani never returned. She were right here, all along.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_43.text: Aye... your sufferin'll soon be over...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_44.text: Don't feel good, that... but at least her sufferin's at an end.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_45.text: Poor thing. Seems even Gods can be lost to time.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_46.text: Your sacrifice won't be forgotten. I swear it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_47.text: There's as many bones here as grains o' sand. Look around.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_48.text: Necromancers, eh? That'd explain all the bones.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_49.text: The stink o' death hangs heavy here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_50.text: Reckon I'll add a few more bones to the pile!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_53.text: There. Now someone can bring you back and see how ya bloody like it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_54.text: Just what I were lookin' for.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_55.text: A test o' mettle, is it? Suits me just fine.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_56.text: Whatever comes me way, I'm ready.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_57.text: Time to spill a bit o' blood.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_61.text: My ancestors' strength courses through me veins.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_109.text: The wisps guide me, and I them.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_64.text: That's a stinger and a half!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_67.text: Made short work o' you two.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_68.text: Messin' with time? Hardly seems fair...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_70.text: You can wind back the clock all you like. Makes no odds to me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_71.text: This valley were carved... and not by man, neither.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_72.text: This were forbidden... but what's one more taboo broken?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_74.text: Whoever put that sword there weren't messin' about.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_76.text: I'd better scarper before his corpse causes an earthquake.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_77.text: A little gem for a big brute—reckon it's mine now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_78.text: We've all we need to mend the horn. Best find Zarka.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_79.text: The Maraketh honour me. Now to prove I'm worthy of it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_80.text: Can only hope Zarka were right about this...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_82.text: To be laid to rest in the sky... Aye, I'd be fine with that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_83.text: Air's thinner up here. Makes me heart ache for home.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_86.text: You'll stay down there if you bloody well know what's good for ya.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_91.text: You've dodged me long enough... No more!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_96.text: That were some speech. The Maraketh are in good hands.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_97.text: Go on, tell me—who are you, really?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_98.text: I don't believe it—an ancient Azmeri, in the flesh...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_99.text: In all me wanderin's, I've not seen anything like this...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_01.text: This humidity... Spirit, how I miss the cool breath o' the mountains.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_03.text: More coming out o' the water!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_05.text: Everywhere I go, the <i>{rathin's} always a step ahead...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_06.text: What're these folk doin' out in the middle o' nowhere?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_07.text: She's friendly, like. A rare quality these days.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_08.text: She's sharp, that one—could come in useful.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_09.text: Pragmatism's all well and good, but that? That were summat else.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_11.text: This here jungle thrums with life.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_15.text: Sorry, big fella. That were a fight for the ages.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_16.text: Somethin' slithers in the dark... Best keep me eyes peeled.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_17.text: Time to get Alva down here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_18.text: Excellent. More wildlife what wants to kill me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_19.text: Plants what spew poison... Just me luck.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_20.text: A Vaal ruin... They're sure to have left me a few nasty surprises.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_21.text: Maybe if I'm quiet... these things <i>{won't} come to life and attack me...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_23.text: Surprisingly spry for a great big lump o' stone.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_25.text: So this here's a Soul Core? Don't much like contemplatin' what's inside...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_27.text: It actually worked! Wonders never cease.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_28.text: More Soul Cores. Must be another door somewhere needs openin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_29.text: Coulda sworn I heard a voice just now...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_30.text: More doors means more Soul Cores. Oughta look around.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_31.text: More Soul Cores? If you insist...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_32.text: Simmer down, ya great big pile o' rust.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_33.text: That thing bodes ill. Best ask Alva.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_34.text: This needs a bigger Soul Core. The little'uns won't do.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_35.text: Now to lug this back to the generator.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_36.text: This here's bigger than the rest—but to what end?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_37.text: Reckon it's workin'. Let's hope the other one's the same.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_38.text: That's done it. Right then, back to the main chamber.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_40.text: 'Shouldn't be a problem', Alva said. Aye, pull the other one.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_42.text: Any Azak what gets in me way is as good as dead.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_43.text: I despise the Vaal, but there's summat to be said for their craftsmanship...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_44.text: There. The lake should be all but drained by now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_45.text: An entire city, lost to time... Let's hope that weren't for good reason.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_46.text: These Azak give tribal life a bad name.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_47.text: Servi's got a score to settle, witch, and I'll make sure it's paid.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_49.text: Now that's a kill worth boastin' about.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_50.text: Spirit watch over us... A more disgusting sight, I've not seen.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_51.text: Killin' scum like that's reward enough...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_52.text: The size o' this place... I can hardly believe it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_53.text: Aye, what's another death-defyin' adventure, eh?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_55.text: Another lever, eh? Glad they've not given up the ghost just yet.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_57.text: Does he have a death-wish or what?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_58.text: Reckon he wants me off his turf.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_63.text: You owe me for this one, Oswald.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_64.text: Reckon I'll leave treasure huntin' to the 'experts' next time.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_65.text: Ugh—the stench o' this place... It's a wonder I'm still standing.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_70.text: Now there's a fight I hope to forget.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_73.text: It's bloody <i>{roastin'} in here. Unnaturally so.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_75.text: Is this a temple of Solaris... or summat else?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_78.text: Bein' stuck in here's enough to drive anyone barmy.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_82.text: So this were how the Vaal lived before we took 'em in...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_83.text: The heart of a giant, this'un.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_84.text: Summat tells me this were no welcomin' party.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_85.text: If it's a fight you want, it's a fight you'll get!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_88.text: Nowt but a monument to the Queen's vanity.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_89.text: I pity these folk... Death's hot on their heels and they haven't a clue.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_90.text: Blood everywhere... What in blazes went on here?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_91.text: Such horrors... What were me ancestors thinkin', welcomin' the Vaal?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_93.text: Nowt but darkness about this statue.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_94.text: Aye, were it magic or technology what did that?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_95.text: Touch one hair on Alva's head and it'll be the last thing you do!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_96.text: For a smart fella, you're a right fool.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_97.text: Hide behind your contraptions, why don't ya?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_100.text: Now will you accept your fate?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_102.text: A marriage of convenience if ever I've seen one...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_103.text: I know nowt o' this Chaos... but a fight's a fight.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_104.text: What's wrong with a good set o' stairs?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_105.text: I've yet to meet a beast I couldn't bring down!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_106.text: The bigger they are, the better the story.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_108.text: I've not seen the likes o' that beast before... and I hope I never do again.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_110.text: Three heads and not a brain between 'em!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_112.text: All that, and I'm still standin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_114.text: They make for a curious couple...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_115.text: A dead tribesman. Reckon Servi knows 'em?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_117.text: Thank the Spirit I were nearby.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_119.text: A cruel twist o' fate, this. Can only hope they rest easy.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_124.text: Can only hope the next lot learns from this'un.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_126.text: If only I'd got here sooner...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_129.text: One wrong move and these plants'll make sure it's me last.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_130.text: This jungle's home to some right strange creatures.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_133.text: It's dormant. Reckon I could get it workin', mind.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_134.text: This here bears the taint o' <i>{rathin}.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_135.text: This don't sit well with me... but aye, it's powerful, there's no denyin' that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_136.text: More rituals... Their depravity knows no end.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_137.text: The Azmeri'd scorn such a ritual... but needs must.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_139.text: Aye, this place reeks somethin' awful...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_140.text: This ain't no way to live.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_141.text: Reckon I'll put them out of their misery.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_144.text: Might be the only thing what's edible around here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_147.text: What's she got cookin' over there?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_148.text: Think she wants somethin' for her brew.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_150.text: Enough to get a stew goin', I reckon.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_151.text: I'm not one for drinkin' strange liquids, but this here seems safe enough.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_152.text: This here might help me get across.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_154.text: Oswald'd pay handsomely for this, I'd wager.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_155.text: This'll fetch a fair bit o' coin.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_156.text: This place is a right treasure trove!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_157.text: These trinkets are about all the Vaal were good for...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_158.text: Whatever this is, it's incomplete. Should keep an eye out for the rest of it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_159.text: One more piece should make this whole again.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_160.text: And that's the lot. As for where it goes... I haven't the foggiest.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_161.text: So this here's the Viper's den...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_02.text: Think I'll spare him the details about, well... killin' him and all that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_03.text: Can't say I trust her... but aye, she might prove useful all the same.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_04.text: There's a strange energy about this rift. Can only spell trouble.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_05.text: No fiend'll pass through these rifts as long I'm about.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_07.text: You'd need double the number to stand a chance against me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_08.text: It's alive with power, no mistakin' that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_09.text: I sense nowt but madness beyond.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_10.text: I know me own mind! You can't trick me!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_11.text: I've known fear all me life. Hasn't stopped me none.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_13.text: Aye, luck's nowt but a fool's comfort.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_14.text: He's a kind nature about him.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_15.text: There's a fine line between confidence and bein' full o' yourself.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_16.text: Strange wee fella, that's for sure.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_17.text: I'm usually one for protectin' nature, not blowin' it to bits.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_18.text: Nowt subtle about it... but aye, it does the trick.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_20.text: Reckon this'll slot into that door I found earlier.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_22.text: There. The door should open now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_24.text: It all comes down to this!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_26.text: I've given it me all. Can only hope it were enough.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_27.text: I hear the skitterin' of Arakaali's children...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_28.text: The only way out is through.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_29.text: Stand in one too place too long and the mud won't let me go.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_30.text: The forest burns, but does not die.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_31.text: I'll never get the sand out of me boots as long as I live.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_32.text: Aye, some good huntin' to be had here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_33.text: Spend every other day in a bog and I'll go barmy before long.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_34.text: Huh. It's as though the Vastiri were reborn.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_35.text: The prettier the plant, the deadlier it tends to be.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_36.text: A fortress is only as strong as the folk defendin' it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_37.text: This time, I'll escape <i>{without} a noose 'round me neck.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_38.text: These towers near touch the sky... Can only wonder what they hold.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_39.text: The heat o' the forge, made manifest.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_40.text: One slip here and the swamp'll swallow me whole.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_41.text: The Spirit's in all of us—it needs no such temple.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_42.text: Hives galore... Nowt for it but to clear 'em out.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_45.text: I've seen enough ruins to last a lifetime...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_46.text: I've seen many a forest... but nowt like this.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_47.text: It's like I'm back where it all began...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_48.text: The air's choked with poison—every breath's a battle.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_51.text: The air's thin up here. Reminds me o' home.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_53.text: Many a secret lies buried 'neath the earth.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_54.text: Aye, it's like I'm back in the Ranges.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_55.text: Forest looks parched—nowt but dry roots here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_57.text: I'm an expert at killin' what's already dead.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_58.text: For how long have these skeletons lain here, forgotten?

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_59.text: The shadows down here have a life o' their own.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_60.text: Let's see where these tracks take me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_61.text: Could do with a drink o' water, this place.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_62.text: That swamp smells summat fierce, even from up here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_65.text: Aye—pretty, like. Could almost convince yourself there were no <i>{rathin} about.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_66.text: All manner o' treasures in here. Oswald'd be beside himself.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_67.text: Plenty o' space for a good scrap.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_68.text: Spirit's breath... Reckon there's enough coin here to drown in.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_70.text: This lake seems of another world...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_71.text: Weren't we supposed to be allies?

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_18.text: Least I know I can kill you already!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_19.text: Killed plenty o' wolves in my time!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_74.text: Well now, what have we here?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_85.text: Wish I could say that were like old times...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_86.text: Last time I followed one o' these, it didn't exactly end well for me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_87.text: There! A sacred wisp! I'd best follow.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_88.text: Redemption's gotta start somewhere—why not here?

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_78.text: Suppose travellin' to another realm's no stranger than travellin' through time.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_79.text: This were no easy task... but I've a feelin' the real challenge is yet to come.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_80.text: Never thought leavin' home'd one day lead me to another realm.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_81.text: Still got me feet on solid ground. That's summat.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_82.text: Just when I thought I'd seen it all...

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_83.text: I've the feelin' this'll be a rough ride.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_84.text: Feels like I've stepped into a bad dream...

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_86.text: What's this, then? Dannig might know.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_87.text: What's this, then? A logbook o' some sort?

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_89.text: I know you're here, Olroth. You can't hide!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_91.text: You've the stench of evil about ya—I'll see to that!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_93.text: If only Dannig were 'ere to see this!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_94.text: More Nameless nonsense... Let's see who's daft enough to stand in me way.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_95.text: Don't need to know what this is to know it ain't good.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_96.text: You lot never learn, do ya?

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_97.text: Doubt I've seen the last o' them. Best find out more.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_98.text: If the king wants blood, I'll give him some - his own.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_103.text: Long live the king,' eh? The bastard.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_104.text: Plenty more where that came from!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_106.text: So this here's the Wildwood... Looks nowt like I imagined.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_79.text: A song woven with ill intent.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_80.text: The same fate awaits us all if Corruption isn't brought to heel.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_81.text: A traveller on a road you have long since abandoned.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_82.text: You lost her long ago. What remained was only a pale imitation.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_83.text: The Empire is dust. Clutching at its relics will not bring it back.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_84.text: One who does not fear the dead!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_85.text: You speak of mercy as if you ever offered it in life.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_87.text: Draven has fallen. But the hands that bound him to this world remain.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_88.text: Asinia returns to dust. Draven will not be far behind.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_89.text: Renly's tools. A small victory amidst all this ruin.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_90.text: In these dark days, even a friendly face is cause for suspicion.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_92.text: That wisp hums with a strange power. I cannot let it slip away.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_93.text: A restless spirit finds no peace. Let it rest now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_94.text: These roots are suffused with a strange magic.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_95.text: I've never known mushrooms to grow in this part of the forest.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_96.text: Wherever that swarm is headed, I'd best follow.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A1_97.text: What creature is capable of such violence?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_94.text: The Faridun trifle with things they do not understand.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_95.text: I see now... the Halani Gates... named not for a river, but a forgotten goddess.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_97.text: I will ensure the Maraketh remember you.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_98.text: Their battle must have shaken the very bones of the earth.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_100.text: May she guide the Ardura as a shepherd guides her flock.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_101.text: This Maraketh fought the raiders to their dying breath.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_102.text: Hm... There are parchments all along these walls.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_103.text: Serpent Clan insignia. They must be nearby.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_104.text: The Abyssals spread their tendrils across the Vastiri.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_105.text: The Third Pact forbade that I see this... and yet, it is wondrous to behold.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_107.text: Alas... I fear this is Lailuma.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A2_108.text: These footprints... A rhoa came this way.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A3_154.text: Cruelty of the Vaal is as vast as their ambition.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_59.text: To face what lies beyond... Perhaps then I will understand this feeling.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_61.text: Something stirs in me. A memory? Or a warning?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_62.text: Shaken I may be, but I will not falter.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_63.text: Those who wield fear often fall victim to it themselves.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_64.text: A trial of the mind as much as the body. I must not waver.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_65.text: They mean to frighten me. I will not let them.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_66.text: By the Dreamer's will, I overcome!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_67.text: Curious. Dannig may shed some light on this Logbook.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_68.text: A logbook... but what knowledge does it hold?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_69.text: Another step on the road less travelled.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_70.text: Olroth's shadow looms. A true test of my discipline.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_71.text: The weight of your sins has not lessened with time.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_72.text: I do not know your name. But I know what you are.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_73.text: Your story was never mine to know.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_74.text: Your fall is complete. At last.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_75.text: A dark ceremony awaits. I shall face it with resolve.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_76.text: An unfamiliar rite. I will learn its meaning soon enough.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_78.text: A strange custom. And a heavy burden.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_79.text: To seek the void is to invite it within. I must be careful.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_10.text: The King calls. I will answer.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_81.text: Not a world. Not a void. Something in between.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_14.text: A cheap ploy. You will not escape me!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_84.text: Return to the nothingness from whence you came!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_85.text: The way is shut. I must seek the missing pieces.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_88.text: The last piece of the puzzle. The door should open now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_25.text: This Lich is a growing concern!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_91.text: Once a home to toil. Now, a tomb for the forgotten.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_93.text: The higher one climbs, the greater the fall.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_94.text: Stone and roots stand unshaken. A land of quiet strength.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_95.text: Stillness invites death. I must keep moving.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_96.text: A land unmarked by time's cruelty.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_97.text: I care not for riches. All that matters is my mission.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_98.text: Familiar ground... but no less dangerous.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_99.text: The first of many. I must pace myself.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_101.text: Riches weigh heavy on the soul.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_102.text: Wealth without wisdom is an anchor, not a prize.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_104.text: The Wildwood's shadows conceal both danger and enlightenment.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EndGame_105.text: I have bested you once. I will do so again.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_79.text: One whose home still bears the scars of your conquest.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_80.text: As you once took everything from my people? Consider the debt paid.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_81.text: A fair price for your crimes, Eternal.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_82.text: A warrior of Ogham, come to see justice done.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_83.text: I expect no mercy—for I shall show you none.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_84.text: Enough talk! It's time we settled this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_85.text: So ends Draven's tyranny. But his witch still lingers.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_86.text: The Praetor remains. My work is not yet done.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_87.text: Father's tools... At least <i>{something} survived this devastation.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_88.text: Not easy to trust these days... but I sense no malice in him.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_90.text: A power unlike any I've seen!

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_98.text: If that is your wish. You have suffered long enough.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_99.text: It would seem Divinity is a double-edged sword.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_101.text: A warrior so vast—and a blade to match.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_103.text: A strong people require a strong leader.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_57.text: I will protect Wraeclast against all aggressors, otherworldly or otherwise.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_58.text: Strangely innocuous, for a pathway to another world.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_59.text: I feel as though I don't belong here... Better make this quick.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_60.text: We are safe from the Breach Lord's tyranny... for now.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_61.text: I don't fear what hides in the dark. I make it fear me.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_62.text: I am prepared for what may come.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_63.text: This place has become... twisted. What happened here?

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_64.text: I'm made of stronger stuff than that!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_65.text: A logbook... Dannig will want to see this.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_66.text: I suspect Dannig will know what to do with this.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_67.text: Once a battlefield... so it shall be again.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_68.text: Olroth's name still stains this place.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_69.text: You will pay for your treachery!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_70.text: I will stamp out evil, whatever the source!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_71.text: You will plague this land no longer!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_72.text: A battle for the ages... but <i>{I} remain!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_73.text: Just like the one back in Freythorn...

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_74.text: Whatever force lies ahead, I don't fear it.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_75.text: Dark forces at work here. I must put a stop to this.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_76.text: If this was meant to break me, it failed.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_77.text: This 'king' will meet his match, same as he did in Freythorn.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_11.text: I will stand before the King – and make him kneel.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_12.text: A screaming void... longing to be made real.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_80.text: A cowardly trick—it won't save you!

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_16.text: Your name will be remembered only for your ill deeds!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_85.text: One more and that gate should open.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_86.text: That ought to do it. Time to take this back to the gate.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_87.text: All roads lead here. So be it.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_24.text: That loathsome Lich caught us with our guards down!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_91.text: A perch for those who think themselves above the world.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_93.text: Cool air, soft earth... a false sense of peace.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_94.text: Strange to find beauty unspoiled. Pity it won't stay that way.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_95.text: A hoard of treasure. A monument to greed.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_96.text: A hard land. The kind that makes warriors... or breaks them.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_97.text: That's one down! I'm just warming up.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_98.text: The battle ends. I stand unbroken!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_99.text: There's wealth enough here to buy a kingdom... or burn it to the ground.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_100.text: Treasure piled high, but honour buried deep.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_101.text: This is like no place I've ever seen... Is it even real?

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_102.text: Dense woods, unseen threats. I must remain vigilant.

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_103.text: Your dark ambitions won't save you this time!

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_104.text: Did you not learn your lesson the first time?

Str4b_Gameplay_Endgame_105.text: I shall relish the chance to put you down again!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_87.text: Well that don't sound sinister at all...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_88.text: I liked the singing. Didn't so much appreciate the assault.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_89.text: Some poor sod who should know better—but here we are.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_90.text: Not my fault you hitched yer wagon to a corpse.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_92A.text: Didn't see your name on the door.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_93.text: Mercy? You don't know the meaning of the word.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_94.text: Then stop flappin' yer gums and get to it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_95.text: Right. Now to put his missus in the ground.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_96.text: If Draven's as much of a windbag, I'm asking for a bigger reward.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_97.text: This must be the old bloke's tools.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_98.text: Never a dull moment in Ogham, eh?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_99.text: That must be one of them wisps.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_100.text: That wisp there seems different to the others.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A1_101.text: Lot o' fuss for a little ball of light.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_111.text: Well... whatever happened 'ere, I doubt it's good news.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_112.text: So... this is what became of you.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_113.text: Alright, then. If fire's what frees you, I won't keep you waitin'.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_114.text: Rest easy, Halani. This world's a rotten place to be, anyway.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_115.text: I don't take kindly to traitors!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_117.text: Where's everyone gone? Better not have started the celebrations without me.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A2_118.text: Here here! First round's on me.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A3_162.text: Looks like someone had a bit of an accident...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_65.text: Oh, great. A Breachstone. I bet that'll lead somewhere nice and cozy.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_66.text: Ain't never had much sense. Might as well see how deep this hole goes.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_68.text: Well, that's one less nightmare cloggin' up reality. For now.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_69.text: If I go insane... well, I've had a good run.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_70.text: Well, if I come back talkin' to myself, at least I'll have good company.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_71.text: Ah, lovely. A nightmare with a sense of nostalgia.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_72.text: Could do with a kip after that! Or a stiff drink.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_73.text: This has Dannig written all over it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_74.text: This is as good as a treasure map, in the right hands.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_75.text: Right then—who wants to get blown up?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_76.text: Not your average expedition, this one. Better keep an eye out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_77.text: So you're the fella who stole the Triskelion Flame?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_78.text: Don't know who you are. Don't much care.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_79.text: Whoever you were, I'm sure you deserved it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_80.text: Well, Dannig—you can thank me later.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_81.text: More of this ritual stuff? Can't mean anything good.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_82.text: What have we got here? Looks like trouble.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_83.text: Ended the same as it did in Freythorn.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_84.text: Something tells me there's more where that came from.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_85.text: What's a little regicide between friends?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_86.text: Killin' kings is practically becoming a habit o' mine.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_87.text: Not exactly a royal court, is it?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_88.text: Nice trick! You'll have to teach me that one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_15.text: If you wanna get your arse beat again, then be my guest!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_90.text: I can see why you want to leave. Won't be letting ya, though!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_93.text: Almost there. Can't wait to see what's behind that bloody door.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_94.text: Right. No more runnin' about. Time to open that damn thing.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_95.text: No turnin' back now. Not that I ever have before.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_23.text: I bloody well knew we'd regret lettin' him out!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_97.text: Must be some good finds in here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_98.text: Another trek through the desert, is it? Lovely.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_99.text: Least I ain't knee-deep in filth... for once.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_100.text: Lot of rocks. Lot of trees. Lot of ways to die.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_101.text: Too exposed up here. Good for a view, bad for stayin' alive.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_102.text: Ahh, I could get used to this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_104.text: A fine spot for a bit o' carnage.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_107.text: Blimey... Is this what paradise looks like?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_108.text: Would be a shame for all this lovely gold to go to waste...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_109.text: Don't like this place one bit...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_110.text: Great. Been <i>{at least} a day since my last stroll through a haunted woodland.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_111.text: You just don't know when to quit, do ya?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Endgame_113.text: What's wrong? Didn't you get your fill of losin' the first time?

Int4b_Gameplay_A2_100.text: How did the tale-women forget you?

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_68.text: I cut him down, but the Breach still stirs. One battle does not end a war.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_69.text: Let them laugh. They will choke on it soon enough.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_91.text: A land unscarred. If only all things were so lucky.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_92.text: Gold always outlives those who covet it.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_93.text: A land of stories and warriors. Today, I write my own.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_94.text: A pirate's dream. A fool's downfall.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_95.text: A king's ransom, yet no king remains.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_96.text: A lake that mirrors the soul's deepest secrets. Let's see what it reveals.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_97.text: A place of old power—and older mistakes.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_100.text: Once a ruler, now a relic. I will bury you with the rest of them.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_101.text: Whatever you once were, it matters little now.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_102.text: For all your arrogance, it seems you bled like the rest.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_103.text: You burned the world around you. Now, you are but ash.

Int4b_Gameplay_Ritual_15.text: Your maze will not stop me, foul king!

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_108.text: One falls... but this tale is far from over.

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_109.text: All this, and still no one to match me!

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_110.text: I said I'd scorch your flesh to the bone if you ever betrayed me!

Int4b_Gameplay_Endgame_111.text: Traitorous Faridun... when will you learn?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_75.text: I know that voice, but there's something... <i>{different} about it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_76.text: Corruption will soon infest every last inch of this forest if I don't put a stop to it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_79.text: No? What do you plan to do about it?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_80.text: One who seeks to slay a witch.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_81.text: Can't say he didn't ask for it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_83.text: Not to worry—your wife won't be a widow for long.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_84.text: I'm sure Draven will be devastated... for the little time he has left.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_86.text: Stick to killing beasts that deserve it and we'll get along just fine.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_88.text: Power like this... as old as the roots beneath my feet.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_89.text: I've hunted many things. That one... I won't soon forget.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_90.text: What's done this to the roots?

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_91.text: Forest's overrun with fungi. Never been this way before.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_92.text: Never seen a swarm of locusts move with such purpose.

Dex4_Gameplay_A1_93.text: Don't know of any native beast that could do this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_93.text: Fools... What were the Faridun thinking?

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_94.text: So the Halani Gates weren't just named for the river...

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_95.text: Of course. You've suffered long enough.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_96.text: Forgotten by even her own people... I wonder what Zarka would make of this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_97.text: Varashta would thank me for this one.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_98.text: A sword through the throat... Certainly one way to kill a Titan.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_100.text: That certainly got the blood pumping.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_103.text: Looks like the Serpent Clan was here recently.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_104.text: Cracks in the ground... Something tried to burst its way through.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_105.text: Hard to believe we once walked the same world as these Titans.

Dex4_Gameplay_A2_108.text: Tracks in the sand... Someone rode a rhoa through here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A3_152.text: All this blood... and for what?

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_21.text: Still breathing. That's all that matters.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_59.text: As if Wraeclast wasn't cursed enough already...

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_60.text: Whatever's on the other side won't be expecting me. Their mistake.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_61.text: The Breach Lords rule here. Let them try to rule me.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_62.text: No one out there can best me, in this realm or the next.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_63.text: If something is watching us, it should pray I don't catch sight of it.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_64.text: A way in. No promise of a way out.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_66.text: Nothing but echoes... and echoes don't scare me.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_67.text: A logbook. Dannig ought to see this.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_68.text: Dannig could make more sense of this than me.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_69.text: People fought and died here... now all that remains is their trinkets.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_70.text: Olroth lingers, like a wound that won't heal.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_71.text: Dannig wants you dead—we have that in common!

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_72.text: So this is <i>{your} domain? Not for long!

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_73.text: Didn't catch your name! Not that it matters now.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_74.text: Didn't your mother ever teach you not to steal?

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_75.text: These rituals demand blood... but it won't be mine.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_76.text: This was put here for a reason. I should tread carefully.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_77.text: Seems Freythorn was just the start...

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_79.text: Perhaps I should show this 'king' how little I care for crowns.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_80.text: The king deigns to meet with me? It's about time.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_81.text: Time to cut the head off the snake.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_82.text: I'll track you down as I would any beast!

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_15.text: And I'll send you right back!

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_84.text: All that power, and still you couldn't hold your ground!

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_91.text: Never trust a place with more shadows than exits.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_92.text: What monstrosities make their home here?

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_93.text: No matter how high you build... nature always wins in the end.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_94.text: Wonder what undesirables I'll be faced with today?

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_95.text: Nice night for a stroll... if you don't mind the monsters.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_96.text: Too much sky, too much open ground. I don't like it.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_97.text: Dead men's treasures. Not much use to them now.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_98.text: Scent of blood on the wind.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_100.text: That's it? And I was just getting started!

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_101.text: Looks like gold... but feels like bait.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_102.text: This gold could be dangerous in the wrong hands.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_104.text: In another life, I might've called this forest home.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_18.text: How many times shall I teach you this lesson?

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_19.text: Want to die again, do you?

Int4_Gameplay_A1_94.text: Sorry sister. Now it's your husband's turn.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_95.text: An Azmeri... Superstitious types. Oh, the fun I could have.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_96.text: What sparkly magic is this then?

Int4_Gameplay_A1_97.text: Oh... This is potent with power.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_98.text: Perhaps this 'Spirit' is more than it seems.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_103.text: Well, well... It appears a sort of necromancy took place here.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_104.text: So, this is what it is to be Divine.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_105.text: If fire will bring you peace, so be it.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_110.text: She really takes herself rather seriously, doesn't she?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_160.text: Oh... bloody. I like this part of the city.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_65.text: Travelling to other realms? Count me in.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_66.text: A gateway to another realm... and perhaps, more power.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_67.text: The air crackles with power... and it's mine for the taking.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_68.text: I long to return to that place.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_69.text: It's them who should be afraid of me.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_70.text: Many have tried to intimidate me. None have succeeded.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_71.text: Is all this mist meant to scare me?

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_72.text: A twisted little dream... yet I was the real nightmare.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_73.text: I must show this to... whatever his name is.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_74.text: It's no forbidden tome, but I'll make do.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_75.text: History left its mark. Time to leave mine.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_76.text: Olroth's time is drawing to a close.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_77.text: Power comes at a price. But I don't mind paying.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_79.text: They're not very good at this, are they?

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_80.text: If you think I'll be cowed by some silly old ritual, you've got the wrong girl.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_81.text: Wouldn't be the first king I've killed... and surely won't be the last.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_82.text: Time to test the king's defences.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_84.text: Darkness, dust... and perhaps something more?

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_85.text: The land is cruel. I rather like it.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_86.text: A fine place for a tower. But better for a throne.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_87.text: Old places often hold old secrets. Let's see what this one offers.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_88.text: Dark corners hide secrets. Or corpses.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_90.text: Too much clutter, too little time.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_91.text: A place of blood and battle. My kind of arena.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_92.text: Gold is a poor substitute for power... but I suppose they made do.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_93.text: Just think what I could do with all this...

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_95.text: The Maji actually <i>{chose} to live here? No accounting for taste, I suppose.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_96.text: You've cheated death long enough, Olroth!

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_98.text: How the mighty fall... if you were ever mighty to begin with!

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_99.text: You had your time. Now it's my turn!

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_15.text: A cute trick – but a stall at best!

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_16.text: If I can't truly kill you, I'll just have to make you suffer... again, and again, and again.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_103.text: One corpse at my feet. I prefer a pile.

Int4_Gameplay_Endgame_104.text: A fun little game, but I always win.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_17.text: Gosh. How many times are you going to come back?

Int4_IntroLine_AscendancyPitch_03.text: In the fields of death and decay, I shall stand eternal. As one of them. As they are... of me.
