DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: We've arrived. I must've drifted off.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_02.text: I have no need of your preaching. I walk the Dreamer's path.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: A skilled craftsman. He may be of use.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: I shall seek out this Makoru.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_07.text: Her knowledge will serve us well in these waters.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_08.text: What drives them to mine this substance so fervently?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_09.text: This power is not of the natural world.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_10.text: I accept its power - but not its path.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: They trap the beast - but for what reason?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: Not a creature one can tame. Yet they're trying.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_13.text: Trapping rhoas? This is not nature. This is cruelty.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_14.text: The cruelty spreads. One cage was not enough.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_15.text: I am not here for your entertainment!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_16.text: They wanted blood. I gave them blood.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: This strength was earned, not given.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_20.text: A mining operation... but not the work of these kinfolk.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_21.text: This poor soul met a most violent end.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: This is where they're hauling the sulphite. But for what purpose?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_26.text: These creatures pay me no mind. Strange behaviour indeed.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_29.text: You wrought death and ruin. Now it calls you home.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_32.text: Hmm... He's lucky to be alive.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_33.text: You are free. Come - our ship awaits.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: This is no mere fog. Something else is at work here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: I should be able to piece the map together now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_37.text: The map is complete. Makoru may know the location.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_38.text: How much will the Kalguurans sacrifice in their pursuit of earthly gains?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_39.text: Two against one. So be it!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_40.text: The fog off this shore is thicker still. I must not lose my way.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_41.text: If her son still lives, I will find him.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_44.text: I do not answer to the dead!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_45.text: Your curse does not bind me!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_46.text: Dannig will know what to do with this better than I.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_47.text: Someone will know what to do with this better than I.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_48.text: Calls to mind Renly's craftmanship. Intriguing.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_49.text: Time to free this unfortunate soul.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_51.text: I fear I've made a grave error.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: These Karui canoes have long since been abandoned.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_54.text: From sand you came. To sand, you return!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: People once called this place home. Where have they gone?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_56.text: Yet more destruction. A tragedy indeed.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_57.text: A predator prowls in the deep.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_58.text: And now it comes to feed!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: Let that be the end of it!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_60.text: Kaimana will be pleased with this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_61.text: This may be of use to someone.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_62.text: That melody hides teeth... yet it beckons me.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_64.text: Could be of worth to someone. Rog, perhaps.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: If this brood is allowed to hatch, the island will soon be overrun.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_67.text: These poor souls... They've been petrified.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_68.text: Your song will not sway my conviction!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Your twisted song dies with you!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_72.text: A place steeped in tradition. I must be respectful.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: Even in death, they fight with honour.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_75.text: Bravery is not an attribute. It is a choice.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_76.text: Even the Mother of Death bears witness.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_78.text: I walk step where few outsiders have tread.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: Its meaning waits to be chosen.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_80.text: A Karui mark of honour... and one I accept.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_82.text: If you serve her, let her witness.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: A worthy foe... and, a strange one.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: I feel... lighter, somehow. Where am I?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: To speak with the Seer of All... Few are given that grace.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: The storm rages... yet something darker waits within.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: Many speak of justice. Few truly live it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_91.text: Faith should be a refuge. This became a tomb.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_92.text: Cruelty begets cruelty. Their fate was earned.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_93.text: I must find a way through.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: All these people, left here to die...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_96.text: A key. This could prove useful.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: I'll need a key for this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_99.text: Power misused. I will wield it better.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_100.text: The Eternals left these prisoners to drown... Is there no limit to their cruelty?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_102.text: This wasn't built to hold a mere man.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_103.text: How long has this door remained shut?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_114.text: Long have you suffered. May rest find you now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_115.text: Here, strength is proven - or lost forever.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_116.text: Too many have died by your talons. That ends now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: No more will you darken the skies.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_120.text: A shrine - and not Karui in nature.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Another of those shrines. The Karui aren't the only ones who call this region home.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_122.text: I follow in the footsteps of countless Karui warriors.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: It is no wonder the Karui consider this a place to prove yourself.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_124.text: Kindness is a rare thing in Wraeclast. I hope it's no mirage.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Many promise 'Utopia'. Few can deliver it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_127.text: The air is still. But something echoes in the distance.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Hmmm... what is going on out there?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Kanu will pay for his betrayal!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: These bells are not what they appear.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_131.text: Another bell. This one exudes a different energy.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: This design is unlike anything I've seen.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_133.text: May your misguided Order soon follow!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: The scale of this excavation... Perhaps the Order have found something of use.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_135.text: They have left no stone unturned. What is it they seek?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Little separates you and the gods you abhor!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: Perhaps this is where our quest ends.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_140.text: Your tribe has much it could learn from you - as do we all.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: No guards... but blood on the wind.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_142.text: The fever has taken them. Then mercy is all that remains.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: Even the land of his tribe, he tramples without thought.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: I can only hope she's not the sole survivor.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_145.text: I am glad she survived, at the very least.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_146.text: All this blood... on Tavakai's hands. This has to end.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_150.text: You would doom your own people in your quest for 'redemption'!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_151.text: So this is where the map leads...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_A4_152.text: This appears to be Kalguuran equipment. I should talk to Dannig.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: As long as you're payin', I'll do what you ask.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: Mortimer wasn't kidding. These things came to wreck shop.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: Cracks like that don't come from quakes.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: Won't be crawlin' out of that again.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: Don't much like the look of that...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: That's one hole plugged. Hope it holds.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: Clearfell's safe. Well... safer than it was before.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: Get back here, you little runt!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: Looks like the real mess starts down there.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Well, in we go. Down where the real filth lives.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: I've killed enough undead to know how this ends!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: Great. Now I get to lug some old sod's finger around.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: It's all gibberish to me. Maybe the Hooded One knows more.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: Looks like someone dug too deep... and let the darkness in.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: Bleak down here... Let's not hang about.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: Ugh. Damn finger's twitchin' in my pocket.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: Guess this is what the finger's for. Lovely.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_20.text: Oof. The ol' tailbone will be feelin' that one for a while.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: Ugh. You're even uglier than I imagined!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Dead - or close enough. About bloody time!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_24.text: Bet this fetches a price... assumin' it ain't cursed.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: Wouldn't exactly wear it to a party... but could be good in a fight.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Now that's a voice that sends a chill down the spine...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_29.text: Locked up tight. Gonna need more than guts to crack it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: Ugh... Back's killin' me. Guess we're here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_02.text: Look, mate - whatever you're sellin', I ain't buyin'.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_03.text: I think me and these Kalguurans might just get along.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: Metalwork like this, he'd have made a killin' back in Trarthus.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: Got my sea legs. Now to get to work.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_08.text: Anything kinfolk want that bad? Best left buried.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_09.text: Oh boy, do I wanna touch that.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: What're they plannin' to do with this?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: Somethin' tells me they ain't keepin' these beasts for conservation's sake.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_13_01.text: A rhoa's a damn sight smarter than any kinfolk. Smells better, too.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_13_02.text: A rhoa's a damn sight smarter than any kinfolk. Smells better, too.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_14_02.text: What? No love for your new champion?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_15.text: Sorry, mate. That's the way it goes sometimes.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_16.text: That's the last time I try to do a good deed!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_17.text: In another life, I'd've done well in the Trarthan pits.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Too clean for kinfolk. This one's man-made.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: These creatures would do the same to me, given the opportunity.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_20.text: Oof. Feel like I'm being slow-roasted here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: That's for gettin' in my way.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_23.text: They're not attacking... I oughta get me one of these.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_24.text: Figures! No one ever wants to share.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_26.text: Ain't the boss of much now, are ya?!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_27.text: No one told me to bring a gift!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_29.text: A prisoner... Surprised he's still breathing.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_31.text: Why does this fog make me feel... strange?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_32.text: Oho! A map! Wait a minute... oh, bollocks! Only part of one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_33.text: That's the map done. Now for the treasure.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: That's the map done. Hope Makoru ain't expecting a share of the spoils.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: Another Kalguuran wreck. Lotta gold spent to get nowhere.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_37.text: I don't know what this fog's doin' to me, but it ain't good.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_38.text: Hate to say it, but if her son's still alive, I'll eat my boots whole.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_40.text: This one's gonna blow too, ain't it?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_48.text: That may not have been my smartest decision.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_49.text: These boats look to have been here a while...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_51.text: Let's hope there ain't any more where that came from.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: Somethin' tells me these people didn't just up and move.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_53.text: More destruction. These folk sure picked the wrong place to settle.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_54.text: Whatever's making that racket sure ain't friendly.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: I'm glad I'm up here and he's down there!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_56.text: Just had to open my bloody mouth, didn't I?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_57.text: I'll never look at a shark the same way again.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: This'll be worth something to someone.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_60.text: She'll have to do more than sing if she wants to lure me in.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_62.text: If I know Rog, he'll be wantin' this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_63.text: That's a lotta eggs. Looks like the siren's assemblin' a whole bloody choir.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_64.text: Heh. Think I ruffled her scales.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: Could end up like these poor sods if I ain't careful.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_66.text: I've had just about enough of your screechin'!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_69.text: Must be nice to swoop in after someone else has done all the hard work.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Long way to fall... but what a view on the way down, eh?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_71.text: You lot ever heard of restin' in peace?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: Bravery, sure. Or stubbornness. Same thing.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_75.text: Sorry, ancestors. Hope this ain't sacrilege.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_76.text: I walk among the dead. Just another day in Wraeclast, eh?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Won't say no to a bit of ink.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_78.text: I've picked worse in my time.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: A monkey? Not exactly what I expected...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_82.text: Before you go cryin' animal cruelty, remember you started this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: Not bad. Should keep an eye out for more of these.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_85.text: Turns out dying's not so bad!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_86.text: Always imagined death would be more... deadly.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Seems like a good place to lock someone up and throw away the key.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: It's easy to talk of justice. Living it's another matter.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: Faith don't count for much when nobody's listenin'.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: Can't say these guards didn't deserve it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: Well well, look what turned up.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_97.text: Power's power. Don't much care where it comes from.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: Locked up and left to rot... Poor bastards never stood a chance.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_100.text: Thick as a banker's skull. Whatever's down here, they didn't want it gettin' out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_101.text: It's a damn bathhouse down here - and not the fun kind!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_102.text: Look, mate, I didn't put you here!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_108.text: No need to thank me for freein' ya.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Ugh, that stench... Is this an island or a bloody hatchery?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Could make a mean omelette with all these...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_111.text: Here we are - the big ugly bird herself!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_114.text: That's for making me see... all that!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_115.text: Who'd build a shrine on this cursed rock?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_116.text: More shrines. Am I following them, or are they following me?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: This is a Karui rite of passage? I'll take Trarthus any day.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_118.text: Great. Whole flock's watchin'. This should go well.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: Don't suppose any of these friendly folk could offer me a beer.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_120.text: Friendly faces. Pointy spears. Something's not adding up.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Can't wait to see this Utopia they've been banging on about.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: What's all that noise? Seems I didn't get the invitation.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_125.text: Wait 'till I get my hands on that Kanu!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: This bell ain't just for show.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_127.text: Another bell. Let's give it a ring, see what shakes loose.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Don't know who carved this... but it looks too old to be the Order.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: The Twilight Order aren't sendin' their best, are they?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: Big operation. Whatever they're after, they want it bad.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_131.text: What is it they're hoping to find here?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: Oi! You're really pushin' your luck, lady!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_133.text: The whole place is comin' down!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: This is it, then. All roads lead here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_137.text: You won't regret this... I hope.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: The old codger's back where he belongs.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: Tavakai tore through the damn thing like paper...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: Still kickin'. Knew she had some fight in her.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: More wreckage. Least I know I'm going the right way.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_147.text: If this is redemption, I'll stick to damnation.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_148.text: Prattle on all you want. We both know who's responsible.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_149.text: Oh, I do love a good treasure hunt!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_150.text: If the Kalguurans grabbed all the good loot, I'll be bloody livid.

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_04_01.text: A face only a mother would love!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_04_02.text: A face only a mother would love!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_02_01.text: Let's see what you're made of!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_02_02.text: Let's see what you're made of!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_02_03.text: Let's see what you're made of!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTwilightGuard_03_01.text: Take your Utopia and shove it!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTwilightGuard_03_02.text: Take your Utopia and shove it!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTwilightGuard_03_03.text: Take your Utopia and shove it!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageWerewolf_03_01.text: Can see your fleas from here!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageWerewolf_03_02.text: Can see your fleas from here!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageWerewolf_03_03.text: Can see your fleas from here!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageSpider_02_01.text: Too many eyes, too many legs!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageSpider_02_02.text: Too many eyes, too many legs!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageSpider_02_03.text: Too many eyes, too many legs!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageSpider_03_01.text: You'd look good under my boot!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageSpider_03_02.text: You'd look good under my boot!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageSpider_03_03.text: You'd look good... under my boot!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTeracottaGuardian_01.text: Time to smash me some pottery!
Time to smash me some pottery!
Time to smash me some pottery!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_01.text: What a lovely little nap. Pity it had to end.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_02.text: Yes, yes, the world is ending. I've heard it all before.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_05.text: Blunt. Brave. Possibly stupid. Time will tell.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_06.text: Charter in hand... time to find a ship.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_07.text: Kalguuran, Karui, I don't care. As long as your ship floats.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_08.text: Funny little beasts with big ambitions. What are they digging for?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_09.text: This radiates power. I must claim it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_10.text: Why cage what you can control?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_11.text: Weaklings. They cage what they fear.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_12.text: What do they want with rhoas?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_14.text: You want a show? Ha! I'll give you a show!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_17.text: Bah! Should've left you for dead!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Strength, stripped from a corpse. The best kind.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_19.text: This looks too sophisticated for kinfolk.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_20.text: Excuse me fellow... where's your face? Hahaha!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_21.text: They're bringing the sulphite <i>{here}? What are those little beasts up to?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_22.text: This heat... Hot enough to strip flesh.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_25.text: Seems they don't want to share!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_28.text: I like your lair! Shame about the occupant.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_30.text: Well, well, aren't you a lucky one?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_31.text: Saved your life. Try not to waste it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_32.text: What a strange feeling... Is it the fog causing this?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_33.text: A map... or at least, part of one.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Time to piece together this puzzle.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_35.text: The last piece of the puzzle. I should show this to the Karui girl.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_36.text: A pirate's life always ends the same: as a pile of bones on some forgotten shore.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_37.text: The Kalguurans throw ships away like spoiled meat.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_38.text: We'll see if she speaks the truth about this metal.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Rare. Dangerous. Volatile. I like it already.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_146.text: All this had better be worth my time.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_44.text: Haha! I knew it was all a ruse!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_45.text: I have to hand it to them - <i>{that} was good.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_46.text: I feel no human souls here. Something's wrong.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_48.text: Clawed your way up from the depths... time to put you back!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_49.text: Something tore through here... Wonder if it's still close.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_50.text: Another corpse of a camp, picked clean.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_52.text: Whatever that belongs to... at least it's down there.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_54.text: A shark on land... Almost a pity I had to kill it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_55.text: That singing... My coven calls to me... A deception!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_57.text: Not to my tastes... but Rog may want it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_58.text: All these eggs... Someone's been busy.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_59.text: Oops! Don't think she liked that...

Int4_Gameplay_A4_60.text: They've been petrified. Wish I knew how to do that.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_61.text: I will rip my sisters' voices from your throat!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_64.text: One less thing to track down.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_65.text: The Karui do love their monuments, don't they?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_66.text: Ghosts of Karui past? Dying once wasn't enough, hmm?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_67.text: Kaom's fire - snuffed out. What's next?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_68.text: And I smile upon your flattery.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_69.text: At last, something in this world recognises my talent.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Whoever tried to hide this didn't do a very good job.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_71.text: The line between life and death grows ever thinner.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_75.text: The Karui are full of surprises!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_77.text: If you weren't already Navali's, I'd claim you as my own.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_81.text: The Mother of Death... We'd make a good pair.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_82.text: Nice spot for a prison. Not so great if you want to escape.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_83.text: Anyone who makes justice their identity must be <i>{astonishingly} dull.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_84.text: Goes to show how far faith gets you.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_85.text: Got what they deserved, by the looks of it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_86.text: I must find yet another mechanism.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_89.text: A key. Don't mind if I do.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_90.text: There you are, you slippery little thing.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_93.text: So much suffering. Why not just kill them?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_94.text: Bloody freezing! Though, I needed a bath...

Int4_Gameplay_A4_95.text: With an ominous door like that, how can I resist?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_97.text: This 'Izaro' sure did a number on you.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_101.text: Have to be quicker than that!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_104.text: Nesting grounds. I could smell the filth a mile off.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_105.text: My my... aren't you a sight?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_108.text: What a glorious mess! I'll treasure the memory.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Whatever that shrine is, it's not Karui.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Another one. If only I knew what they meant...

Int4_Gameplay_A4_111.text: The Karui are brave to hunt here, I'll give them that.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_114.text: Such sweet smiles... such sharp spears. Curious.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_115.text: This 'Utopia' sounds like a dreadful bore.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_116.text: Arastas again. Let's make this quick, before someone smiles at me.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_117.text: Ugh... What is going on out there? They sure know how to waste a girl's time.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_120.text: Another bell. What does this one do?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Ancient markings... and too intricate for those Order halfwits.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_122.text: Down you go, you oversized puppet.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_123.text: All this secrecy... what are they hiding?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_124.text: Impressive architecture. No wonder they love it so.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_125.text: I was about to say the same thing myself.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Idiot! You're bringing the whole place down!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_127.text: Here we are at last. Let's hope it was worth the trip.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Yes, yes, hello to you too.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Hmm. I could just kill my way in... maybe next time.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_130.text: I don't <i>{plan} to desecrate anything... but sometimes it can't be helped.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_131.text: I see you haven't keeled over just yet.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_132.text: I usually enjoy the scent of death... but not like this.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_133.text: Ugh, blood fever... They're as good as corpses already.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_134.text: Tearing down your own walls... A fitting start to a massacre.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_135.text: You're lucky I was passing by.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Get out of here, before you end up like the rest of your tribe.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_137.text: You've had your fun! Now it's my turn.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_138.text: If Tavakai wants to slaughter his entire tribe, he's going about it the right way.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_139.text: Give me back my ship captain!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_142.text: It would seem your ancestors disagree!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_143.text: This had better not be a wild goose chase.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Something claws its way up from below. Time to find out what.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: What pretty little cadavers they make.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: Something foul stirs beneath the surface.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: The darkness subsides. What a pity.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: A wound in the earth, left to fester.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: Job's done - for now. I expect there'll be more where that came from.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: What a treat! We must do it again sometime.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: Don't go hiding on me now.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: How deep does this rabbit hole go?

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Curiosity kills. But I don't mind a little death.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: A lich that won't serve me is better as ash!

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: A cursed little keepsake... and not just for show.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: Ancient secrets! Hmm... less fun when I can't read them.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: Abyssal spoor... Still fresh. How delightful.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: Sealed with something... foul. I won't be going any further just yet.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The finger twitches in my pocket...

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: Well, only one thing for it...

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: They'll pay for making me do that.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: Is that supposed to impress me?

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Dragged from the depths... and into my hands.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: That voice... its power frightens me.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Whatever's waiting below... it'll have to wait a while longer.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_01.text: A fight to the death! Delightful.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Don't you recognise a fellow sister? Ugh, no matter!

Int4_Gameplay_P1_03.text: Witches, were you? Could've fooled me.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_04.text: Power clings to this stone... Old and waiting.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_05.text: That did <i>{something}. Can't wait to find out what.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_06.text: Whatever these do, I doubt they're just for show.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_07.text: Ha! You think this circle can hold me?

Int4_Gameplay_P1_10.text: Poisoned roots, whispering trees... I rather like it here.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_14.text: How many people did you gift to your precious Thane?

Int4_Gameplay_P1_15.text: One less sycophant at the Thane's feet.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_16.text: All this wealth... I'm sure they won't miss a coin or two.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_18.text: Sorry to interrupt your little dance!

Int4_Gameplay_P1_19.text: Ogham is free of your torment.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_01.text: What a dump. Too much sand.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_02.text: I step on it - it responds. How intriguing.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_03.text: Awfully big head, yet not enough brains to avoid near-extinction.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_05.text: Nothing like a tomb to lighten my mood.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_07.text: I suppose I could help... maybe...

Int4_Gameplay_P2_09.text: Whoever she was, she's gone now.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_10.text: Seems the Serpent Clan's already slithered through here.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_11.text: Power dwells here, waiting to be claimed.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_13.text: The djinn are silent. Their power is spent.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_14.text: Ugh. I'm already bored of you.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_16.text: As if this place wasn't hot enough already...

Int4_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Fire and bluster - that's all you were.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_18.text: The Black <i>{Sekhema}... Sounds like a woman of good taste.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_19.text: All this effort to honour the dead. Why not raise them instead?

Int4_Gameplay_P2_20.text: The Maraketh loathe necromancers. Good thing these <i>{Sekhemas} aren't in any state to protest.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_21.text: If they're offering power, who am I to refuse?

Int4_Gameplay_P2_24.text: Dry as a bone... and just as inviting.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_25.text: Perhaps this will fill the well.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_26.text: A well like this could come in handy.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_27.text: Call yourself a prince? I've seen corpses more fit to rule!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_01.text: Well hello, my little eight-legged friends...

Int4_Gameplay_P3_02.text: Sometimes, we must kill the things we love.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_04.text: So much noise. So little venom.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_05.text: The Azmerian is out of her mind. Fun!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_08.text: I'll pluck the feathers from your frozen carcass!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_09.text: Your corpse belongs to this mountain now.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_12.text: Even the dead shiver up here.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_13.text: Strange. Why don't the monsters attack him?

Int4_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Glad that frozen heap's behind me.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_17.text: If the Vaal still lived, I'd strangle them all myself!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_18.text: When will they learn not to stand in my way?

Int4_Gameplay_P3_19.text: A tomb... of the living? How unnatural.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_20.text: The time of the sparrow has come, or some such nonsense.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_21.text: As much as I'd love to kill you, Doryani and I need your help.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_01.text: What's this? Ancient power, still pulsing...

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_03.text: This light now glows... And there are others, still waiting to be lit.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_06.text: So many beacons, so little time.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_07.text: Ah, just when the tedium was threatening to set in.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_08.text: The final beacon... almost within reach.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_09.text: These seem to be a kind of beacon.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_15.text: This device... I sense the temple is bound to it.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_16.text: I can feel the structure shifting from within.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_17.text: Every stone hums with ancient power.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_18.text: Hmm... not as I remember it.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_19.text: A dramatic entrance! Pity it won't save you.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_22.text: Brutes with big hammers... How dull.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_24.text: Seems the operation was a success!

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_26.text: You died as you lived - pointlessly.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_27.text: Another brute goes to their death.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_28.text: So much strength, so little sense.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_29.text: Flesh and steel - both fragile in their own ways.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_33.text: To bind a soul within crystal... I'm almost jealous.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_34.text: How do I learn this power?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_35.text: Greedy Vaal... Save some souls for the rest of us!

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_37.text: Such pretty armour... all to adorn a corpse.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_38.text: They'll die no matter how well-armed they are.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_39.text: All the armour in the world... and still, you die.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_40.text: Up to no good, are we?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_41.text: What is going on in here?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_42.text: Another Atziri lapdog barking for its master.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_44.text: What do you know? More Corruption.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_45.text: The Corruption here is particularly potent.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_46.text: The kind of science I can get behind.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_49.text: What in the world... did I just do?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_52.text: You've trained enough. Time for the real thing!

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_54.text: Time this generator served my ends, not theirs.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_55.text: Power enough for even me... almost.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_56.text: Ah, my own little army of victims. How delightful!

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_57.text: These constructs spoil the fun. Give me blood to spill!

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_58.text: Marvels of technology! I look forward to destroying them.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_59.text: Why sacrifice what you could bend to your will?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_60.text: The Vaal waste perfectly good thralls.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_61.text: The Vaal would sacrifice their own shadows if they could.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_63.text: A forge... What <i>{don't} they have in here?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_65.text: No amount of smithing will save your empire from ruin.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_66.text: The Vaal never did know when to stop cutting.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_67.text: Not exactly elegant... but certainly inspired.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_68.text: Some splendidly deranged experiments in here.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_70.text: Still playing with your little gems, are you?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_71.text: Their ambition burns as bright as their failure.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_74.text: Was that supposed to startle me?

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_76.text: Discipline and delusion, drilled into every skull.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_77.text: Fusions of flesh and steel... How interesting.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_78.text: All this will do much better in my hands.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_79.text: Time to meet the man behind it all.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_80.text: This place is in need of a new Queen.

Int4_Gameplay_Incursion_82.text: Atziri's untold riches - now all mine.

Int4_IncursionTempleEnterSubsequent_01_0.text: What power will I claim today?
What power will I claim today?
What power will I claim today?

Int4_IncursionTempleEnterSubsequent_03_0.text: These temples... always rearranging their guts.
These temples... always rearranging their guts.
These temples... always rearranging their guts.

I do love to play with fire.
I do love to play with fire.
What's life without a little risk?
What's life without a little risk?
What's life without a little risk?

Int4_IncursionTreasureRoomSubsequent_01_.text: It's like they're giving this stuff away.
It's like they're giving this stuff away.
It's like they're giving this stuff away.

Int4_IncursionTreasureRoomSubsequent_02_.text: The treasure is mine once more.
The treasure is mine once more.
The treasure is mine once more.

Int4_Wild_EngageWitch_04_01.text: Anything you can do, I can do better!

Int4_Wild_EngageWitch_04_02.text: Anything you can do, I can do better!

Int4_Wild_EngageWitch_04_03.text: Anything you can do, I can do better!

Int4_Wild_EngageCorruptedMonster_03_01.text: What a pretty corpse you'll make!

Int4_Wild_EngageCorruptedMonster_03_02.text: What a pretty corpse you'll make!

Int4_Wild_EngageCorruptedMonster_03_03.text: What a pretty corpse you'll make!

Int4_Wild_EngageSpider_02_03.text: Which leg shall I pluck first?

Int4_Wild_EngageFaridun_01_02.text: May your corpse adorn the desert!

Int4_Wild_EngageFaridun_01_03.text: May your corpse adorn the desert!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Do not fear. If evil seeks entry, I will beat it back.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: Clearfell cannot fight this threat forever. I must do my part.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: Their deaths bring quiet - but not peace. Not yet.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: The wound closes. But the will behind it remains.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: I do not require thanks - but you are welcome all the same.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: It flees not in fear - as if called by something deeper still.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: The wound runs deeper than I feared.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Not made by hands... but by hunger.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: You cling to life. I will cut it free!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: This finger... Cold, but not lifeless.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: This language is unknown to me. The Hooded One may know its meaning.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: That spire... Vaal work, without question.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: The same black rot as before... The Lost Men unearthed more than just bone.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: Life and death are out of balance here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The finger stirs. This place calls to it...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: A mouth made of earth... and it seeks to swallow me whole.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: It resists me. I lack the means to go on.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_20.text: I'd rather not do that again.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: You are not of this world. And you are not welcome in it!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_22.text: I will put you down as many times as needed.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Return to the depths that spawned you!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: Power shaped in the bowels of the deep.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Born of darkness... but not bound to it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: How long was I sleeping? Nevermind... I should find Alva.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: He shapes more than metal. That much is clear.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_05.text: He's bold, for one so young.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: From the Vastiri to the ocean... My travels have taken me far indeed.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_07.text: She knows these waters. She will guide me well.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_09.text: It hums with power... No wonder these little beasts kneel.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: Caged strength. They fear what they cannot tame.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: Another. What war are they preparing for?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_13.text: Even the wilds are not spared their chains.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_15.text: They demand blood. I will give it to them!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_16.text: Flee! Before you meet the same fate!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Caged for too long! Turned vicious!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: The kinfolk aren't the only ones scouring this island.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_21.text: This volcano is no forge. Why do they bring the sulphite here?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: Solerai herself would swelter in this heat.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_25.text: Power makes believers of us all.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_26.text: Kinfolk do not share power, it seems!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_28.text: Let this volcano be your tomb!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_32.text: You are chained no longer. Go where you will.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_33.text: The fog here clouds my will.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Only a piece. The rest must still be out there.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_35.text: The map is complete. Its secrets will follow.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: The map is complete. Makoru will know how to read it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_37.text: Bones in a cave. A fitting end for a thief.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_39.text: I will search for this Verisium... and her son, if he yet lives.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Hah! Your curse holds no power over me!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_152.text: I see why Verisium is so coveted.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_45.text: Strange alloy... I'll ask Dannig what he knows.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_46.text: These spikes... The Ezomytes runed something very similar.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_48.text: A cunning trick. May it not bear a bitter cost.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_49.text: Even paradise can sour. Something here has turned.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: They built... then fled. An all-too-familiar story.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_54.text: Such heavy footfalls... I should be careful.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: What does that fin belong to?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_57.text: This island grows stranger by the minute.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_58.text: Kaimana will soon have a fin for her brew.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: Someone may want this. It may yet prove useful.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_60.text: That singing... a trap, woven in song.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_62.text: Hmm. Sir Rog may find a use for this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_63.text: This is no mere spawn - it's an army in waiting.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: Each and every one of them, turned to stone...

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_66.text: You will not find me such easy prey!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_68.text: Her song ends, and her spell breaks.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_70.text: So this is where the Karui come to test their mettle...

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_71.text: Even death does not dull their pride!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_72.text: A Maraketh earns her blessings, one trial at a time.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: She knows truth when she sees it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_76.text: The Karui honour me. May I prove worthy of it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Where I come from, such marks bring shame.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: I do not run from a challenge!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_80.text: I do not know this power!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: He is much more than he appeared.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_86.text: I walk where few dare... and fewer return.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Her eyes see further than most dare look.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: Even the storms cannot wash away what was done here... the place reeks of it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: True justice need not declare itself.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: Faith fed them nothing, in the end.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_91.text: Guard or prisoner - death claimed them all.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_92.text: I must find a way to open this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: A key. Best keep it close.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: There is power buried in this place.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_99.text: These prisoners were left to their fates. No wonder madness took them.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_101.text: This was not built to keep people out, but to keep something <i>{in}.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_102.text: Whatever is down here, they left it to drown like vermin.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_103.text: Not this Izaro - but I am your doom!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Your lust for vengeance dies with you!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Something wild nests here. And it won't take kindly to visitors.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_111.text: A nest like this... the mother must be monstrous.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_112.text: There you are. The source of all this filth.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_113.text: What is happening? Do my eyes decieve?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_116.text: Foreign work. Old. I don't recognise this craftsmanship.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: Another shrine... and still no meaning I can grasp.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_118.text: Risking death to prove one's worth... the Karui are not so different from us.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: Look at the size of those birds... our honoured dead would be eaten whole.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_120.text: A brief calm, amid a storm of Corruption.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Their faces wear smiles... but those spears suggest otherwise.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_122.text: I have learned to be wary of any man who promises the sun and the sky.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: I trust the Order will not begrudge us this visit.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_125.text: Something moves beyond these walls. I should investigate.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Now we see the Order's true face!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Another bell. What song does this one sing?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Unfamiliar etchings... but too old to be the Order's work.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: Pathetic sycophant. Where are your masters now?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_131.text: An operation of this scale... whatever they seek, it is no small prize.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: I should have known you would be involved in this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: A place of endings... or new beginnings.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Out of respect, I will not intrude.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_137.text: You have shown me grace. I will return it in kind.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: Your people will be glad to have you back.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_139.text: The air's thick with blood. I must hurry.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_140.text: The blood fever spreads... then we end it, here!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: Tavakai's strength, turned against his own people... he must be stopped!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_142.text: One soul spared. Progress of a kind.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: She is stronger than she looks.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: Blood fever stirs something foul in his heart!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_145.text: Tavakai's wrath has turned pride to ruin.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_147.text: The blood of your people stains your hands!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_148.text: Do you not see what you've become?!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_149.text: Listen to your forebears, while you still can!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_150.text: Let's hope this map was worth the ink.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_151.text: A Kalguuran encampment. Best speak to Dannig.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: What he describes... it echoes the stories of what the old Maraketh once faced.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: These beasts... just as the tale-women described in ancient times.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: So this is the source... It spills forth old power.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: Crude magic. Barely controlled. No wonder it leaks.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: A tear in the earth. Something pushed through.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: Sealed. Yet I doubt it will hold forever.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: The Maraketh have fought such darkness before. I will not falter now.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: It flees - into the waiting dark.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: So the infection runs deeper than I thought.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Let us see what festers in the dark.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: Undead filth! Die as you were meant to!

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: A cursed relic - but one which may yet serve a purpose.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: Its meaning escapes me... but perhaps not the Hooded One.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: The stink of the Vaal is all over this spire.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: More remnants of the Abyssals... Recent ones, too.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: The deeper truths lie beyond. But there is no way forward - yet.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The lich's finger... it pulses. As if something is calling it home.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: The pit calls, and the flesh obeys.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: It hungers still. I can feel it.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_20.text: Ugh. That fall was... harder than I expected.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: I stand against the darkness - like my ancestors before me!

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Return to the dark that birthed you, fell creature!

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_24.text: Even inert, it reeks of the darkness below.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: Grotesque. But power has its uses.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: That voice... I felt it in my very bones.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_01.text: Ice and fire... locked in unending struggle.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Both flame and frost shall fail you!

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_03.text: In all things opposed... yet they meet the same end.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_04.text: This stone bristles with old magic.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_05.text: Its purpose eludes me... but the world feels altered somehow.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_07.text: Fell spectre, you will not bind me here!

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_08.text: All that thunder, yet you die with a whimper.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_09.text: Her voice reveals our way forward... again.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_10.text: A whisper of what might be...

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_11.text: Could almost pass for the Wildwood... if one believed the stories.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_12.text: Even the dead peddle their wares.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_16.text: It will not bring back your victims... but may it bring them peace.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_17.text: Pitiful. He hoards gold like it buys him absolution.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_18.text: They dance while their people suffer. Disgusting.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_19.text: I've danced with scorpions. I'll dance with you too!

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_20.text: Your shadow darkens Ezomyr no more.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_01.text: I never tire of the sight of home.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_03.text: The Titans built monuments to themselves. Now they are the monuments.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_04.text: Their strength lingers... and I will wield it.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_07.text: Come, beasts - I shall bring you the storm!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_10.text: The Serpent Clan leave a trail of destruction in their wake.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_11.text: Djinn are capricious beings. Even caged, they should be approached with care.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_13.text: The djinn withdraw. Their bargain is fulfilled.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_14.text: Tentacled monstrosity - you have no place here!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_16.text: I do not fear you, fire-spawn!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Now your blaze is but smoke.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_20.text: A place to honour the <i>{Sekhemas} of old.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_21.text: Let her wisdom guide my path.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_22.text: Her name may be dust... but her legacy lives on.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_27.text: Craven traitor! The Faridun disgrace us yet again!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_28.text: Asala's throne is not yours to claim!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_05.text: The ice keeps death at bay... for now.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_06.text: Your wings will break against my will!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_07.text: Fall with the snow, feathered thing.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_10.text: A cold to rival the Winter of the World.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_11.text: He doesn't command the monsters, but nor do they attack him. Curious.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_12.text: The worst of the cold is behind me. I hope.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_13.text: Curse the Vaal and their obsession with traps!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Another beast led by nothing but its own hunger!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_15.text: The Vaal languished in their own opulence. A pity.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_16.text: Listen now! The time of the sparrow has come!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_17.text: Doryani lives. If you wish to as well - then <i>{kneel}.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_01.text: An ancient current... still alive within this relic.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_03.text: One light stirs. The others wait.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_05.text: A third node in this network.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_06.text: A fourth. These are not here by chance.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_08.text: The final link in the chain.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_09.text: These function as beacons of some sort.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_13.text: At last, a new path is revealed.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_14.text: The passage of time has not spared these halls.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_15.text: This mechanism is tied to the temple's very heart.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_16.text: The building's innards twist and turn at the altar's command.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_17.text: To command the structure itself... extraordinary.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_20.text: Come, then. Leap to your death!

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_25.text: So ends your service to the Queen!

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_26.text: A mighty commander... reduced to dust.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_27.text: Your flame was no match for mine.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_28.text: Master of the forge, bested by his own fire.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_30.text: Death is too kind a fate for you!

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_33.text: A chamber for binding souls in crystal.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_34.text: Here they force the soul into new shapes.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_35.text: To harvest a soul... the height of depravity.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_36.text: That did not go as I'd hoped.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_37.text: A hall shaped by their hunger for blood.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_38.text: Cruelty is woven through every blade.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_39.text: An arsenal built for dominance, not defence.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_43.text: The taint of Corruption is upon this place.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_46.text: The Vaal seek dominion over life itself.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_47.text: This is not surgery... it is desecration.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_48.text: A theatre of butchery masquerading as medicine.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_50.text: These are not soldiers - merely meat for the grinder.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_51.text: Here, the Vaal temper their blades - and their wills.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_54.text: Power spreads outward from here, like roots from a tree.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_55.text: A wellspring of energy... dangerous and unbound.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_56.text: They have their weaknesses, just as men do.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_57.text: Magnificent feats of engineering - but beatable all the same.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_58.text: The pinnacle of their craft... and still, <i>{not} enough!

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_60.text: Power born of blood... the oldest magic of all.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_61.text: The Vaal bled their own to chase eternity... and failed.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_63.text: Fire and metal, turned to instruments of war.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_64.text: A forge to strike fear into their enemies.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_66.text: When it comes to 'science', the Vaal know no restraint.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_68.text: The Vaal steep to new lows.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_69.text: The cost of Vaal ambition is writ on every body.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_70.text: They force gems into flesh and call it progress.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_71.text: The Vaal's pursuit of mastery leaves only ruin in its wake.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_72.text: Thaumaturgy offers power, but never control.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_74.text: They wield treachery like a blade!

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_75.text: The Vaal at their worst: cunning without honour!

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_76.text: Their might rests on fear, not conviction.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_77.text: Twisted work... half man, half machine.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_78.text: All this gold... and still their empire burned.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_79.text: The architect's influence lingers in every stone.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_80.text: Time the Red Queen was deposed.

Int4b_Gameplay_Incursion_82.text: So this is all that remains of her empire.

A building that shifts like the sands.
