StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_17.text: Reeks o' memory and madness both...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_19.text: No great truths in ye - only madness!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_20.text: Not the first nightmare I've outlasted.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_21.text: This ought to stir the hornet's nest.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_22.text: Cannae rob the dead without payin' for it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_23.text: Looks like a record o' lost expeditions. Best show it to Dannig.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_24.text: A record o' some sort. Looks Kalguuran.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_26.text: Aye, this is it... Olroth's near.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_27.text: Yer fellow Kalguurans'd like their Flame back!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_28.text: Whatever ye are, ye reek o' old sins.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_29.text: Madness took ye long before I did.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_30.text: Ye damned yerself for that Flame - and now it dies with ye.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_31.text: Boils my blood, to know the 'King' still spreads his rot across our lands.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_32.text: I'd hoped never to see one o' these again...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_33.text: Mark my words, Aoife - I'll kill every last cultist that took ye from me.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_34.text: All these years, and still his poison seeps through the roots.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_35.text: I'll drag the damn King from his mists and make him bleed.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_11.text: Aoife... my fellow Maji... you will be avenged.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_37.text: The King calls, and I answer - one last time.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_16.text: Ye'll never lay hands on my Aoife again!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_40.text: I've felt yer shadow since the Wildwood. Now I return ye to it!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_46.text: To an end I go - mine, or theirs.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_24.text: That wretched Lich wasted no time, did he?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_48.text: Their end's come - and mine can wait a little longer.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_49.text: Feel right at home in woods like these.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_50.text: At least the plants still thrive, amidst all this death.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_51.text: Countless folk met their end in this here bog.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_52.text: What foul magic keeps these trees burnin'?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_53.text: Red as the blood that runs in my veins.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_54.text: A land as ruthless as the beasts who call it home.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_55.text: Not afraid of a little mud.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_57.text: Roots here run deep... twistin' and turnin' in on themselves.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_58.text: These walls stand strong... long after their builders turned to dust.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_59.text: Corruption's a prison all its own.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_60.text: Rather be in the jungle, not above it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_62.text: A village lost. A home forgotten.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_63.text: I doubt the dead'll fancy me despoilin' their temple.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_64.text: This many hives about... bound to be a right nuisance.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_65.text: Man tried to build here... now the wild takes it back.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_66.text: The jungle blooms with life and death alike.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_67.text: Each tomb is more rank than the last.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_68.text: Corruption chokes the life from this wood.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_69.text: Let's see 'em try to take down a Druid on forest soil.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_70.text: My lungs'll thank me not to linger here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_71.text: Us folk come and go... but the wild stands eternal.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_73.text: Mountains like these... cold for even a beastwalker.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_74.text: Death wends its way through the trees.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_75.text: Some things, even Corruption cannae despoil.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_76.text: These springs once brimmed with life... now they breed only death.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_77.text: A calmin' place... if not for all the monsters.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_78.text: The dead should feed the soil - not fill tombs.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_79.text: Dead souls, cut adrift... left to languish on the tide.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_81.text: Buried so deep, the sky's little more than a memory.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_82.text: Naught left to mine here but death itself.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_83.text: Cracked and barren earth... yet still the rot finds root.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_84.text: Man werenae meant to climb so high.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_85.text: I long to see such places rid o' Corruption's taint.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_86.text: The river below still flows... but there's naught left for it to water.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_87.text: I didnae think such places still existed...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_88.text: Riches buried deep... and for what?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_89.text: Feels like I've walked this earth before.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_92.text: Spoils as far as the eye can see.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_93.text: Coin's a means to an end - nothin' more.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_94.text: Still waters... but somethin' foul lies beneath.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_95.text: I didnae wish to ever return here...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Endgame_96.text: I've no qualms with puttin' you down!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_17.text: No matter how many times ye rise – soon comes the fall!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_18.text: What a pathetic excuse for a wolf you are!

StrInt4b_Intro_01.text: My past is a mire. My memory, a haze. All that's left to guide me is instinct - wild and untamed. Cross me, and you'll learn this bear bites back.

StrInt4b_Ascendancy_01.text: Fate branches like roots through soil. I sow the seeds of what may be - and choose which future will sprout.

StrInt4b_Ascendancy_02.text: The storm, the flame, the biting cold - all dance to the Draíocht's song. Through totem and spirit, I bear its power to the world.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: Never was a fan o' settlements like this... I cannae hear the Draíocht here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_02.text: You'll not find a willin' sheep here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_03.text: He's got a mouth on him, hasn't he?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: Rare to meet such an upstandin' sort.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: We've a means of transport. Now if only we knew where to go.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_07.text: Ye'd have liked this one, Aoife.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_08.text: These kinfolk are awful industrious. To what end?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_09.text: Look at 'em - like moths to flame.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: Ought to loose these beasts on the kinfolk - see how they like it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: Ought to cage these kinfolk - see how they like it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_13.text: Savages... Rhoas were meant to roam.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_14.text: How many beasts must they bind afore they're sated?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_15.text: What've they done to this creature?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_17.text: Kinfolk caged ye... I gave ye release.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: This dig's no kinfolk work... too neat by half.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_20.text: Found naught but death in their venture.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_21.text: The earth's fury. I know it better than most.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: Hotter than a damn forge in here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_23.text: Stone brutes, risen from the fire.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_28.text: Ye've stuffed yer face long enough!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_29.text: Bloated tyrant - I'll cut ye down to size!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_30.text: Drink yerself to death, why don't ye?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_31.text: Man in a cage... looks like he needs freein'.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_32.text: Ye're free - now off with ye. Quickly now.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_33.text: Fog thick as stone... Naught natural about this.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Hmm... looks like part of a map.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_35.text: Should be able to piece the map together now.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: Done my part. Makoru will do the rest.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_38.text: The Kalguurans were arrogant, to think they could tame such a place.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Oh, we'll both be leavin', lad - I in life, you in death!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_45.text: Strange metal... shimmers like the night sky.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_46.text: Strong enough to break any bind.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_50.text: Boats left to rot... bodes ill.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_51.text: Beast o' the sands - I'll feed ye to the dunes!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: Yer claws willnae snare another soul.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_53.text: Homes smashed, lives scattered to the winds.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: That fin... big as a damn sail!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_57.text: Cursed creature... The sea won't miss the likes o' you!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: No sense leavin' this - might be worth somethin'.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_60.text: Aoife? ... No... Just some foul trick.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_63.text: A brood chamber... reeks o' what's to come.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: Folk turned to stone... Wicked sorcery.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_66.text: You... how dare ye use her voice!?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_68.text: Ye dared imitate my Aoife. No more!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_69.text: One step nearer to the end o' the road.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Deep as eternity... I cannae see the bottom.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_71.text: They fight with the wisdom of ages!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: The forest recognises one of its own.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_74.text: Hinekora speaks. I heed her call.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_75.text: Welcome in death's halls... a strange privilege.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Yama? What are ye doin' down here?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_83.text: A trial worthy o' the name. Ye fought well, Yama.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_86.text: It's true, then... Death wears a face.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: This folly o' the Eternal Empire. Lockin' men away to satiate their conscience...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: So much for the gods' mercy. Left to rot in their own chapel.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: Starved dogs'll eat their masters first.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: There'll be some mechanism to unlock this, no doubt.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_93.text: Might open somethin' that needs openin'.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_94.text: Aha! This'll fit that bloody door.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: Feels wrong, aye... but I'll need all the boons I can get where I'm goin'.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_96.text: To be trapped down here so long... a slit throat would've been the kinder fate.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: This door... A warnin', cast in iron.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_99.text: Must've been sealed an age, to trap the water so.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_106.text: Free of yer binds, at last.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_107.text: The Karui test their strength against this place. Best keep my guard up.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_108.text: How many Karui died in the pursuit o' these eggs?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Ugh... what is wrong with ye!?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_112.text: Let us be rid o' yer venomous ways!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_113.text: This shrine... it looks to have been here longer than the Karui.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_114.text: Another o' these shrines, just as ancient as the last.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_115.text: Mean lookin' things. Hope they stay over there.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_116.text: They look friendly... but their smiles dinna reach their eyes.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: What's the Order need with all these weapons?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_118.text: I'll believe this 'Utopia' when I see it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: If the Order's as friendly as they claim, mayhaps they can point us in the right direction.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: The Order and their infernal secrets...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_124.text: These markings... strange. Foreign. The forge must be near.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_125.text: Twilight dogs... yer leash became a noose.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: The scale o' this... The Order have been hard at work.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_127.text: The Order are searchin' for somethin'... but what?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_128.text: You again... Should've known you're behind all this!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Tryin' to kill us both? Mad fool!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: Aye, this is the place. No two ways about it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: I'll not go where I'm unwanted.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_133.text: I thank ye. Ye've naught to fear from me.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: Found his way back home, I see.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_135.text: So much death... Can feel it in the air.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_137.text: Tavakai destroys the very home he swore to protect.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: I hope she's not the only one.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_139.text: Aye, she's alive... but what of the rest?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: The trail o' destruction wends this way... We must be gettin' close.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: Then we'll settle this with blood.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: If he keeps on like this, there'll be naught left to save!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_145.text: Ye talk o' power like ye've any right to it!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_146.text: This is where the map leads, sure enough.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A4_147.text: Someone's been here already... Kalguurans, by the look of it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Down he goes. The dark calls him home.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: A sickness, burrowin' its way up through the very earth.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: Now to find the heart o' this rot - and cut it out.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: Rotten thing - time you embraced death once and for all!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: A foul omen... but I sense I'll need it yet.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: I cannae make sense of it...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: Abyssals usin' Vaal craft... filth upon filth.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: Freshly dug. These Abyssals move quickly.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: There's no end to this place...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Cannae wait to be rid o' this damn finger.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: Finger's twitchin' in my pocket. Makes my skin crawl.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: Och... too bloody old for this.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: You and yer kin are nae welcome here!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: Up ye get, then. Won't be up long!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: Darkness birthed ye. Now darkness takes ye back!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: Dark hands shaped it... now mine bear the stains.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: A yawnin' chasm... as deep as it is hungry.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_01.text: Fire and ice... a war as old as the wilds themselves.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Ah, so now ye agree on somethin'!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_03.text: Their feud's settled - by my hand.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_04.text: Old power sleeps in this stone.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_05.text: That did somethin'. Can feel it in the bones o' the earth.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_07.text: The King in the Mists has no claim here!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_08.text: Nameless fiends... I'll slaughter every last one o' ya!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_09.text: The Draíocht's touch... gentle as ever.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_10.text: An omen... the kind that bleeds old wounds.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_11.text: This cannae be... the roots still whisper her name...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_12.text: An odd sort, to say the least.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_13.text: Not the first of these I've seen.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_15.text: A jailer fat on pain... I'll see ye starve!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_16.text: So ends the Thane's pet butcher!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_17.text: Gold piled high - same as his sins.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P1_20.text: Ye bartered with yer souls... Now ye pay the price.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_01.text: Already feels like a lifetime since I were here last.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_03.text: The strength o' titans, in the palm o' my hand.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_04.text: More blasted undead... At this rate, I hope the next tomb's my own.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_06.text: Twisted beasts... I'll put ye down!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_09.text: Serpent Clan have made a right mess o' this place.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_10.text: Djinn give with one hand, take with the other.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_11.text: I dinnae trust it... but I'll use it all the same.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_12.text: The Djinn have given what they will.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_13.text: Damn serpent-spawn... The desert's sick with yer kind!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_14.text: You'll poison the sands no longer!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_15.text: Creature o' flame, come meet yer end!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Their honour endures, long after their flesh has gone to rot.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_18.text: The Maraketh do much to honour their dead.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_23.text: Well's run dry. Wonder if I could fill it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_24.text: Empty but for a single drop... Feels heavier than it should.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_25.text: Give to the land, and it gives back.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_26.text: Power makes a fool o' men like ye!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P2_27.text: Prince or pauper - the Vastiri bows to no Faridun!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_03.text: Whatever speaks to ye, it's no Spirit!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_04.text: Kill yer kin, and get what ye deserve!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_05.text: I'll leave ye broken on the mountainside!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_07.text: Ye're not the only feral beast here!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_09.text: Och... the kind o' cold that seeps into yer bones.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_10.text: Didnae expect to find anyone up here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_11.text: Can finally feel my fingertips again.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Come too far to let ye stop me now!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_15.text: The way to the vault lies open.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_16.text: We'll soon see if Doryani's allies are as friendly as he says.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_17.text: The time o' the sparrow has come... am I right?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_P3_18.text: Didn't ye hear me? We're supposed to be allies! Bloody imbeciles.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_01.text: Ancient relics... poisonin' land and beast alike.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_14.text: This place has gone to ruin.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_16.text: Feels like the whole place is shiftin'.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_20.text: Almost gave me a bloody heart attack!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_22.text: Let's have it, then, ye big lout!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_79.text: A twisted mess of steel and sinew!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_23.text: Has no one ever told you not to poke the bear?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_24.text: That's for scarin' the livin' daylights out of me!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_26.text: Ye forged yer own end, fool!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_81.text: A craft most vile... ended at last.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_27.text: The Vaal besmirch both past and present.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_29.text: Is this where they make their infernal Soul Cores?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_30.text: The gall o' the Vaal, to violate a man's very soul...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_31.text: Time I put a stop to these vile experiments.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_33.text: The Vaal never lacked for arms, did they?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_34.text: They're gearin' up for somethin' in here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_35.text: Dinnae like to see such weapons in Vaal hands.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_38.text: This place twists and turns without end.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_40.text: The Vaal worked their most vile crafts in this place.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_41.text: This place bleeds Corruption from every stone.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_42.text: What in blazes has gone on here?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_43.text: How much blood have they spilled in the name o' 'science'?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_44.text: Bloody butchers, the lot o' ye!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_82.text: What in the Draoicht's name did I just do?!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_47.text: This lot's no rabble! Best stay sharp.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_49.text: Power sleeps here, waitin' to be woken.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_50.text: A right beast of a generator.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_51.text: So this is where these blasted machines are made.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_52.text: Their hands never tire... nor mine.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_53.text: No end to these damned things.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_54.text: This must be where the Vaal make their cursed sacrifices.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_55.text: All this slaughter, just to feed their thirst for power.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_56.text: They've spilt enough blood here to drown a god.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_60.text: Willnae need those weapons when I'm through with ye!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_61.text: I shudder to think what horrors unfolded here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_62.text: What hubris, to give life to such things...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_63.text: Damn the Vaal and their cursed experiments!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_65.text: Can scarcely imagine what heinous things these walls have seen.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_66.text: My contempt for the Vaal knows no bounds.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_70.text: I feel unseen eyes upon me...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_71.text: The Viper's left her mark here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_72.text: This is what comes o' meddlin' with nature.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_73.text: This must be where they keep their treasure.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_75.text: Time the Red Queen was knocked off her perch.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_77.text: Hoarded enough riches to feed the world twice over.

StrInt4b_IncursionTempleEnterSubsequent_.text: Never the same twice, this place.
Never the same twice, this place.
Never the same twice, this place.
Cannae trust a stone to stay still here.
Cannae trust a stone to stay still here.
Cannae trust a stone to stay still here.
What nonsense will the Vaal serve up this time?
What nonsense will the Vaal serve up this time?
What nonsense will the Vaal serve up this time?

StrInt4b_IncursionTreasureRoomOpenedSubs.text: Rather this in my hands than theirs.
Rather this in my hands than theirs.
Rather this in my hands than theirs.

DexInt4b_Wild_EngageAncientEzomyte_02_01.text: I shall free you from this world!

DexInt4b_Wild_EngageAncientEzomyte_02_02.text: I shall free you from this world!

DexInt4b_Wild_EngageAncientEzomyte_02_03.text: I shall free you from this world!

DexInt4b_Wild_IncursionCorruptionBenchUs.text: The curse is now its to bear.
The curse is now its to bear.
The curse is now its to bear.

DexInt4b_Wild_IncursionTempleEnterSubseq.text: No matter the path, I'll walk it.
No matter the path, I'll walk it.
No matter the path, I'll walk it.

DexInt4b_Wild_IncursionTreasureRoomSubse.text: These treasures lie idle no longer.
These treasures lie idle no longer.
These treasures lie idle no longer.

DexInt4b_Keystone_RitualCadence.text: I've been training for this my entire life.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_01.text: This relic hums with power long dormant.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_03.text: One light stirs. There must be more.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_09.text: Empowered by sacrifice - same as the last.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_12.text: Five lit... The end draws near.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_13.text: That's all six. The way reveals itself.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_14.text: This temple has long since fallen into disrepair.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_15.text: This mechanism hums in tune with the stone around it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_16.text: The temple stirs... reshaping itself from within.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_17.text: What power, to shift the very earth beneath our feet.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_18.text: This has changed since I was here last.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_19.text: You strike first. I strike true!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_20.text: I shall give you the fight you seek!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_21.text: Another who mistakes size for strength!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_22.text: Your fury does not move me!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_23.text: Come. Let us end this misery!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_24.text: The depths of their cruelty is laid bare!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_26.text: A life spent chasing power ends as it should.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_28.text: The hammer that builds... also destroys.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_29.text: There is no end to these shameful experiments.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_31.text: Typical of the Vaal, to meddle with such things.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_32.text: Once Corruption takes hold, it does not let go.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_33.text: The soul was not meant to be contained this way.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_34.text: These Soul Cores are a hideous technology.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_35.text: Let these be the last souls they ensnare.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_36.text: That did not work as intended.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_38.text: Violence begins long before the first strike.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_39.text: Blades enough to shape an empire... or break it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_42.text: Pride makes for brittle armour indeed.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_43.text: Corruption has taken hold of this place.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_44.text: The taint here runs deeper still.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_46.text: This is no house of healing.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_47.text: Untold atrocities - all in the name of 'progress'.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_48.text: Such butchery cannot be allowed to continue.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_49.text: By the Dreamer's will, this will not break me...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_50.text: So this is where the rank and file rest their heads.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_51.text: Soldiers of skill... but no soul.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_53.text: A generator... but what does it power?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_54.text: I dare not think what fuels these generators.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_55.text: So much power, in the hands of so few.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_56.text: Born to serve - yet destined only for destruction.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_57.text: These creations serve but one master: death itself.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_58.text: If only the Vaal put their technological brilliance to better use.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_59.text: Countless tragedies were writ in this very room.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_60.text: Here, the Vaal strike the darkest of bargains.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_61.text: The Vaal sacrifice their very souls for power.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_63.text: Such industry... yet all for ruin.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_64.text: Even fire bends to Vaal ambition.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_65.text: A cathedral of fire and steel.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_66.text: The Vaal conduct all manner of vile experiments.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_67.text: One cannot butcher their way toward enlightenment.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_68.text: How many lives were lost to these dark designs?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_69.text: The Vaal tried to birth gemlings here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_70.text: For every victim, a virtue gem.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_71.text: May those who suffered here find peace.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_75.text: A blade from the dark cuts no deeper!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_76.text: These barracks bear the mark of the Viper.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_77.text: The Vaal seek to transcend mortal life. Instead, they defile it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_79.text: Here dwells the architect of death.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_80.text: Now ends Atziri's reign of terror.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Incursion_81.text: Her shadow darkens this world no longer.

Int4b_DjinnSand_Ascendancy_02.text: We are bound, as stone to sand.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_02.text: It feels like a lifetime ago that I stood here last.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_05.text: For the Keepers of the Flame!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_07.text: And ever closer to the return of the Dreamer.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_09.text: The Dreamer will be glad of their defeat.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_12.text: That door has not been open in some time.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_13.text: I feel... strange. As though I've woken from a dream.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_14.text: By the will of the Dreamer, you are no more!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_01.text: Gettin' some shut eye, aye? Fair enough.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_02.text: Right, investigate the tower... How hard can that be?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_04.text: Huh. Did <i>{not} think that would work.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_05.text: Well, at least we know where we're headed.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_06.text: Seems this fortress has a bit of a security problem.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_07.text: Never met a lever I didn't wanna pull.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_11.text: Admit it. You had no idea what was gonna happen.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_13.text: Right then... off to the monolith!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_15.text: You got it boss. Back in a jiffy.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_16.text: Gotta hand it to them – the folk who built this loved a bit o' drama.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_17.text: Nothin' left to do but press on.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_18.text: Blimey! What couldn't these people do?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_19.text: Only slightly less impressive the second time.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_20.text: That must be what we're after!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_24.text: Well, this all looks important... whatever it is.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_25.text: I'd have just whaled on the thing... but that works too.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_26.text: It's fine. I'm fine! Just don't. Look. Down.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_28.text: Never seen such a strange contraption. And I've seen plenty.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_29.text: Are these bloody things even alive?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_30.text: Won't let you or anyone else stop me now!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_39.text: Haven't got a clue what this is, but... might come in useful.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_32.text: What even is this bloody thing?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_33.text: I'll be a changed man after this... or a dead one.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_34.text: Feel a bit dirty after that.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_35.text: I guess we ain't talkin' this out, then!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_36.text: Wasn't plannin' on destroyin' the world. Maybe if you stopped to listen you'd know that.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_37.text: Blimey... Power like this don't come cheap.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_01.text: What she's doin' all the way out here?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_02.text: Let's see what these Keepers are all about.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_06.text: Ailith? I'm bloody well seein' ghosts!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_09.text: That explains the creepy hands everywhere.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_10.text: I'll send ya back where you belong!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_11.text: Guess someone didn't like what they saw!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_12.text: Hm... Don't remember that door bein' open...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_13.text: Piss off back to your breach!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_14.text: Ailith! Did she really just... do that?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_EGBreach_15.text: Huh. Still wouldn't call it a tree...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_03.text: Whatever this is, it ain't good.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_04.text: Oh, not this bloody fog again!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_05.text: Ugh... that fog makes me feel ill.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_06.text: There's a sadness here... Hits you in the chest the moment you arrive.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_08.text: Job done... and I'm only lightly traumatised.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_09.text: Don't suppose I'll hallucinate somethin' fun this time.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: Well don't let me keep ya!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: Enough with the damn fog already!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_13.text: Don't like this feelin'... Not one bit...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_14.text: Not lookin' forward to this one...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_15.text: What is this, a memory? I don't remember it like this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_16.text: Worst bloody dream I've ever had.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_18.text: Whatever happens, I've gotta keep my head.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_19.text: Think I'll be havin' nightmares about that for a while yet...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_02.text: More o' these bloody rituals... This ain't good.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_03.text: She's like somethin' out of a dream...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_06.text: I've made worse trades... Not with worse people though.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_08.text: I must be mad, acceptin' an invitation from a bloody ghost!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_09.text: Let's see the King refuse me now.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_28.text: Sorry, miss. You deserved better than this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_17.text: Damned darkness won't find ya here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: Right, time to finish our effigy!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_24.text: Can't even see my nose in front of my face down here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_25.text: I'll send ya back to whatever void you crawled out from!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_29.text: That one's for the Speaker of Truths! Bloody beast o' darkness...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_27.text: Rest easy now, you hear? You've earned it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_01.text: That man appears in some distress.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_02.text: Elder Madox? What's come over you?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_03.text: There is something ethereal about this fog.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_05.text: Freed from the grips of madness... for now.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_06.text: I feel a great unease here... as if something terrible took place.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_07.text: I release you from your torment!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_08.text: I should confer with Elder Madox.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_09.text: The fog rolls in once more. I must steady myself.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: If you do not learn from your losses, you are doomed to repeat them.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: It is... difficult... to centre myself here...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_13.text: This fog grows worse still... as though it seeps into my brain...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_14.text: The world is awash with madness.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_16.text: A cruel delusion – but a delusion nonetheless.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_18.text: I must remain calm – now more than ever.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_01.text: He saved us... but at what cost?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_05.text: An entire fortress, risen from nothing. Let us see what it holds.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_06.text: What luck... The first of their defences, already breached.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_07.text: Perhaps this lever will grant us passage.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_08.text: The fortress responds, as if stirred from slumber.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_12.text: Our course is set. The monolith awaits.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_14.text: Another proverbial mountain to climb... So be it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_15.text: Our efforts have borne fruit at last.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_20.text: If this is anything like the first, I'd best be on my guard.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_21.text: So, this is what we have sought.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_28.text: I stand atop the world itself.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_29.text: A woman with child... but who is she?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_30.text: The most elaborate contraption yet. What might it do?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_40.text: I suspect this is what we seek.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_35.text: Every road taken, every triumph and every failure – it has all led to this.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_37.text: If you will not yield, I shall do what must be done!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_38.text: I answer only to the Dreamer! But I will not let this world come to harm.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_02.text: A shadow hangs over this land – dark and terrible.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_03.text: An ethereal presence... Who is she?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_04.text: This ritual is ended. But there will be more.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_09.text: A success. But there is still more work to be done.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_12.text: They display her like a trophy. Barbaric.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_13.text: You will not claim her. I will not allow it!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_16.text: I am sorry, Aoife. Let us leave this cursed place.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_17.text: You are safe now, Aoife. The darkness cannot touch you here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_18.text: It is good to see her amongst friends once more.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_20.text: The first piece of the puzzle.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: The final piece. Now we can complete the effigy.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_24.text: An all-consuming darkness... I must be the light.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_25.text: Creature of darkness – I shall return you to nonexistence!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_26.text: May darkness never grip this land again.

DexInt4b_AscendancyPitch_03.text: I have walked the path of pain, of patience, of discipline. And I will walk it still - until all who oppose me lie broken in my wake.

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_First.text: Big words for a bloke who won't show his face!

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_Second.text: Gettin' you to shut up would be a start!

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_Fourth.text: You know what? Yeah! I do!

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_01.text: He's out. He did all he could...

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_02.text: Let's see what this tower holds.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_03.text: We're certainly off the beaten path.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_04.text: Let's hope that's not just for show.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_05.text: No wall too high. Let's get moving.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_06.text: Well then... no need to look for a way through.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_15.text: If they're out there, I'll find them.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_16.text: Almost too easy. Should be wary of a trap.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_17.text: Suspect there'll be more trickery ahead.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_20.text: What is this magic? Is it even magic at all?

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_21.text: What illusions will they conjure this time?

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_22.text: Did the fragment do all that?

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_24.text: That's all we need to enter the monolith.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_25.text: Let's see what you've been hiding.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_27.text: Another ancient mechanism... I'll let Doryani do the honours.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_29.text: Whole world feels different from up here.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_33.text: When will you ancient fools learn to get out of my way?

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_42.text: I <i>{think} this is what we need.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_36.text: Feels like the end... one way or another.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_37.text: The only thing that could stop me now is myself.

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_38.text: Don't care what you are – I'll make you bleed!

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_39.text: It deserves a better guardian than you!

Dex4_Gameplay_EGrev_40.text: Power to dwarf the gods themselves.

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_01.text: A strange face. Better keep my guard up.

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_02.text: It's quiet here. I could get used to this.

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_03.text: Wouldn't be the first hive I've flushed out.

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_05.text: Your masters will meet the same fate!

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_07.text: They're in for a rude awakening.

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_12.text: Don't see Ailith anywhere... but that door is open.

Dex4_Gameplay_Breach_15.text: No ordinary tree – if it can be called one at all.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_01.text: Who's that? Doesn't seem in his right mind.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_03.text: Hm... This is no natural fog.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_06.text: There's a sadness here... The kind that seeps into the soil.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_07.text: Put you out of your misery!

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_08.text: About time I checked in with Madox.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_09.text: This fog gets thicker with every step.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: Oh, is it? Or are you just starting to sweat?

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: More fog... Have to keep my head clear.

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_16.text: Almost lost myself for a moment there...

Dex4_Gameplay_Delirium_19.text: I'll never look at fog the same way again.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_01.text: Looks like someone's been dabbling where they shouldn't.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_02.text: I've seen what these things can do. Can't let it happen here.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_04.text: Can't celebrate just yet. Still more to come.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_06.text: Might as well get something out of this.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_07.text: Take it. Before I change my mind.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_09.text: That puts a dent in their plans. But they're not dead and gone just yet.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_13.text: The Nameless don't have a home – and I'll see it stays that way!

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_16.text: Rest assured, Aoife. Your death has been avenged.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_17.text: We're here. They can't hurt you anymore.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_18.text: Good to see someone's watching over her.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_20.text: Could use this to make the effigy.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: Should have enough to complete the effigy now.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_22.text: I'm no sculpter... but it'll do.

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_24.text: Never seen such darkness. But I've got just the thing...

Dex4_Gameplay_Ritual_25.text: If there's one thing I know how to do, it's hunt beasts like you!

Dex4_Wild_Delirium_First.text: I'll walk this maze... as long as it takes to find you.

Dex4_Wild_Delirium_Fourth.text: Powerful enough to make you regret every word.

Dex4_Wild_Delirium_Fifth.text: Think it's about time someone shut you up.

Dex4_Wild_Delirium_RoomSeven.text: What do you know? I don't need her. I don't need <i>{anyone}!

Dex4_Wild_Delirium_FinishFirstSImulacrum.text: My mother seemed to think so. As for me... I'm not so sure.

Dex4_Wild_Delirium_ShatterMirrorChildIns.text: Takes more than superstition to scare me.

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_EnterTwinMap.text: Come on, then – shake a leg!

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_FirstPermaDelirio.text: Lucky for me, so's my thirst for battle.

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_RoomSeven.text: That's not true... You've got no bloody idea what you're talkin' about!

StrDex4b_Wild_Delirium_FinishFirstSimula.text: I dunno. Have you tried not bein' a knob?

DexInt4b_Wild_Delirium_EnterTwinMap.text: I will pursue you to the end.

DexInt4b_Wild_Delirium_FirstPermaDelirio.text: The Dreamer has taught me patience. I will not be deterred.

DexInt4b_Wild_Delirium_RoomSeven.text: Vile fiend... I will never let this come to pass!

DexInt4b_Wild_Delirium_FinishFirstSimula.text: We are not the product of our birth, but of the choices that come after. That is what defines us.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_89.text: The roots are infused with magic.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_90.text: Awful lot o' mushrooms. More than you'd expect.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_92.text: What kind o' beast could do summat like this?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A1_93.text: So you're what's been been feastin' on the livestock!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_101.text: Vultures have practically picked the place clean.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_102.text: Must be a reason for all this parchment.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_103.text: Serpent Clan's made their mark here, sure enough.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_104.text: Bloody Abyssals, pokin' their noses where they're not wanted...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_105.text: To see one o' these Titans in their day... must've been summat to behold.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_107.text: Aye, tell me that's not Shambrin's friend...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_108.text: These rhoa tracks are deep. Means it had a rider.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A2_62.text: There's nowt I won't sacrifice to hear the Spirit again.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_163.text: That's a shaman if ever I've seen one.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A3_164.text: Reckon I can cut back through there.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_01.text: Who's that? Looks like she can handle herself.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_02.text: Let's see what these 'Keepers o' the Flame' are all about.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_04.text: Spirit's breath! What happened to Ailith?

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_07.text: About time we took the fight to them!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_08.text: By the skin o' me teeth!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_10.text: Hiveborn filth... I'll make this quick!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_11.text: Tell yer fat-fingered friends Wraeclast is spoken for!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_13.text: You and your Hiveborn are done for!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Breach_15.text: Right powerful, this. Glad it's in our hands.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_02.text: Elder Madox! What's happened to ya?

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_03.text: What is this fog? Makes me feel right strange...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_04.text: More o' this Raven Trickster nonsense...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_06.text: Somethin' awful happened here... Can feel it in the air.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_07.text: This fog makes a mess o' monsters and men alike.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_08.text: About time I checked in with Madox.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_09.text: Fog feels thicker every time I see it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_10.text: There could be ten o' ya for all I care!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: Oh... Borin' you, am I? Poor thing!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: Damned fog sends a chill down me spine.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_13.text: It's not real... None o' this is real...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Delirium_14.text: Here goes. Better keep me wits about me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_01.text: Here he sleeps. His bravery won't be forgotten.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_03.text: More ancient markings. We're on the right track.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_04.text: It's workin'... Can feel the power coursin' underfoot.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_05.text: Right then – we've a fortress to conquer.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_06.text: Forget findin' the weak point. Here's one already.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_08.text: Well, guess we know they work.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_11.text: Did you mean to do that?

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_21.text: No end to this madness – except the one I'll give 'em.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_23.text: Just the reward I was hopin' for.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_26.text: Only been five minutes, and already he comes back to bite us!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_27.text: Whatever this is, it's over my head.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_28.text: Can't believe all this stuff still works.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_29.text: Wow... rivals the highest peak in the Ranges.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_30.text: Wouldn't fancy haulin' a statue all the way up here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_31.text: These ancients and their bloody machines.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_33.text: Damned construct! Get out o' my way!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_41.text: This had better be what we're lookin' for.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_42.text: Reckon this is what we need.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_38.text: You'll not come between me and saving this world!

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_39.text: Your watch is over. Now mine begins.

Dex4b_Gameplay_EGrev_40.text: Power enough to bring Wraeclast to its knees.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_01.text: I've a bad feelin' about this effigy...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_03.text: Almost thought that were a wisp...

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_04.text: Ha! So much for your bloody ritual!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_06.text: It's here either way. Might as well use it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_07.text: A dark bargain if ever I've made one.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_08.text: What is this place? Where is this place?

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_09.text: Reckon I've killed enough cultists. Time to meet with the man himself.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_10.text: If the king wants blood, I'll feed him his own.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_11.text: Time to finish what the Maji started.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_13.text: Nameless, aye – and soon, lifeless too!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_15.text: And I'll be here waitin' when you do!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_16.text: Sorry, love. Let's get you home.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_17.text: Here we are, Aoife. Back where you belong.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_19.text: Bloody rituals... I'll stamp out every last one!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_20.text: As good a start as any.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: Got enough to complete the effigy now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_22.text: Reckon I make a better effigy than that sorry bunch o' cultists.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_24.text: The Darkness damn near suffocates ya! Time we let the light in.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_25.text: Head won't fit on a mantle, but I'll still take it!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_27.text: Farewell, Aoife. You're free at last.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_29.text: That's the hare... from Madox's fable!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_31.text: Ugh... what've they done to me?

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_32.text: Touched by the tendrils o' Darkness.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_33.text: Time for a spot o' regicide.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Ritual_34.text: First the King, now for his Queen!

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_First.text: Come on, then – where are you hidin'?!

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_Second.text: Why don't you show your face and find out?

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_Third.text: Do you do <i>{anythin'} but jabber on?

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_Fourth.text: I've no interest in power... only what's needed to end this.

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_Fifth.text: Ha! Even your insults are gettin' weaker.

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_EnterTwinMap.text: See you at the finish line!

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_FirstPermaDelirious.text: Can't get rid o' me that easy.

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_RoomSeven.text: No... I did what I did to save him! To save all of 'em!

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_FinishFirstSimulacru.text: No one's irredeemable. That's just an excuse for those who don't care to try.

Dex4b_Wild_Delirium_ShatterMirrorChildIn.text: Is it now? Reckon I'll be just fine.

DexInt4b_Chayula_MonkTruthRevealed_Bone.text: What?! What is the meaning of this?

DexInt4b_Chayula_MonkTruthRevealed_Cone.text: No! No! My fears were... true all along?! You're a monster! I am human. My life is my own!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_1.text: Ye've done yer part. Now for us to do ours.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_2.text: I'll get to the bottom o' these towers. Or the top, as it were.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_3.text: I'll make short work o' this.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_4.text: Old as dirt... yet still intact.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_5.text: Aye, we'll crest that wall – or break it down.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_6.text: Seems this place has seen battle already – and plenty of it.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_7.text: Could be this lever'll let us through.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_10.text: Ach! A bit o' warnin' wouldnae go amiss!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_12.text: Then let that pillar o' flame act as our beacon.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_14.text: Very well. I'll do as ye ask.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_16.text: Soon we'll see what waits beyond the wall.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_20.text: Curious... Like an echo of what once was...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_21.text: Here's what we came to find.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_25.text: Hmm... cannae make heads or tails o' this.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_26.text: Never thought I'd be so thankful for the Vaal wizard.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_27.text: A sight to take yer breath away... or mayhaps that's just the altitude.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_28.text: Pride o' place atop the tallest tower in the land. Must've been important.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_29.text: Another blasted contraption I cannae understand.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_30.text: Willnae bow to no blasted automaton!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_33.text: Strange thing... but I sense it's what we need.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_34.text: I'd best steel meself. No knowin' what comes next.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_36.text: Guess we'll do this the hard way!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_37.text: You were no protector... but I will be.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_EGrev_38.text: Power like this... a great and terrible thing.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_1.text: Not a face I recognise. Let's hope she's no threat.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_2.text: It looks a peaceful place... but somethin' bristles beneath.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_7.text: Good! These breaches are nothin' but a damned nuisance.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_9.text: They've long spilled into our world... Now it's our turn!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_10.text: Of all the wretched Hiveborn, ye're the worst yet!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_11.text: Ach – was just about to finish the job!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_12.text: Where's that door lead? Wasnae open afore.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_13.text: Die now, ye vile affront to nature!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Breach_15.text: Still cannae stand this infernal tree.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_1.text: Fella's not right in the head, by the looks o' things.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_3.text: I've not seen fog like this afore...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_4.text: This fog reeks o' the Raven Trickster...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_5.text: Fog's gone... but it'll be back. And we'd best be ready.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_6.text: Cannae put my finger on it... but there is somethin' deeply wrong with this place.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_7.text: Madness claimed ye. Now death takes ye.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_8.text: If they mean to drive me mad, they'll find I already am.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_9.text: Time for a little stroll through the fog.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_10.text: It's this lot who are trapped! And you'll be next!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: Is it now? You're welcome to walk away!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: Can hardly hear myself think with all this bloody fog...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_13.text: Ach... madness spreads like rot, seepin' into every pore...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_14.text: Let's hope I make it out the other side with me wits intact.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_15.text: Curse this memory o' mine... always playin' tricks on me.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_16.text: I have my demons, aye... but I'll not let them be the death o' me.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_18.text: Time we peeled back the layers o' this Trickster's mind.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Delirium_19.text: Pushed to edge o' sanity and back... but at least it's over now.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_1.text: No! I'd hoped never to see one o' these again...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_2.text: All these years, and still his poison seeps through the roots!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_5.text: I'll drag that damn king from his mists and make him bleed.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_6.text: There ye are. Always a sight for sore eyes.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_7.text: All the better to kill you with, vile King.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_8.text: Take your tribute. I'll take yer head soon enough.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_10.text: No amount of cultist blood will sate me. Not until we take down the King.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_13.text: No... Ye murderous bastards! I will rip the flesh from yer bones!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_14.text: I will die a thousand deaths before I let ye take her!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_18.text: Here we are, Aoife. Free from that cursed place at last.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_19.text: May the Goddess do what I couldn't, and watch over her.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_20.text: Let us stamp out this cursed cult, once and for all.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: A fine way to start an effigy.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_23.text: Just as ugly as I am! This'll do just fine.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_26.text: Foul beast – I'll bring ye to yer knees!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_27.text: No longer will you haunt my dreams!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Ritual_28.text: So long, my love. This ruined heart will carry ye close, now and always.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_1.text: I should give the poor lad a hand.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_3.text: Farrow will want a look at these symbols.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_4.text: This liquid has the look o' Verisium.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_5.text: I dinnae recognise these tools... but Farrow might.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_6.text: Best see what Farrow has to say about this.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_7.text: Kingsmarch reduced to naught by rubble... A cryin' shame.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_10.text: I'll not let you touch it, blasted undead!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_11.text: There's only one fate befittin' a traitor like you!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_12.text: Only thing calling you is the grave!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_13.text: A comet that size... damn near beggars belief.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_15.text: I'll send ye back to the stars!

StrInt4b_Gameplay_Expedition_16.text: The Kalguur will be tellin' stories about this for a long time to come.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A1_91.text: There's a strange magic betwixt these roots.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A1_92.text: Enough mushrooms to feed an army... or poison 'em.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A1_93.text: The locusts flock to safety. I'd best see where they've gone.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A1_94.text: Damn near massacred, these cattle... What could've done this?

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_102.text: Maraketh... dead by the raiders' hands.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_103.text: These parchments form a kind o' trail...

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_104.text: Smacks o' the Serpent Clan, this.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_105.text: The Lightless claw their way up from below.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_106.text: Folk as big as mountains... It's just as well they're no more.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_108.text: The Lost Men'll pay for this barbarism.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_109.text: Must be Lailuma... poor lass. The desert claims another.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A2_110.text: Rhoa tracks in the sand... Someone's been through here.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A3_162.text: Ought to follow those snakes, see where they're headed.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A3_163.text: Some kind o' shaman, looks like.

StrInt4b_Gameplay_A3_164.text: Seems like a hidden exit over there.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_1.text: The Hooded One sleeps... Damned Cataclysm.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_2.text: Now to find a way forward.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_3.text: The other tower is this way.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_4.text: It's working. Now for the other tower.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_5.text: The fortress awaits. So be it.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_6.text: This is proof enough: no matter the fortress, it can be breached.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_7.text: That lever may get us through.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_12.text: Whatever comes next, I'll meet it head on.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_14.text: We've come this far. I'll do my best.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_15.text: The first of their defences breached.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_19.text: It's like I've been transported back in time...

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_25.text: Doryani will understand this better than me.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_26.text: Good thing we have him to call upon.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_27.text: It's been a long road from Ogham... but here we are.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_30.text: Ancient guardian – I will cut you down!

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_31.text: You will not stand in my way!

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_32.text: Is this what we've been searching for?

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_33.text: We are close now. I can feel it.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_34.text: This is it. I won't fail.

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_36.text: Then you leave me no choice!

Str4b_Gameplay_EGrev_38.text: More power than I've ever known.

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_1.text: Who is that? They don't look hostile.

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_2.text: A quiet sanctuary, far away from the rest of the world.

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_3.text: The Hiveborn are many – but we will beat them back.

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_5.text: I fear neither servant nor master.

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_7.text: The breach hungers. We will see it starve.

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_10.text: I will break you as you broke your world!

Str4b_Gameplay_Breach_13.text: Depraved Lords, this is your end!

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_1.text: That man is in some kind of trance.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_3.text: This fog clouds not only my vision, but my mind as well.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_4.text: This fog... Tekaru's influence spreads like a plague.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_5.text: Thank the First Ones... The fog is clearing.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_6.text: Such sadness here... The kind born of a heinous act.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_7.text: I won't let this fog make a monster of me!

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_8.text: We are making headway, slowly but surely.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_9.text: I am prepared for what may come.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: You sound scared. You should be.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: This damned fog again... I cannot let it break me!

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_13.text: This place... like a waking nightmare...

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_14.text: Fear is in the mind. It can be overcome.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_16.text: None of this will come to pass. I will not let it.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_17.text: Elder Madox will want to see this.

Str4b_Gameplay_Delirium_18.text: A glimpse inside the mind of a madman... I'd best be ready.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_1.text: Looks like a sign of some dark ritual...

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_2.text: I've seen what these cultists can do. I won't let it happen here!

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_5.text: This accursed cult will never know peace. I'll make sure of it.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_8.text: I pay you tribute – but not respect.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_9.text: I do not know this place...

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_14.text: I won't let you harm her any further!

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_17.text: It's alright, Aoife. He's gone now.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_18.text: Here we are. You're safe now, Aoife.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_19.text: If only she'd been watched over from the start. Might've had a happier ending.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_20.text: Their darkness spreads... but I will blot it out.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: We can use this for the effigy.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_22.text: There. Now we can complete the effigy.

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_23.text: Now to banish the Darkness once and for all!

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_25.text: I am the light which pierces the darkness!

Str4b_Gameplay_Ritual_26.text: Born of nothing, you shall return to nothing!

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_3.text: One of those inscriptions... I should get Farrow in here.

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_4.text: Liquid Verisium... Farrow should see this.

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_5.text: A workbench. Are these runesmithing tools?

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_6.text: A runestone. This calls for Farrow.

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_7.text: My heart breaks for the people of Kingsmarch.

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_8.text: I can't leave her to die!

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_9.text: You defile it yourself, wretched undead!

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_11.text: You will pay for your treachery!

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_12.text: It is not the sky, but the earth, that calls you!

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_13.text: The comet's even bigger up close than I imagined.

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_15.text: The beast within! Come on, then!

Str4b_Gameplay_Expedition_16.text: Should make for a good story some day.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_92.text: I've never seen roots like this before. Where are they coming from?

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_93.text: I've never seen so many mushrooms this far from the Tangle.

Str4b_Gameplay_A1_95.text: These cows weren't just eaten... They were ripped to shreds.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_104.text: The raiders made an example of this poor Maraketh.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_105.text: These parchments form a kind of trail...

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_106.text: The Serpent Clan have come this way.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_107.text: The Lightless nest in these sands.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_108.text: To witness a clash of Titans... Can only imagine how the earth would tremble.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_110.text: Cruel deaths, enacted by a cruel people.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_111.text: Damn it all... This must be Lailuma.

Str4b_Gameplay_A2_112.text: These footprints belong to a rhoa.

Str4b_Gameplay_A3_158.text: I think there's a way out over there.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_2.text: This had better not be a fool's errand.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_3.text: This tower will fall like the last.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_6.text: Seems we're not the first to assault this fortress.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_8.text: I suppose that was the last one.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_10.text: You're a clever one. Did you know that would happen?

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_12.text: Very well. Now, to topple the monolith.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_16.text: Practically begging me to step inside.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_20.text: I do love the chance to kill my enemies twice over.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_25.text: This device... Perhaps the thaumaturge can make sense of it.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_26.text: He's still useful for something, it seems.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_27.text: A fine place for a throne, when all is said and done.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_28.text: Well then... what's in her belly?

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_29.text: Hm... what's this do, I wonder?

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_30.text: Do constructs feel pain? Let's find out!

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_31.text: You will crumble like the last!

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_32.text: This dark treasure holds many secrets.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_33.text: The final piece to this secret.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_34.text: The secrets of this monolith will soon be mine.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_35.text: The final piece falls into place.

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_36.text: Then you're just as deluded as he was!

Int4_Gameplay_EGrev_37.text: I'm afraid you're not in a position to make demands.

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_1.text: Ugh... she's going to want to talk to me, isn't she?

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_2.text: I certainly wouldn't choose to live here.

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_3.text: Why else would I be here?

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_5.text: The Hiveborn aren't sending their best, it seems!

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_6.text: Ailith? Who brought you back from the dead?

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_9.text: There's power here... wasted on these mindless hordes.

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_10.text: Time you were both dealt to!

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_11.text: Bah! They got off easy... this time.

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_12.text: Someone left the door open. Would be a shame not to take a peek.

Int4_Gameplay_Breach_13.text: Thanks for stopping by, I guess.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_2.text: Elder Madox... <i>{Hello?} Can you hear me?

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_3.text: I feel strange... Is it the fog?

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_4.text: This fog... Seems the Trickster wants to come out and play.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_5.text: The fog disperses... and with it, its demons.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_6.text: Not all is as it seems here... Delightful!

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_7.text: Ha! Was that meant to scare me?

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_8.text: These delusions are little more than a nuisance.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_9.text: Come on then, Trickster. Show me what you can <i>{really} do.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_11.text: If this is a game, it's one you'll lose.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_12.text: The fog's getting worse. It clouds my senses.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_13.text: Ugh... Feels like something's crawling inside my skull...

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_14.text: Why do I feel like I'm being watched?

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_15.text: Is this Clearfell? It seems so... real.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_16.text: I won't lie, that was an impressive show. Albeit... disturbing.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_17.text: Suppose I should take this to the old man.

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_18.text: Let's have a look inside, shall we?

Int4_Gameplay_Delirium_19.text: It'll take much more than that to break my mind, I'm afraid.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_1.text: Ooh! This altar is positively beautiful!

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_2.text: These cultists sure get around, don't they?

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_3.text: Is that a spectre? She's not one of mine.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_5.text: Leave the dark rituals to the experts, hm?

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_8.text: One day, it'll be me they're paying tribute to.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_9.text: Hm... I rather like it here.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_10.text: Let's see how the King measures up.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_13.text: Did you feel strong, defiling her this way?

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_14.text: Take it from a necromancer – stealing bodies isn't so easy!

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_17.text: Come, then. Let's get you out of here.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_18.text: There. Let's see them try to hurt you now.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_19.text: Finally, she is free of him.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_20.text: More cultists to kill. Lucky me.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_21.text: The first piece of my grand effigy.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_22.text: Now I can add the finishing touches to the effigy.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_23.text: Not the most flattering likeness... but it should do the job.

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_26.text: I'll send you back to the void myself!

Int4_Gameplay_Ritual_27.text: You came from nothing. Now return to it!

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_1.text: This halfwit is in need of rescuing.

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_2.text: Well, at least I didn't rescue him for nothing...

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_3.text: Another of those inscriptions... Should get the 'runeseeker' in here.

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_4.text: Liquid Verisium... What's it doing here?

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_5.text: These look like the runeseeker's tools.

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_6.text: Best see what the insufferable Ezomyte has to say about this.

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_7.text: Look at this place... The Cataclysm spared no one.

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_8.text: Doesn't <i>{anyone} know how to defend themselves?

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_9.text: I defile many tombs. Don't think yourself special!

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_11.text: If it isn't the traitor himself!

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_12.text: I'm afraid you won't be answering that call!

Int4_Gameplay_Expedition_16.text: Kalguuran story time is over for now. Phew.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_99.text: Magic swirls about these roots... but where is the source?

Int4_Gameplay_A1_101.text: They left in a hurry. Perhaps I should follow.

Int4_Gameplay_A1_102.text: Something had a little too much fun with this cattle.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_111.text: These raiders aren't out to make friends.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_113.text: The Serpent Clan nest is near.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_114.text: The Lightless claw their way up from below.

Int4_Gameplay_A2_115.text: Oh, to have one of these under my thrall...

Int4_Gameplay_A2_117.text: The Lost Men treat corpses like decorations. How wasteful!

Int4_Gameplay_A2_118.text: It would seem Shambrin's out of luck...

Int4_Gameplay_A3_161.text: Where are they slithering off to?

Int4_Gameplay_A3_162.text: She looks important. Or rather, she was.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_163.text: There's a way out over there.

Int4_Gameplay_A3_164.text: Infested, you say? Maybe I'll stop by.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_1.text: He sleeps now. The Beast overwhelms him.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_2.text: Now to unearth the secrets here.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_4.text: The ancients must have been truly brilliant, to design such a thing.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_5.text: We know our objective. Now we must see it through.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_6.text: Time has worn away at this fortress.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_16.text: The pieces are falling into place.

Int4b_Gameplay_EGrev_19.text: This... is it some kind of mirage?
